jobs.description:
Greenlight is a family technology company on a mission to help families raise financially smart kids and navigate life together. Its suite of products — including the Greenlight app, debit card, Safe Family GPS trackers, and Family Hub — brings together financial tools, safety features, and everyday family management in one connected experience. Designed for busy families who want convenience without compromise, Greenlight continues to innovate alongside the evolving needs of modern life. Today, more than 6.5 million family members trust Greenlight to stay in sync.
At Greenlight, we're here to make the day-to-day easier and futures brighter, so families can spend less time managing life, and more time living it. That's why we get out of bed every morning.
 


Greenlight is hiring a Senior Product Manager, Conversion Rate Optimization to own how visitors, especially those from paid media, become paying customers. You will own the conversion journey from ad click and landing page through plan selection, registration, KYC, onboarding and first purchase on greenlight.com.
This role combines CRO strategy (what the customer sees and why) with product execution (getting experiments built, launched and measured correctly). You will set the CRO roadmap, run a high-velocity experimentation program, and improve how our plans and products are presented so more families sign up and pay.
This role reports to the Senior Director of Product, Product Led Growth.
 Own the full-funnel CRO roadmap for paid traffic, tied to registration and paid-subscription targets.
 Match each landing page to the ad’s intent, audience and channel, and tailor value-prop messaging by segment and traffic source.
 Work with Growth Product and Growth Marketing leadership to turn each funnel stage into a multi-channel acquisition testing strategy.
 Find and size drop-off using funnel analytics, session replays and user research.
 Streamline the path from the landing page through registration and KYC, including multi-step forms and mobile-first flows, adding trust and compliance signals without hurting conversion.
 Improve plan presentation and comparison to ease decisions and sharpen our competitive position.
 Build and prioritize an experiment backlog scored on impact, effort and confidence.
 Design and run statistically sound A/B and multivariate tests across landing pages, plan selection, signup, onboarding and upsell. Manage setup, QA, traffic allocation and readouts, and plan test velocity around available traffic.
 Share results to inform Product, Marketing, Brand and Lifecycle strategy.
 Define tracking from landing through plan selection, registration, KYC and activation, and work with Analytics and Engineering to implement it. Ensure clean data flows from the website into registration, product and lifecycle systems.

jobs.description:
What we do and why we do it 
 As the leading end-to-end investment platform for single-family rental homes (SFR), our mission is to make real estate investing radically accessible, cost effective, and simple. We successfully merge our passion for helping investors build wealth through real estate with cutting edge technology that transforms the way they do it.   
 How it’s going (and growing)  
 With a talented team of 750+ Roofsters, our collaborative, can-do culture is what fuels our growth. In 2022, we closed on our Series E, raising $240 million, and have offices in the Bay Area and New York City. Our growth includes recent acquisitions of Stessa (financial and asset management software), RentPrep (tenant screening and placement service for landlords), and Mynd (property management platform for both Retail and Institutional investors). In 2025, Roofstock took an ownership stake in Casago (short-term rental management services), expanding our platform to support both long-term and short-term rental investment services.
 About the Role 
 The Manager for the Delinquency and Eviction Team will oversee a team of Jr. Delinquency/Eviction Specialists and Delinquency & Eviction Specialists, ensuring the effective management of delinquent accounts and eviction processes. The Manager will provide leadership, develop strategies to minimize delinquencies and ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations. This role is critical in maintaining financial stability and fostering positive relationships with residents across the portfolio.
 Responsibilit ies 
 Team Leadership and Management: 
 Supervise, mentor, and develop a team of Delinquency & Eviction Specialists, Jr. Specialists, and HAP Specialists.
 Set performance objectives, conduct regular 1:1’s, and provide ongoing coaching and feedback.
 Oversee the onboarding and offboarding of new team members to ensure a smooth transition and integration into the team.
 Recruit and hire to fill open positions on the team.
 Foster a culture of excellence, accountability, and collaboration within the team.
 Create and implement effective training programs and supporting process documents to support changes in local and state laws.
 Delinquency and Eviction Oversight: 
 Monitor and analyze delinquency rates across the portfolio, developing and implementing strategies to minimize late payments and non-payment issues.
 Oversee the initiation and management of eviction processes, ensuring compliance with local, state, and federal regulations.
 Ensure accurate documentation and record-keeping of all delinquency and eviction activities.
 Own portfolio delinquency (DQ %).
 Oversee the Legal Rent Demand Notice (LRDN) program, bankruptcy cases, and HAP/Section 8 delinquency.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: 
 Work closely with property managers, legal teams, and other stakeholders to efficiently handle delinquency and eviction cases.
 Coordinate with the senior leadership team to align team goals with company objectives.
 Manage relationships with eviction attorneys and vendors, including performance and escalations.
 Process Improvement and Compliance: 
 Identify areas for process improvement and implement strategies to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of delinquency management and eviction processes.
 Own the workflows and automation the team relies on, partnering with product and engineering on changes.
 Ensure all team members are up-to-date with relevant laws, regulations, and company policies related to property management and eviction.
 Reporting and Analysis: 
 Prepare and present reports on delinquency and eviction metrics, trends, and forecasts to senior management.
 Present DQ results and commentary to owner clients in monthly business reviews.

 Customer Relations and Conflict Resolution: 
 Oversee communication strategies with residents regarding delinquency concerns, payment plans, and eviction notices.
 Provide guidance and support to team members in handling escalated resident concerns and disputes.

 Provide ongoing training for team members regarding changes in laws and regulations affecting delinquency and eviction processes.

 Ability to thrive in a fast and ever-evolving environment.

jobs.title: Pricing and Procurement Manager
jobs.description:
What we do and why we do it 
 As the leading end-to-end investment platform for single-family rental homes (SFR), our mission is to reinvent the rental housing ecosystem for the benefit of all. We successfully merge our passion for helping investors build wealth through real estate with cutting edge technology that transforms the way they do it.
 How it’s going (and growing) 
 With a talented team of 750+ Roofsters, our collaborative, can-do culture is what fuels our growth. In 2022, we closed on our Series E, raising $240 million, and have offices in the Bay Area and New York City. Our growth includes recent acquisitions of Stessa (financial and asset management software), RentPrep (tenant screening and placement service for landlords), and Mynd (property management platform for both Retail and Institutional investors). In 2025, Roofstock took an ownership stake in Casago (short-term rental management services), expanding our platform to support both long-term and short-term rental investment services.
 About the Role: 
 The Pricing & Procurement Manager owns what Roofstock pays for construction, maintenance, and turnover work. Today, customers are more sensitive to costs, and we're looking for a dedicated owner to benchmark, set, maintain, and defend our prices.
 You will own the price book end to end: line-item pricing by market, flat-rate pricing for in-house technician work, and labor rates for non-flat-rate pricing. You will benchmark our prices against the market, bring them to fair market value, and negotiate national supplier agreements that lower material and equipment costs across every job. You'll do it with data, and you'll build the tools and AI workflows that keep pricing current without manual upkeep.
 This is a high-visibility role with executive sponsorship. You'll work closely with Vendor Programs, Construction, R&M, Finance, and Product, and your work will directly impact customer retention and owner NOI.
 Responsibilities:   
 Own the Price Book: Be the single owner of construction, maintenance, and turnover line-item pricing across every market. Set standards for how prices are built, changed, approved, and published, and keep them current on a defined review cycle.
 Benchmark Against the Market: Build a repeatable benchmarking program that compares our line items to what other operators of similar density and volume pay, plus local market rates. Use it to move prices to fair market value, weighted to our volume, without creating vendor capacity problems.
 Put a Price on More of the Work: Expand line-item and flat-rate pricing so more work orders are priced up front instead of billed hourly or bid one-off. Lead the national flat-rate rollout cycle.
 Negotiate National Supplier Agreements: Source and negotiate with national suppliers of materials, appliances, flooring, paint, HVAC equipment, and similar categories. Set the terms our contractors follow in the vendor playbook, and drive rebates and discounts that benefit owners, vendors, and Roofstock alike.
 Hold the Line on Price Adherence: Monitor invoices, change orders, and estimates against the price book. Spot off-book payments, find the root cause, and fix the price, scope, or process so it's solved once.
 Automate Pricing Upkeep: Partner with Product and BI to build the data, dashboards, and AI workflows that keep prices current, flag outliers, and automatically price new scopes, so the price book scales without adding headcount.
 Qualifications: 
 5+ years in pricing, procurement, strategic sourcing, or cost estimating, ideally in residential construction, property management, home services, or facilities
 You've built or owned a price book, unit-cost database, or rate card, and kept it current
 You know what a paint job, a flooring install, or an HVAC replacement should cost, or you know how to find out fast
 Strong analytical skills: comfortable modeling pricing scenarios, margin, and volume trade-offs in spreadsheets and BI tools (Sigma, SQL, or similar a plus)
 Track record negotiating national or multi-region supplier agreements, including rebate and discount structures
 Clear communicator who can explain a price to a vendor, a customer, and an executive, and hold the line when needed
 Bias toward building systems over doing work by hand; experience using AI or automation to scale analytical work is a strong plus
 Comfortable in a fast-moving environment with a lot of ownership and few handoffs
 Bachelor's degree in business, construction management, supply chain, finance, or equivalent experience
 Travel Required

 Team Overview 
The Financial Services Analytics team partners with banks, lenders, insurers, and other financial institutions to solve complex business challenges using advanced analytics and TransUnion data assets. The team delivers predictive modeling, risk analytics, fraud solutions, and business intelligence insights that help clients make smarter business decisions and drive measurable outcomes. This role reports to Director of Data Science and Analytics.
This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week. 
 Role Overview and Core Responsibilities 
 You will partner with internal and external cross-functional teams to drive new business initiatives and deliver long term value-added solutions to various TransUnion customers. These tasks will include –among others- the development of predictive models and business intelligence solutions of moderate scope and complexity for customers within the various industries served by TransUnion.
 You will lead analytic client engagements involving descriptive, predictive, and prescriptive analysis for a variety of business use cases leveraging multiple analytic techniques. As a project leader, you will take ownership of all aspects of the project from design, to development, to peer review, to client presentation, to implementation and audit.
 You will identify strategies and opportunities for customers to test and adopt TransUnion’s analytic products and services and develop project proposals, sales presentations and promotional collateral to enable the adoption of integrated customer solutions supported by TransUnion, applying your practical analytic experience to find areas of new value of TransUnion customers. In the context of these opportunities, you will interact directly with TransUnion Sales and business unit partners and provide an analytic perspective and general support as needed.
 You will design, write, and test programs for data extraction, segmentation and statistical analysis on large population datasets using languages such as R, Python, SQL, Hive and Spark, formalizing some of these efforts into repeatable process improvements.
 You will deliver analytic insights and recommendations in succinct and compelling presentations for internal and external customers representing a wide range of backgrounds and levels. You will foster a high performance culture and cultivate an environment that promotes excellence and reflects the TransUnion brand.
 Required Knowledge and Experiences 
 Master’s or PhD degree in statistics, applied mathematics, financial mathematics, computer science, engineering, operations research, or other highly quantitative field; or a Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field with at least three (3) years of relevant professional experience. In either case, the candidate will demonstrate a consistent track record of academic excellence.

Familiarity with US GAAP concepts and common accounting principles

jobs.description:
Verisk is a global data, analytics, and technology company helping organizations make better decisions about risk.
 Across the insurance industry, our data, predictive models, and technology support decisions throughout the insurance lifecycle, from underwriting and pricing to claims management and fraud detection. We work with complex, high-value datasets including weather, property, business, financial, claims, policy, medical, imagery, and geodemographic data.
 Within Verisk Claims UK, we focus on helping insurers improve how claims are assessed, managed, and resolved. Our analytics and automation solutions help streamline claims processes, identify fraud, and support better outcomes for insurers and their customers.
 About the role 
 We’re looking for an early-career Data Scientist to join our International Analytics Team and help build the next generation of analytics products across claims and underwriting.
 This is a role where you can do more than develop models in isolation. You’ll work with real-world insurance data, explore complex problems, test different approaches, and help take models from initial idea through to production.
 The work is varied. Depending on the project, you could be developing supervised machine learning models, exploring clustering techniques, working with language models or network analysis, or contributing to AI solutions involving automated document processing, agentic decision-making workflows, and claims analysis and auditing.
 You’ll have room to experiment, learn, and build your technical depth while working alongside experienced colleagues who value peer review, knowledge sharing, and high-quality analytical work.
 For someone at the beginning of their data science career, this is an opportunity to develop broad, practical experience within a global organization while seeing the real-world impact of your work.
 This position can be based in our offices in London or Norwich.
 Why join Verisk Claims? 
 This role offers the combination of technical variety, meaningful data, and long-term career development that can be difficult to find in an early-career data science position.
 You’ll be working on products that support real decisions across the insurance industry, with access to diverse datasets and opportunities to apply both established modeling techniques and newer areas of AI.
 You’ll also have the scale and stability of Verisk behind you, alongside the opportunity to take genuine ownership of your work, develop your technical expertise, and understand how high-quality data science moves from experimentation into products used by the industry.
 If you’re looking for a Data Scientist role where you can keep learning while building things that have a practical, measurable purpose, we’d like to hear from you.
 #LI-SD2  #LI-Hybrid You don’t need to arrive knowing everything about insurance. We’re looking for someone with strong analytical foundations, curiosity, and the motivation to develop.
 Ideally, you’ll bring:
 •   A bachelor's, master's, or PhD in mathematics, statistics, data science, computer science, another scientific discipline, or a related analytical field.
 •   Solid programming skills, ideally using Python and SQL.
 •   Experience working with data, including manipulation, cleaning, validation, and analysis.
 •   Exposure to statistical modeling, machine learning, or other predictive techniques.
 •   Strong logical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to approach complex questions in a structured way.
 •   Good attention to detail and an interest in producing reliable, reproducible analytical work.
 •   Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical work to different audiences.
 •   A collaborative approach and willingness to learn from, and contribute to, the wider team. •  Support the development of new analytics products for insurance claims and underwriting.
 •   Explore complex datasets and turn them into meaningful insights, including data processing, cleaning, joining multiple data sources, feature engineering, analysis, and interpretation.
 •   Build and compare predictive models using techniques such as GLMs, gradient boosting, Random Forests, and neural networks.
 •   Identify the features and factors that provide meaningful predictive value and understand how they influence model performance.
 •   Help create, test, and monitor agentic AI workflows that are traceable, repeatable, and suitable for real-world use.
 •   Work with stakeholders to understand requirements and translate business problems into practical analytical solutions.
 •   Write clear, reusable, and well-documented code, using version control and creating functions and templates that can be applied efficiently to future projects.
 •   Communicate analytical approaches, progress, findings, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues.
 •   Take part in peer reviews, sharing ideas and learning from colleagues while contributing to consistently high-quality work.

When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.
 As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.

 Innovation
 Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms

 Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives

 Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline

Senior Associate, Data Scientist - Business Cards Marketing Data Science 
 Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making. 
 As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives. 
 Team Description 
 The Business Cards Marketing Data Science team is a team of talented data scientists leveraging cutting-edge machine learning models and statistical methods to deeply understand customer behavior, so we can optimize our marketing campaigns to win new customers and drive sticky relationships with our existing customers.  
 In the recent past, we have experimented with multiple modeling approaches including time-series models, regression & classification models, ensemble models, LLMs, causal learners to name a few. Our objective is to drive model usage across every aspect of marketing and increase personalization.  
 We are embedded within the teams owning the campaigns and hence work very closely with business analysts and marketers to ensure that the models we build drive business value and are used in decision making and in marketing campaigns. 
 Role Description 
 In this role, you will: 
 Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers love 
 Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data 
 Build machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation 
 Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals 
 The Ideal Candidate is: 
 Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. 
 Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. 
 Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. 
 Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning. 
 A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science. 
 Basic Qualifications: 
 Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date: 
 A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 2 years of experience performing data analytics 
 A Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Master’s Degree in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics), or PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) 
 Experience working with AWS 
 At least 2 years’ experience in Python, Scala, or R 
 At least 2 years’ experience with machine learning 
 At least 2 years’ experience with SQL

jobs.description:
You are a strategic thinker passionate about driving solutions in Financial Analytics, Reporting, Business Intelligence, Data Science (EDA and Modelling) and AI / Gen AI . You have found the right team. 
 As a Financial Analytics Associate within our Asset and Wealth Management Transformation and Analytics Team, you will define, refine, and deliver strategic goals for our firm by translating complex financial and operational data into actionable insights, predictive models, and AI-promoten solutions that enhance decision-making and promote business performance. 
 Job Responsibilities : 
 Scope, prioritize and co-ordinate activities with product owners and finance stakeholders. Partner with Finance, Risk and Business teams to identify strategic analytical, data science and AI solutions. Perform in-depth financial analysis including revenue, expense, margin, variance, profitability, product/client profitability and KPI analysis to support business decisions. 
 Design, develop and automate management reporting, dashboards and scorecards covering P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, forecasts, budgets, headcount and performance metrics. Drive the annual budgeting, mid-year re-forecast, rolling forecast and multi-year strategic planning cycles in partnership with Business Finance teams. 
 Implement exploratory data analysis (EDA) and statistical modelling to identify trends, patterns and drivers of financial performance. Identify key financial and operational data sources that can drive business impact; ensure data quality, reconciliation and audit trails across reporting outputs. 
 Design and develop data mining and reporting queries from large data sets (both structured and unstructured) and convert raw financial data into clear information. Build compelling visualizations and storytelling using BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, Alteryx) that translate financial results and model outputs into clear business narratives for senior leadership. 
 Employ scaling and automation to data preparation, consolidation and reporting workflows to improve efficiency and accuracy of recurring financial deliverables. Transform model outputs and analytical results into formats digestible to end users through visualizations, clear tables and thoughtful presentations; assist technical and non-technical stakeholders in interpreting the analysis. 
 Leverage AI assistants and copilots (e.g., Microsoft 365 Copilot, GitHub Copilot, and in-house Gen AI tooling) to accelerate analytics workflows — code generation, SQL/Python drafting, document summarization, and natural-language querying of financial datasets — while applying firm-approved controls on data confidentiality and model output review. 
 Required qualifications, capabilities and skills 
 Self-starter, attention to detail and results oriented, able to work under minimal guidance in a fast-paced environment. 
 Uses pertinent financial data and facts to identify and solve a range of business problems within area of expertise. 
 Mandatory experience in financial analytics, FP&A, management reporting, variance analysis and KPI/performance measurement. Strong understanding of accounting principles (US GAAP / IFRS), financial statements (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow), journal entries, intercompany, allocations, accruals and month-end close processes. 
 Working knowledge of profitability and performance metrics: unit economics, gross/operating margin, contribution margin, EBITDA, ROE/ROA,  cost-to-income ratio, NIM, fee revenue and AUM-based metrics.  
 Mandatory experience in Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), regression and statistical/machine learning modelling applied to financial or business datasets. Hands-on experience with pandas and PySpark/PySQL stack. Experience in building data extraction, transformation and modelling pipelines. 
 Strong proficiency in SQL (Snowflake, Databricks) and Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Keras, PySpark/PySQL) for data wrangling, modelling, AI pipelines and automation of financial workflows. Hands-on experience using AI skills / copilots to support analytics work — e.g., Microsoft 365 Copilot (Excel, Power BI, Word, PowerPoint), GitHub Copilot, for  SQL generation, data summarization and productivity gains in day-to-day financial analytics deliverables; awareness of responsible-AI, data-privacy and model-risk guardrails. 
 Working proficiency in data visualization tools; strong experience with BI technologies including but not limited to Tableau, Power BI and Alteryx. Experience in end-to-end implementation of Business Intelligence (BI) reports and dashboards for finance, risk or business performance reporting. Should be good at mathematics, inferential statistics and quantitative analysis as applied to financial data and model building. 
 Provides explanations and information to others on topics within area of expertise; strong business partnering skills with Finance and Business stakeholders. 
 Experience Required: 5+ years in data/analytics related projects with 2+ years in financial analytics 
 Good communication and analytical skills, with the ability to present financial insights, model results and AI-driven outputs clearly to senior stakeholders. 
 Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills 
 Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science or Engineering. A different field of study with significant professional experience in Financial Analytics / BI / Data Science / AI is acceptable. MBA (Finance) is a strong plus. 
 Exposure to Asset & Wealth Management / banking products and metrics (AUM, net flows, revenue yield, client profitability, fee waivers) is strongly preferred.

Join a team that evaluates complex and innovative transactions across renewable energy, transportation, energy transition, and emerging green technologies. You'll develop deep credit risk expertise, work alongside experienced professionals, and gain exposure to high-profile transactions across diverse industries and markets.
 As a Credit Risk Analyst in the Infrastructure & Green Economy Credit Risk team, you will structure new transactions and manage a portfolio of existing loans and related credit exposures to greenfield and brownfield projects across multiple sectors, including energy, power, renewables, energy transition, emerging green technologies, and transportation assets. You will work closely with senior team members and partner with colleagues across financing, banking, and markets businesses. This role provides an opportunity to enhance your analytical skills on highly structured transactions across a range of industries and countries in a fast-paced and highly competitive environment.
 Job Responsibilities 
 Interface closely with business teams to develop diligence questions by reviewing contracts, forecasts, budgets, financial statements, construction reports, operating reports, and other materials.
 Use strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify risks and recommend loan structures that appropriately protect the firm's interests in structured transactions.
 Build and maintain financial models to assess the impact of forward-looking risks on key business and transaction drivers.
 Support transaction execution by reviewing and structuring financing and commercial contracts and making recommendations regarding capital structure, exposure levels, and risk ratings.
 Apply corporate finance and accounting expertise to prepare credit memorandums and support credit approval and booking processes.
 Perform portfolio management activities, including analyzing amendment and waiver requests, conducting periodic credit reviews, completing ongoing counterparty and industry credit analysis, monitoring trading limits and credit ratings, and supporting documentation revisions.
 Maintain awareness of all aspects of assigned clients, including industry trends, portfolio performance, covenant compliance, current events, potential risks, and opportunities.
 Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills 
 Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
 Experience in financial services, consulting, risk management, corporate finance, or a related field.
 Strong financial modeling skills and familiarity with financial statements, including the ability to analyze capital structure, profitability, project costs, and cash flow.
 Understanding of front-office processes, credit risk management, and commercial requirements.
 Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment.
 Ability to learn quickly, with strong attention to detail and excellent organizational and time management skills.
 Strong commercial judgment with the ability to balance risks and opportunities.
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and effectively.
 Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and Word, including working with large datasets.
 Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills 
 Experience in project finance, infrastructure finance, or structured lending.
 Knowledge of energy, renewables, transportation, or emerging green technology sectors.
 Familiarity with credit risk assessment of complex financing structures.

jobs.description:
Join an Applied Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning team that takes Generative AI and Machine Learning applications from prototype to production for a Global Banking business. You will work in a collaborative, inclusive environment with opportunities to build technical depth.
 As a Senior Associate–Applied Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning in the Applied Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning team, you will help solve exciting business challenges for a Global Banking business within a leading global financial institution. You will work with product, business, and engineering partners to turn business problems into AI/ML solutions, balancing accuracy, latency, cost, and risk, and deliver them reliably in a regulated environment. You will apply sound technical judgment to balance business needs with technical constraints, contribute to experimentation and validation, and help productionize scalable and trustworthy solutions. You will also engage in knowledge sharing through enterprise machine learning communities.
 Job responsibilities 
 Collaborate with an Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML) team to contribute to projects within a global organization and support an inclusive culture with a growth mindset
 Assist in setting the technical vision and executing strategic roadmaps to drive AI innovation
 Design, build, and iterate on generative AI and machine learning applications
 Evaluate large language model (LLM)-powered applications using curated test sets, metrics, automated and LLM-based scoring, human review, and regression testing, and use the results to drive improvements
 Partner with engineering teams to productionize solutions, and monitor quality, latency, and cost once deployed
 Work with product and business partners to translate requirements into AI/ML specifications, define milestones, and deliver using Agile methodology

 Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

 Experience evaluating AI/ML systems, including designing metrics, test sets, and experiments for non-deterministic outputs
 Knowledge of data structures, algorithms, machine learning, data mining, and information retrieval
 Hands-on experience applying classical machine learning (for example, linear models, tree-based ensembles, clustering) and deep learning (for example, neural networks, transformers), including feature engineering, model training, and validation
 Proficiency in Python with hands-on experience in machine learning and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, scikit-learn) and generative AI ecosystems (Hugging Face, large language model application programming interfaces, LangChain/Google ADK)
 Experience using version control, code review, and testing practices
 Collaboration skills and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer, Senior Associate of Morgan Health
jobs.location: New York, NY, United States; Washington, DC, United States
jobs.description:
Morgan Health is a mission-driven healthcare organization within JPMorgan Chase focused on improving the quality, affordability, and experience of employer-sponsored healthcare. We operate with the focus and agility of a smaller, specialized team, backed by the scale, resources, and reach of one of the world’s largest companies. Our team brings together healthcare, data, research, investment, and policy expertise to tackle some of the most complex challenges facing employers and their employees. If you are someone who wants their technical work to have a tangible impact on healthcare, this is a unique opportunity to build within a highly collaborative team to further Morgan Health’s mission. 
 As a Senior Analytics Engineer within Morgan Health, you’ll play a key role in building the data foundation behind that work. You’ll have meaningful ownership of Morgan Health’s analytics environment, partnering closely with data scientists as well as other internal and external stakeholders to turn complex healthcare data into trusted, production-ready data marts that support research, insights, and decision-making. In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape how analytics engineering is done within Morgan Health — not simply inherit an established process. You will own and evolve core elements of the analytics life cycle, from data modeling and testing to CI/CD, monitoring and quality standards. Because we’re a focused team, you will work closely with the people using the data and have visibility into how your work contributes to healthcare research, insights, and ultimately better outcomes.
 This role is in-office five days per week, based in either New York, NY or Washington, DC. 
 Job Responsibilities: 
 Develop and maintain Morgan Health’s healthcare data models (e.g., marts and curated datasets) using SQL and dbt
 Create proof of concept (POC) solutions of data products per data scientist design requirements; iterate rapidly to refine requirements and evolve POCs to production-level solutions
 Design and evolve a robust automated testing framework (e.g., dbt tests, custom checks, risk-based testing strategies)
 Design, deploy, and maintain Databricks bundles and production jobs using environment branching strategies, and integrate with Unity Catalog to ensure an access-controlled, auditable data asset management
 Lead code reviews and establish quality standards for the team’s dbt codebase; enforce best practices and drive continuous improvement in code-review rigor, traceability, and maintainability
 Maintain clear documentation (data dictionary, model descriptions, metric logic, known limitations, and issue logs) to promote transparency and support data governance and HIPAA-aligned compliance standards
 Proactively investigate, identify root causes, and address data quality issues in the analytics layer; partner with the Data Product lead to validate upstream issues and prioritize solutions
 Design CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows in response to evolving control requirements — not just execute an existing process
 Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills: 
 Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related discipline
 5 years of professional experience in analytics engineering, data analytics/modeling, or a closely related role with a focus on building curated, analyst- and data-science-facing datasets
 Proficiency in SQL with demonstrated skills and hands-on experience building modular, tested, version-controlled SQL transformations using dbt
 Demonstrated ownership of the full lifecycle of a dbt project, including automated testing, CI/CD and deployment, environment/version management, monitoring, and ongoing performance and reliability of the analytics layer in production
 Hands-on experience using Databricks (or similar platforms) to develop, deploy, and support data pipelines and analytics workflows in a production environment; experience working with Python or R for analysis, testing, and automation
 Proven track record of creating and maintaining data models, data marts, and transformations that support multiple competing analytical use cases
 Strong written and verbal communication skills with an ability to effectively interface within cross-functional teams (data scientists, analytics engineering, product/architecture, and platform partners)
 Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills 
 Experience working with health care data (e.g., medical and pharmaceutical claims, eligibility, provider, survey, or biometrics data), common medical groupers, and quality measurement standards
 Advanced degree in a quantitative field such as computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related discipline
 Experience using AI-assisted coding tools to develop, test, and improve SQL, Python, and analytics engineering workflows
 Experience supporting analytics platforms in regulated and/or privacy-sensitive environments
 Demonstrated ability to successfully multitask, balance competing priorities, and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment
 To be eligible for this role, you must be authorized to work in the United States. We do not offer any type of employment-based immigration sponsorship for this role. Likewise, JPMorgan Chase & Co. will not provide any assistance or sign any documentation in support of any other form of immigration sponsorship or benefit, including optional practical training (OPT) or curricular practical training (CPT).

jobs.description:
Within J.P. Morgan Wealth Management, Wealth Management Solutions (“Solutions”) serves the entire wealth spectrum, from affluent clients in Chase branches to deca-billionaires in our ~50 Private Bank offices globally. Our extensive product platform spans investments, lending, banking, mortgages, trusts & estates, insurance, and retirement. Our team of more than 1,200 professionals spans 20 cities globally. These dedicated teams of experts have extensive industry experience, and leverage global economic and market insights to formulate broad strategic views and provide integrated solutions and advice through a private client lens.

The primary function of this role is to drive the development of next generation Quantitative Risk models with support of a team, own the vision for the applications, and support the prioritized needs of the stakeholders within J.P. Morgan Wealth Management globally.

 Qualifications:
 Minimum of 10 years of total professional experience in quantitative risk management, financial engineering, or quantitative analytics, with at least 5 years focused specifically on product management for complex technical or data platforms

jobs.description:

The QTR Securities Services team applies cutting-edge AI/ML techniques to fundamentally transform the way we do business by enabling business revenue growth and efficiency within the CIB organization.

This could range from leveraging LLMs to deliver capabilities at scales never before possible, to developing ML applications that make business-critical predictions, to handling vast data sets using the J.P.Morgan's Cloud capabilities. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems using your quantitative background and experience, this may be just the team for you.

jobs.title: Quant Analytics, Senior Associate - Asset Wealth Management
jobs.location: New York, NY, United States; Jersey City, NJ, United States
jobs.description:
AI is only as good as the data and business context behind it—and in asset management, that starts with a trusted view of our clients. Join a team that turns complex data into clear insights, strategic recommendations, and reusable analytics products. You will help shape how client data is prepared for AI and how teams across the business use data to make better decisions. If you enjoy combining quantitative rigor with real-world business impact, this role is built for you.
 As a Senior Associate, Quantitative Analytics at JPMorganChase within the Asset & Wealth Management Business Intelligence & Analytics team, you will own the Client Analytics Data Product and shape how client data is prepared for AI as part of the Asset & Wealth Management AI data strategy. You will partner with marketing, sales, finance, product strategy, client service, and investment teams to understand how each uses client data, and turn those perspectives into a shared view of the client, quantitative insights, and strategic recommendations. You will combine advanced analytics, internal and third-party data, and dashboards in Microsoft Power BI and Qlik Sense to deliver trusted, AI-ready data products that improve business performance.
 Job responsibilities 
 Own the Client Analytics Data Product roadmap, success measures, and delivery plan, prioritizing work by business use case and adoption outcomes.
 Partner with marketing, sales, finance, product strategy, client service, and investment teams to run intake, align priorities, and drive adoption of analytics products.
 Deliver quantitative insights and senior-ready recommendations that improve decisions across the business (for example, segmentation, coverage strategy, profitability, retention, and flows).
 Design and execute analyses using methods such as regression, segmentation, propensity modeling, attrition modeling, forecasting, attribution, and test-and-learn experimentation.
 Define shared client and product definitions and certified metrics so teams and AI tools consistently get the same answer to the same question.
 Build scalable dashboards and reusable analytics products in Microsoft Power BI and Qlik Sense, and partner with technology teams to embed insights into workflows and reporting.
 Integrate internal and third-party data and build validated analytical models in SQL and Python, addressing entity resolution, hierarchies, history, granularity, and data quality.
 Required qualifications, capabilities and skills 
 3+ years of experience in quantitative analytics, data science, business intelligence, or analytics consulting delivering insights and analytics products for multiple business teams.
 Demonstrated quantitative skills in statistics, regression, segmentation or clustering, forecasting, and experimental design.
 Advanced SQL and Python experience (for example, pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels) working with large, multi-source datasets.
 Hands-on experience building dashboards and analytics products using Microsoft Power BI and/or Qlik Sense.
 Proven ability to translate analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders, supported by concrete examples and outcomes.
 Strong stakeholder management skills, including influencing without direct authority, aligning competing priorities, and driving adoption across teams.
 Working knowledge of data governance fundamentals (definitions, lineage, data quality, access controls) and how trusted data supports responsible AI use cases.
 Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills 
 Experience using third-party asset management datasets such as Morningstar, FINTRX, Broadridge, and/or Preqin for competitive and industry benchmarking.
 Knowledge of asset and wealth management products and distribution, including mutual funds, exchange-traded funds, separately managed accounts, alternatives, assets under management, and flows.
 Experience applying advanced methods such as propensity modeling, next-best-action modeling, causal inference, and/or time-series forecasting to client and product datasets.
 Advanced dashboarding and semantic modeling skills (for example, Data Analysis Expressions, Power Query, and Qlik scripting and set analysis), with familiarity in Snowflake, Databricks, or dbt as a plus.

jobs.description:

 As a Product Control Senior Associate you will work closely with multiple teams across front office, middle office, technology and policy to support the firm’s structural interest rate risk management hedging activities.  
 Position Responsibilities: 
 Interest rate risk hedging analytics support: explain drivers of hedge results (e.g., curve moves, carry/roll, DV01 changes) and produce related analyses for senior management 
 Ensure accurate valuation, booking, P&L attribution, for hedging activities and ensure hedges qualify for and are maintained under hedge accounting rules 
 Oversight of hedging related financial reporting, operational controls and documentation. 
 Partner with Technology teams to streamline and improve the end-to-end processes through automation and workflow redesign 
 Implementation of new hedging strategies  
 Participate in ad-hoc projects and other analytical requests  
 Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (CPA or progress toward CPA is  preferred) 
 Minimum 3 years’ relevant experience within a financial institution/markets environment and/or in public accounting 
 Working knowledge of fixed income and rates products (e.g., interest rate swaps government/agency bonds, securitized products) 
 Capable of managing individual projects and meeting deadlines with minimal supervision 
 Strong communication skills with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts to key stakeholders 
 High motivation, a desire to learn and ability to quickly climb the learning curve 
 Ability to manage tight timelines, prioritize effectively, and maintain high attention to detail 
 Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills: 
 Solid understanding of interest rate swaps/derivative products (trade economics, lifecycle events, discounting basics) and how they are used to hedge interest rate risk  
 Knowledge of or experience with hedge accounting concepts including documentation, effectiveness assessment and financial statement presentation/disclosures for fair value and cash flow hedges

jobs.description:
The Core Engineering  
 The Core Engineering builds and operates the platforms, applications, data solutions, models, and analytics that power critical processes for The Core divisions of the firm (e.g., Risk, responsible for the risk profile of firm activities; Controllers, responsible for the financial control and reporting obligations; Compliance, responsible for the firm’s compliance, regulatory, and reputational risks; Corporate Treasury, responsible for the firm’s liquidity, funding, balance sheet, etc.; and Human Capital Management, responsible for attracting, developing, and managing a global workforce). A centralized engineering structure in support of The Core enables a common platform model and operating framework that promotes consistent governance and scalable solutions, leveraging cloud, AI, and machine learning for innovation and efficiency. The Core Engineering’s 2,000+ engineers and strats deliver engineering, data, analytics, and quantitative capabilities within six business units:  
 Metrics & Analytics Platforms: responsible for the measurement and management of the firm’s risk, capital, and liquidity for The Core functions 
 The Core Strats: responsible for the development and implementation of models and other quantitative methodologies, including the accuracy and attribution of modeled metrics 
 Financials & Reporting: responsible for facilitating the production of the firm’s financials and a wide range of reporting functions 
 Non-Financial Risk & Controls: responsible for non-financial risk and control processes 
 Enterprise Platforms: responsible for platforms and applications that support critical operational processes across The Core such as payments, people processes, and procurement 
 Shared Services: responsible for driving the adoption of consistent engineering strategy, including data platforms, cloud, and AI enablement, as well as the management of technology risk  
 MARKET RISK STRATS 
 The Market Risk Strats team within the Core Strats is a quantitative modelling team focusing on market risk and capital models.  The team is primarily responsible for designing, implementing and maintaining quantitative models for metrics such as Value-at-Risk, Stress Tests and Capital. 
 YOUR IMPACT 
 The responsibilities can include:  
 Developing, refining and maintaining robust and production quality market risk models (such as value-at-risk, stress tests) and capital mdels. This involves identifying market risk factors for various products and building mathematical models to capture their economic and statistical characteristics.  
 Implementing, testing and productionizing models and analytics.  This involves prototyping models, implementing them and designing tests to ensure the quality of implementation as well as tests for the continuous functioning of the models. 
 Performing pricing analyses, risk and capital impact analyses. 
 Interact with various other groups such as risk managers, senior managers and stakeholders to explain the results of the models and analytics and provide quantitative advice. 
 REQUIREMENTS 
 Strong quantitative skills with a PhD degree in a quantitative discipline (Physics, Mathematics, Quantitative Finance, Computer Science, Engineering, etc.) or a Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in a quantitative discipline with 1-3 years of relevant work experience.
 Excellent command of mathematics, modeling and numerical techniques. 
 Good knowledge of statistics, time series analysis, econometric modeling and probability theory. 
 Strong programming skills and experience with a popular programming language (Java, C++, Python etc.). 
 Hands-on experience of developing pricing models/risk models.
 Excellent written, verbal and team-oriented communication skills.

jobs.description:
Company Profile: 
 Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, investment management and wealth management services. The Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments and individuals from more than 1,200 offices in 41 countries.
 As a market leader, the talent and passion of our people is critical to our success. Together, we share a common set of values rooted in integrity, excellence and strong team ethic. Morgan Stanley can provide a superior foundation for building a professional career – a place for people to learn, to achieve and grow. A philosophy that balances personal lifestyles, perspectives and needs is an important part of our culture.
 Department Profile: 
 The Financial Crimes Risk (“FCR”) department is embedded within the Firm’s business line. It is responsible for identifying, assessing, and escalating potential money laundering and reputational risk issues associated with higher risk client types. The FCR department is considered the first line of defense and supports the onboarding, enhanced due diligence, and negative news processes for Morgan Stanley.
 Position Summary: 
 Our key priority is to design and build Wealth Management, Bank, and Investment Management Risk’s ability to aggregate, analyze and report on relevant risk factors within the FCR segment across these Morgan Stanley businesses. 
 The Data, Analytics and Reporting Team (“DART”) within FCR is seeking a candidate who will provide analytical and reporting automation support for the financial crimes program, regulatory thematic updates, and transformation initiatives across the first line financial crimes processes. In addition to working within FCR, the employee will also collaborate with the Business, IT, Legal and Compliance, and Bank and Field Management.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Our key priority is to design and build the first line Financial Crimes Risk supervisory framework and control structures. This includes the ability to aggregate, analyze and report on key risk factors in the Financial Crimes space across WM, Bank, and Investment Management businesses, particularly with respect to heightened risk client types and international wealth businesses and compliance with relevant policies and procedures when servicing clients. The ideal candidate will have experience in managing complex strategic projects, related to risk oversight in financial crimes, have expertise in data management and reporting as well as good strategic thinking and communication skills to produce effective monitoring of existing and emerging risks and ultimately effect change in the business’ risk management practices.
 The candidate will be responsible for collecting, processing, and analyzing data from various sources. The employee will be expected to work independently as well as part of a team to execute the full cycle of quantitative analysis. This includes sourcing raw data, quality checking the data, transforming data as necessary and using data to draw sound conclusions and help drive risk policies. This role requires familiarity with datasets larger than four million records and to build automated and scalable tools for reporting and analysis. The employee will take initiative and responsibility to drive tasks forward. In addition to data management, the ability to reach conclusions quickly and consistently will be critical to being successful in this role. The candidate’s primary responsibilities will include:
 Support development of control structure based on ongoing analysis and relevant risks related to the first line financial crimes risk program, including regulatory and transformation initiatives 
 Through data-driven analyses, liaise with functional area representatives from FCR and its stakeholders to identify and assess potential gaps in the risk framework and provide recommendations on control structures 
 Assist with developing requirements and work closely with technology, data & analytics, and operations teams to drive relevant data sourcing systemic control development 
 Manage projects to build automated and scalable tools for reporting, analysis and gaining efficiencies in financial crimes risk processes 
 Assist in designing and implementing a holistic risk management framework for the firm’s financial crimes risk program 
 Integrate new data queries and insights into existing supervision framework 
 Perform data analysis on special topics related to key events and regulations 
 Assist in building data pipelines to support risk management process 
 Engage senior stakeholders across 1st and 2nd lines on special initiatives and ongoing financial crimes related risk matters 
 Expand the use of AI across 1st line FCR data driven activities and processes to drive efficiency and automation 
 Required Skills: 
 Strong knowledge of SQL and Python are job requirements
 Strong project management skills and ability to manage many competing priorities
 Experience visualizing data for reporting and end user analysis, using tools like Tableau
 Practical experience with applying statistical models to solve business problems
 A quantitative degree e.g., Math, Statistics, Computer Science, Finance
 Experience in risk management, financial industry and/or business management.  Knowledge related to Wealth Management a plus
 Working knowledge of financial risk management concepts, with a desire to quickly acquire deeper proficiency
 Familiarity with Agile software development and software design patterns is a plus
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and comfortable interfacing with senior personnel on highly sensitive issues
 Proven ability to work across departments to influence others and build strong relationships
 Strong belief in purposeful evolution, innovation, and digital transformation
 Attention to detail, high level of initiative and resourcefulness and ability to problem solve, demonstrate good business judgment and integrity
 Proficiency in Microsoft programs including Outlook, Word, PowerPoint and Excel
 WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM MORGAN STANLEY: 
 At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years.  Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work. 
 To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices​ into your browser.
 Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background.  Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents. 
 Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

Key responsibilities include leveraging databases to acquire client and performance data, transforming extracted data into meaningful insights and trends, and delivering those insights to leaders to make complex business decisions. Job expectations include working with business partners to understand, coordinate, and deliver agreed upon priorities while communicating complex data outputs and delivering the appropriate summary and data required.

 Supports the extraction of data using a variety of a programming languages, such as SQL, SAS, Python, or Spark/Scala, and applies knowledge of relational and non-relational database systems housed on both on-premise and off-premise (hybrid) platforms

 Line of Business Description: 
 This job is responsible for supporting analytical work efforts for a Line of Business or business discipline. Key responsibilities include acquiring, integrating, and analyzing client and performance data, transforming data into meaningful insights, and communicating findings that support business decision-making. Job expectations include partnering with business stakeholders to understand priorities, supporting analytical projects, and delivering accurate, actionable information through data-driven analysis.
 Responsibilities 
 Supports analytical projects by researching data sources, executing established methodologies, and delivering results according to defined requirements and timelines.
 Extracts, prepares, validates, and manages data using analytical tools and programming languages such as SQL, SAS, and Python.
 Integrates and transforms data from multiple internal and external sources utilizing technical, business, and process knowledge to create reliable datasets and meaningful business insights.
 Performs quantitative analyses on client, transaction, and performance data to identify trends, answer business questions, and support informed decision-making under the guidance of senior analysts and managers.
 Communicates analytical findings and recommendations effectively to technical and non-technical audiences through presentations, reports, dashboards, and other business communications using tools such as PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and Tableau.
 Performs quality assurance and validation reviews on analytical outputs, identifies data quality issues, and escalates concerns as appropriate.
 Adheres to established governance, documentation, and quality-control standards to support auditability, consistency, business continuity, and regulatory compliance.
 Required Qualifications 
 2+ years of demonstrated experience in analytics, quantitative research, data science, or a related field.
 Experience using analytical and programming tools such as SQL, Python, and AI coding agents.
 Experience extracting, integrating, and manipulating structured and unstructured data from multiple database platforms and data environments, including Hadoop.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights.
 Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly communicate complex analytical concepts and findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
 Ability to collaborate effectively with business partners, analysts, and technology teams in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.

 Knowledge of advanced analytical techniques, including statistical sampling, optimization, machine learning, predictive modeling, artificial intelligence, and related quantitative methods.

jobs.title: AI Engineer – Global Rates, APAC Local Markets Sales & Trading
jobs.description:
The Global Rates business is seeking an exceptional AI Engineer to support our APAC Local Markets rates Sales & Trading desk, driving the development and implementation of cutting-edge artificial intelligence and data-driven solutions that will transform our pricing, trading, risk management, and client service capabilities across the region's local rates markets. This role sits at the intersection of advanced AI/ML technology and financial markets, offering the opportunity to build innovative solutions that directly impact revenue generation, pricing precision, and trading risk management.
 As an AI Engineer within Global Rates supporting APAC Local Markets, you will work directly alongside rates traders and sales professionals on the desk, translating fast-moving market needs into production-grade analytical tools. A core focus of the role is pricing optimization, bid-offer spread calibration, and the application of modern machine learning and generative AI techniques to sharpen client pricing and enhance trading risk management across local rates products. You will also be responsible for building the dashboards, visualizations, and alerting systems that empower sales and trading to detect shifts in client behavior, surface new sales opportunities, and pursue revenue optimization strategies.
 Success in this role demands a proactive individual who is comfortable facing off directly to traders and sales people, thrives in a fast-paced trading floor environment, and can react quickly to changes in market needs.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Pricing Optimization & Trading Analytics 
 Design, develop, and deploy models and tooling for pricing optimization and bid-offer spread calibration across APAC local rates products
 Investigate and apply modern machine learning techniques to improve client pricing accuracy, competitiveness, and profitability
 Build analytical solutions that strengthen trading risk management , including risk identification, hedging insight, and exposure monitoring
 Partner with rates traders to rapidly prototype, test, and refine pricing and risk models in response to evolving market conditions
 Dashboards, Visualization & Alerting 
 Build intuitive dashboards and visualizations for rates sales and trading to monitor client activity, pricing performance, and market dynamics
 Develop alerting systems that flag changes in client behavior, emerging sales opportunities, and other revenue optimization signals
 Translate complex data and model outputs into clear, actionable insights for a non-technical trading floor audience
 Iterate quickly on tooling based on direct feedback from the desk
 Generative AI & Machine Learning Solution Development 
 Design, develop, and deploy production-ready AI/ML applications leveraging generative AI techniques , including large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic frameworks
 Apply generative AI to enhance trading workflows, client pricing insight, research summarization, and desk automation
 Build intelligent automation to streamline repetitive trading and sales analytics tasks
 Implement guardrails, validation frameworks, and monitoring for deployed AI/ML models and applications
 Data Engineering & Integration 
 Design and build data pipelines to support analytics and ML workflows, integrating market data, trade data, and client activity data
 Develop robust ETL processes for preparing model inputs and maintaining curated datasets
 Leverage open-source frameworks such as Trino, Parquet, AWS S3, and Airflow to build scalable, high-performance data infrastructure
 Create APIs and services to integrate analytics and AI capabilities into existing trading and sales platforms
 Collaboration & Innovation 
 Partner directly with rates traders and sales people to identify high-impact use cases and deliver solutions at the speed the desk requires
 Collaborate with quantitative researchers to integrate AI/ML techniques into rates pricing and risk models
 Work with compliance and risk teams to ensure solutions meet regulatory and governance requirements
 Stay current with emerging AI/ML technologies and evaluate their applicability to Global Rates and APAC Local Markets needs
 Contribute to the firm's AI/ML community of practice and knowledge-sharing initiatives
 Required Qualifications 
 Education 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative field
 Strong academic foundation in algorithms, data structures, statistics, and software engineering principles
 Professional Experience 
 1–5 years of professional experience in AI/ML engineering, quantitative development, software development, or data science roles
 Demonstrated experience building and deploying production analytical or AI applications
 Proven track record of delivering end-to-end technical solutions, ideally in a fast-paced or front-office environment
 Technical Skills – Core Requirements 
 Generative AI & Machine Learning: 
 Strong grounding in statistics and modern machine learning techniques , with the ability to apply ML to real-world problems such as pricing, forecasting, anomaly detection, or behavioral analysis
 Hands-on experience with generative AI techniques and large language models (GPT, Claude, Llama, etc.)
 Practical experience implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems
 Experience with agentic frameworks and autonomous coding systems 
 Agentic Coding Tools: 
 Comfort and hands-on proficiency with agentic coding tools and AI-assisted development workflows (e.g., agentic IDEs and coding assistants) to accelerate delivery
 Ability to effectively orchestrate, review, and validate AI-generated code within a production-grade engineering process
 Programming & Development: 
 Strong proficiency in Python 
 Strong SQL skills
 Front-End Architecture (Beneficial): 
 Solid knowledge of front-end architecture and modern web development , including JavaScript, HTML/CSS , and a modern component framework such as Angular or React 
 Ability to design and build responsive, performant, and maintainable user interfaces for dashboards, visualizations, and alerting tools used on the trading floor
 Understanding of front-end architectural patterns — component-based design, state management, API/data integration, and reusable UI component libraries
 Experience with data-visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Plotly, Chart.js, or equivalent) to present complex trading and client data clearly and interactively
 Awareness of UX best practices for real-time, data-dense financial applications
 Data & Open-Source Frameworks (Beneficial): 
 Knowledge of open-source data frameworks: Trino, Parquet, AWS S3, and Airflow 
 Experience building and maintaining scalable data pipelines
 Domain Knowledge 
 Knowledge of financial markets is a major plus — particularly rates Sales & Trading, APAC local rates products, pricing, and trading risk management
 Key Attributes & Ways of Working 
 Proactive and self-directed — anticipates the needs of the desk and takes initiative
 Comfortable facing off directly to traders and sales people — able to communicate clearly and credibly with front-office stakeholders
 Fast and adaptable — reacts quickly to changing market needs and shifting priorities
 Commercially minded — understands how technical solutions translate into revenue and risk outcomes
 Collaborative — works effectively across trading, sales, quant, technology, and control functions

Working closely with data scientists, product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders, the Analyst will develop scalable analytical solutions that accelerate data-driven decision making while maintaining the highest standards of Responsible AI and model governance. 
 Shift Time: 1:30 pm - 9:30 pm (should be flexible to US timing's ) Degree in a quantitative field preferred, such as Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Finance, Economics, Statistics, or a related discipline. 
 1+ years of experience in data science, advanced analytics, machine learning, decision science, or related quantitative roles. 
 Strong programming skills in Python and SQL, with working knowledge of Hive and/or PySpark in large-scale data environments, hands-on experience developing machine learning models end-to-end, and familiarity with software engineering best practices including Git-based version control. 
 Demonstrated hands-on experience building or experimenting with LLM-based applications, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, semantic search, embeddings, structured outputs, or AI-powered assistants. 
 Knowledge of supervised machine learning techniques (e.g., gradient boosting, tree-based models, regression, clustering) and statistical techniques such as hypothesis testing, multivariate testing, ANOVA, and model evaluation methodologies. 
 Exposure to AI agent frameworks, tool/function calling, vector databases, LLM orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, DSPy), context management, or workflow automation is a plus. 
 Familiarity with modern ML/AI development frameworks, open-source libraries, prompt lifecycle management, and evaluation frameworks. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to execute well-defined analytical tasks accurately and efficiently. 
 Demonstrated ability to manage assigned work independently while collaborating effectively within a cross-functional team. 
 High attention to detail, intellectual curiosity, and an experimentation mindset with the ability to evaluate solutions objectively and iterate based on evidence. 
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain analytical findings and support stakeholder discussions. 
 Familiarity with Responsible AI principles, including explainability, bias and fairness assessment, hallucination mitigation, prompt safety, model monitoring, evaluation, audit readiness, and GenAI risk management practices. Execute analytical and data science solutions to solve business problems using statistical techniques, machine learning, and modern Generative AI approaches. 
 Develop, test, and maintain analytical models and AI-enabled data products—including predictive models, prospect scoring, prioritization, matching, enrichment, and intelligent decision-support capabilities—to improve targeting and acquisition effectiveness. 
 Design, build, and evaluate Generative AI workflows, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) , embedding-based retrieval , semantic search , prompt engineering , structured outputs , and LLM-powered applications, selecting appropriate approaches based on business requirements, solution quality, scalability, latency, cost, and governance considerations.

 Collaborate with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to support the implementation, deployment , monitoring , and continuous improvement of analytical and Generative AI solutions within business workflows. 
 Evaluate AI and GenAI solution performance using quantitative and qualitative evaluation techniques, including model performance metrics, retrieval quality, response accuracy, prompt robustness, business outcome measures, and production monitoring .

Role Overview
Mastercard is seeking a highly analytical and commercially minded professional to join the RAISE Value Quantification team within Strategy Pricing & Interchange. The ideal candidate will bring strong experience in predictive modeling, machine learning, pricing analytics, and data science, combined with the ability to influence commercial decisions. a. Design and build predictive models that quantify the economic, operational, and customer value of Mastercard products and services.

c. Translate model outputs into clear value stories, commercial insights, and business cases.

a. Develop value-based B2B pricing models, commercial frameworks, and analytical tools that support product pricing and go-to-market strategy.
b. Estimate adoption, revenue impact, customer economics, churn elasticity, and outcome-based scenarios.
c. Run pricing scenarios and sensitivity analyses to guide strategic trade-offs and executive decision-making.
3. Machine Learning & Advanced Analytics
a. Apply machine learning, statistical techniques, and advanced analytics to identify pricing opportunities, customer value drivers, and performance trends.

Must-Have Business & Pricing Skills

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to link data, insights, and business impact.
Must-Have Professional Skills

• Strong ownership mindset and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
• Curiosity, learning agility, and innovation mindset.

The team educates investors and prospects on our strategies through written answers to client questions, new business presentations, and review discussions of existing investments. Additionally, the team is involved in different stages of the investment process, including product development, performance monitoring and analysis.
