jobs.location: San Francisco, New York City, Seattle
jobs.description:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.  What you’ll do 
 About the internship 
 Stripe's Applied ML, Data Science, Risk, and Payments organizations are excited to offer Master's machine learning engineering internships for the summer of 2027. This is an exceptional opportunity to contribute to critical projects that directly enhance Stripe's suite of products, focusing on areas such as foundation models used for dozens of tasks e.g. fraud detection, enhanced support, and predicting user behavior.
 As an intern, you'll tackle challenging problems at the intersection of finance, technology, and data. You'll have the chance to work on creative projects like the Stripe Assistant and the Stripe Foundation Model, which leverage machine learning to revolutionize how businesses interact with financial services and data.
 Responsibilities 
 Develop and deploy large-scale machine learning systems that drive significant business value across various domains.
 Engage in the end-to-end process of designing, training, improving, and launching machine learning models.
 Write production-scale ML models that will be deployed to help Stripe enable economic infrastructure access for a diverse range of businesses globally.
 Collaborate across teams to incorporate feedback and proactively seek solutions to challenges.
 Rapidly learn new technologies and approaches, demonstrating a strong ability to ask insightful questions and communicate the status of your work effectively.
 Who you are 
 Minimum requirements 
 A deep understanding of computer science, obtained through the pursuit of a Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a closely related field, with the expectation of graduating in winter 2027 or spring/summer 2028.
 Practical experience with programming and machine learning, evidenced by projects, classwork, or research. Familiarity with languages such as Python, Scala, Spark and libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, and Scikit-learn.
 Expertise in areas of machine learning such as supervised and unsupervised learning techniques, ML operations, and possibly experience in Large Language Models or Reinforcement Learning.
 Demonstrated ability to work on collaborative projects, with experience in receiving and applying feedback from various stakeholders.
 A proactive approach to learning unfamiliar systems and a demonstrated ability to understand complex systems independently.
 Intent to return to the degree-program after the completion of the internship/co-op.
 Preferred qualifications 
 You Might Also Have:
 Two years of university education or equivalent experience, with in-depth knowledge in specific domains of machine learning.
 Published and presented peer-reviewed articles in top-tier venues.
 Experience in writing high-quality pull requests, maintaining good test coverage, and completing projects with minimal defects.
 Familiarity with navigating new codebases and managing work across different programming languages.
 Excellent written communication skills to clearly articulate your work to both team members and wider Stripe audiences.
 Application requirements 
 Please submit the following with your application:
 A detailed resume or LinkedIn profile showcasing your work history.
 Examples of relevant work and your approach to learning, such as GitHub repositories, StackOverflow contributions, or other project portfolios.
 Join us for an unforgettable summer internship and help shape the future of global commerce. At Stripe, you won't just be working on theoretical projects; you'll make a tangible impact on the world's economic infrastructure.

We craft the creative vision and strategy for different types of projects and audiences, and amplify them across various mediums, channels, objects to environments, and digital and physical experiences.
 The Stripe brand identity team is responsible for defining and evolving Stripe’s visual identity, and bringing the Stripe brand to life in new and impactful ways across surfaces. Our goal is to enable the creation of a coherent, high quality brand experience across the user journey, building recognition and trust in Stripe at every turn. We collaborate with other design systems teams to translate our brand for Stripe.com and Dashboard, and partner with teams across the company on high impact user-facing projects to create work that feels authentic to Stripe at scale.
 What you’ll do 
 3d illustrator/animators at Stripe demonstrate passion for great design and for expanding, evolving, defining, and documenting flexible illustration systems that achieve bar-raising quality and consistency for the brand at scale. The ideal candidate excels at delivering on brand 3d illustration from conception, to 3d modeling, and all the way to motion. They have a deep understanding of visual storytelling, iterate quickly, and collaborate seamlessly with marketers, product managers, leaders, other designers, and agency partners.
 Responsibilities 
 Work across the Stripe brand ecosystem to develop, establish and create illustration and motion styles in close partnership with brand, product design, and marketing.
 Create photo-realistic 3d compositions that tell editorial stories in static and motion and a variety of advertising surfaces from billboards to video.
 Champion and influence how the Stripe brands expresses itself through image and motion and develop guidelines, systems, and processes to ensure quality and consistency at scale.
 Work collaboratively with non-motion designers, elevating and informing each others’ work.
 Oversee quality and consistency of 3d illustration/motion and how it is used to express our brand—from product, to advertising campaigns and events.
 Oversee the work of external teams in creative strategy, execution, and production.
 Collaborate with designers, researchers, product managers, marketers, and other cross-functional partners to serve a global audience.
 Inspire, create and sustain a culture of excellence by expanding and evolving our best practices, design process, and ideation.
 Stay curious and experimental as an avid maker, obsessed with tinkering and tool building with AI to create beautiful things
 Shape a strategic vision that pushes brand boundaries and builds internal awareness of design’s impact at Stripe
 Who you are 
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
 Minimum requirements 
 6+ years of relevant design and art direction experience for technical and product-driven companies.
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in art, or equivalent professional experience.
 Have a strong strategic acumen for building leading brands in a fast-paced, global facing environment.
 Are a systems-thinker and excel at extrapolating and extending shared patterns and behaviors.
 Proven excellence in effective art direction, and building and extending 3d illustration systems.
 Have proven track record of using and building AI tools to create exceptional work in new ways
 Have the ability to express and communicate a brand through distinct graphics, patterns, motion, interaction, and video.
 Can effectively communicate concepts, direction and decisions with the team and with external partners.
 Strong track record independently delivering work as well as collaborating with and influencing the work of other designers, contractors, and agencies.
 Preferred qualifications 
 Find a meaningful balance between optimizing for speed, quality, and doing risky, interesting, pixel-perfect work.
 Are persuasive and humble in explaining your work, process, and decisions and crave feedback to help you design at your best.
 Love working with other designers to help them learn and grow—and have them help you learn and grow.

 About the team 
 The Procurement team provides services to the businesses that are the backbone of Stripe. Stripe’s broader Procurement organization consists of Third Party Risk, Strategic Sourcing, Supplier Deal Management (Procurement Contracting), Procurement Enablement, Accounts Payable, and Travel and Expense.
 Our Procurement Contracting function, Supplier Deal Management (SDM), builds an efficient supplier contracting process, reduces friction for business leaders, works in partnership with Third Party Risk and Legal to minimize risk, and increases the speed at which Stripe can engage key suppliers.
 SDM’s mission is to drive agreements efficiently through appropriate channels, bringing structure to the overall contracting process in partnership with stakeholders while providing a customized and guided user experience and effectively managing value and risk for Stripe.
 What you’ll do 
 Reporting to the Head of SDM and working closely with SDM Leads, you’ll support the supplier contracting process, from answering initial questions and reviewing use cases to negotiating commercial terms and supporting contract lifecycle management.
 Responsibilities   
 Answer initial questions and educate directly responsible individuals (DRIs) on the overall risk assessment and supplier contracting process
 Conduct an initial review of DRI-provided use cases and appropriate contractual terms, or assemble appropriate Stripe templates, and prepare agreements for legal review according to defined guidelines when necessary
 Review and negotiate commercial terms in supplier agreements when needed
 Monitor productivity and communication with DRIs using our procurement tool, Zip
 Engage internal stakeholders, including Legal, Sourcing, Third Party Risk, and Stripe DRIs, to understand their needs and translate them into a risk-balanced approach to preparing contracts using training and existing frameworks
 Manage engagements within our procurement system, Zip, and contract lifecycle management system, Ironclad, and support end-to-end contract lifecycle management
 Partner with respective internal teams to resolve business inquiries and troubleshoot issues related to contracting

 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
 Minimum requirements 
 8 years of professional experience in contracting within procurement, legal operations, or another commercial deal negotiation capacity
 Demonstrated ability to understand commercial and legal language commonly used in commercial contracts, ease in reviewing and drafting contractual language, and experience negotiating contracts and partnering effectively with legal teams
 A solution-oriented mindset with enthusiasm for establishing contracting best practices, the ability to earn trust quickly and deliver value for a critical, fast-paced function involving multiple stakeholders, and the ability to support opinions with sound reasoning
 Flexibility and comfort with changing requirements in a high-volume environment, meticulous attention to detail, and a rigorous decision-making process
 Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to represent Stripe effectively when interacting with stakeholders
 Preferred qualifications 
 Broad contracting experience across a range of common categories, such as technology, marketing, workplace, and services
 Understanding of or experience with e-procurement tools and contract lifecycle management systems, such as Zip and Ironclad
 Familiarity with the fintech industry and its supply chain and procurement challenges
 A builder’s mindset and a willingness to question assumptions and conventional wisdom

 Stripe Terminal helps our users extend their online presence to the physical world. With Terminal, businesses can unlock in-person payment use cases that fit their business model, whether that’s creating a superb retail experience, extending their website to a pop-up store, or enabling a mobile point of sale at their next event.
 Terminal is one of the fastest-growing products at Stripe, and we are building a uniquely powerful unified commerce platform for global enterprises. The platform offers a single integration for in-person payments, fast and low-cost cross-border money movement, AI-powered optimizations and fraud protection, reporting, and differentiated ways to pay.
 What you’ll do
 As the product manager responsible for enterprise success within Terminal Payments, you’ll deliver an end-to-end payments and commerce platform for enterprise users. You’ll work directly with users and partners to understand their needs, identify investments that serve multiple businesses, and turn those opportunities into products and integrations.
 Responsibilities
 Set a multi-year strategy for Terminal’s enterprise payments capabilities, build alignment, and translate that strategy into roadmaps and measurable objectives and key results

 Build integrations that expand Terminal’s enterprise capabilities, including gift cards, private-label credit cards, tax refunds, and third-party point-of-sale systems

 Recruit, develop and lead a team of product sales executives focused on expansion and retention of our largest Billing Users
 Create go-to-market plans and solutions to meet our customer needs, in collaboration with Product, Sales, Finance and Marketing stakeholders.
 Manage day-to-day operations, with a focus on performance against key sales metrics.
 Be accountable for driving revenue, increasing attach rates, and new client acquisition at high rates of growth.
 Coach and guide the team in developing consultative and solution-based sales skills through all facets of the sales cycle.
 Get hands on engaged in the largest, most strategic opportunities, leading executive relationships and helping the team win new customers.
 Inspire, motivate, and enable individual development to promote career growth of direct reports.
 Lead with clarity and context with a compelling plan in line with Stripe’s direction.
 Create structure and focus for GTM ideas and product sales campaigns that the product team is exploring. Drive execution and measurement. Analyse results and make recommendations for action in a timely manner.
 Constantly innovate and improve programs and program management mechanisms, suggesting new ideas, sharing best practices, and improving the business and customer engagement model.
 Who you are 
 You are an adept sales leader, capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization. You have a reputation and drive for building strategic relationships with executives (CEO, CFO, and CTO) across the AMER region, including core markets like NA, CA, and LATAM. You excel in building clear plans to grow a region through a high-functioning sales team, with strategic thought leadership and strong management. You see value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require both deep product understanding and technical knowledge, especially for AI industry users. You’re as comfortable working with clients as with internal stakeholders (including executives) and are excited to become an expert and share your knowledge. You possess an organized, self-starter mindset and excellent communication skills, with a track record for improving the processes and organizations around you.
 Minimum requirements 
 10+ years of sales leadership experience, launching and growing high-functioning sales teams/products.
 20+ years of experience in hyper-growth SaaS environments across the AMER region.
 Industry experience in finance, revenue management, financial services, or similar software services.
 Proven ability to be a self-starter, capable of driving business results without significant supervision.
 Ability to understand complex technical requirements and craft solutions across multiple stakeholders.
 An enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves” mentality.
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
 Strong presentation skills, particularly for in-person meetings with multiple stakeholders.
 Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke agreements with startup, SMB, and Commercial businesses.

jobs.title: Startup Products Strategy & Operations, Insights & Analytics
jobs.description:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team 
 The Startup Products team builds Stripe Atlas and other products that help founders start and run a company, from anywhere in the world. We believe that startups are one of the most effective ways to solve the world's problems, and we want to give founders a running start — and keep them running. We help founders form their company, raise capital, execute critical legal agreements, access the internet's best tools, and automate operations while feeling ambitious, smart, and assured. Our goal is to create more startups that get to product-market fit, fast.
 Our team is composed of high-agency, high-ownership product thinkers, who genuinely care about helping founders and making it easier to start and run a startup. Every person on the team is responsible for making our product the best it can be, and for ensuring our roadmap contains the highest impact ships for founders.
 What you’ll do 
 As a Strategy & Operations team member on the Startup Products team, you’ll help us understand and talk about the startups that use our products, turning data into clear internal and external narratives, and use analysis to shape strategy and product priorities. You’ll own high-signal metrics and dashboards while also leading deep dives that explain what is changing, why it matters, and what we should do next.
 Responsibilities 
 Delve into the data to glean new insights about how users use our products and how they are building their businesses on Stripe
 Package insights into external-facing content, driving our public storytelling about our users and the startup market, in partnership with marketing and communications.
 Analyze product performance, identify trends and anomalies, diagnose drivers, and translate findings into concrete recommendations and synthesis to share with internal stakeholders.
 Lead analytical deep dives on strategic questions, new product opportunities, founder segments, growth drivers, and the impact of launches or operational changes.
 Contribute to product and business strategy by sizing opportunities, testing assumptions, evaluating tradeoffs, and helping prioritize the roadmap.
 Help us build and maintain a streamlined set of internal dashboards to help us understand user behavior and product usage.
 Who you are 
 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
 Minimum requirements 
 5+ years of experience in strategy and operations, business analytics, management consulting, or another highly analytical role in a technology company.
 Strong analytical judgment, including the ability to choose the right methodology, pressure-test results, and distinguish signal from noise.
 A creative and collaborative approach to finding new insights in data.
 Excellent written communication skills, and the ability to package data into easy to understand content.
 High agency and extreme attention to detail.
 Preferred qualifications 
 Experience with startups, founders, company formation, fintech, or products serving small and early-stage businesses.
 Experience conducting or applying user research, shaping product roadmaps, or bringing new products from 0→1.
 Experience using AI tools to simplify and speed up your work.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Developer Experience
jobs.location: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
jobs.description:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.
 About the role 
 More and more of our engineering work now runs through autonomous agents, and those agents can only be as effective as the tools, context, and codebase around them. As a Developer Experience Engineer, you'll build the tooling and agent workflows that let humans and agents change our largest monorepos quickly and safely.
 You'll own the interfaces engineers use to observe, steer, and give context to the agents working on our code. You'll also build the guardrails that keep complexity in check as those agents take on bigger changes. Large-scale work like framework upgrades, language migrations, and dependency health is still part of the job, but you'll do it by building and steering agents rather than making the changes by hand. This is a high-leverage role. Every improvement you ship multiplies across the whole engineering organization.
 What you’ll do 
 Build and ship the tools engineers and their agents use every day, such as CLIs, desktop integrations, and interfaces for observing, unblocking, and steering autonomous agents, and own their adoption, distribution, and support
 Design and evolve agentic loops (the plan, act, verify, and iterate cycles) and the harnesses, skills, and context that let agents do real engineering work reliably
 Build agent workflows that drive large-scale changes across the codebase, including framework upgrades, language migrations, and dependency updates, with minimal disruption to product teams
 Build the guardrails, tests, and automation that make large, agent-authored changes safe to land, and track the leading indicators of growing complexity
 Find friction in the development workflow for both humans and agents, and fix the root causes
 Partner with builders inside and outside of engineering to understand their pain points, and measure the adoption and impact of what you ship
 Set technical direction and mentor other engineers on agent design, tooling, and codebase health
 What we’re looking for 
 We care more about what you've done than about which specific technologies you used to do it.
 Required 
 Shipping developer tooling at scale: You've shipped tools that engineers use daily, such as CLIs, desktop integrations, configuration management, or internal platforms. You understand what it takes to drive adoption, debug problems, and support users.
 Scaling work with agents: You've built agent workflows that finished work that would normally take a team weeks. Examples include generating codebase summaries or world models, writing skills and loops, or orchestrating a team of semi-deterministic agents. You have a deep understanding of agentic loops (tool use, context management, verification, failure handling) and are eager to keep evolving them as the field changes.
 Evolving frameworks and large codebases: You have deep experience with application or platform frameworks, including upgrading them and managing their evolution over time. You also have a track record of leading migrations or large refactors from planning through rollout.
 Significant experience (typically 10+ years for Staff, 7+ for Senior) working in large, complex codebases
 Strong communication skills and the ability to build trust with teams by owning the outcomes of your work
 Nice to have 
 Experience with harness engineering or context engineering
 Experience with agent observability, for example through OpenTelemetry
 Experience distributing internal tools (versioning, release channels, auto-update) and measuring adoption with telemetry or surveys
 Background in developer productivity metrics, test infrastructure, or CI/CD
 A passion for intuitive user experience and good taste in elegant solutions
 Open source contributions to developer tooling or agent frameworks
 Block takes a market-based approach to pay, and pay may vary depending on your location. U.S. locations are categorized into one of four zones based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. The successful candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future.
 To find a location’s zone designation, please refer to this  resource . If a location of interest is not listed, please speak with a recruiter for additional information.

 $217,800 — $326,800 USD 
 Zone B: 
 $207,000 — $310,400 USD 
 Zone C:
 $196,100 — $294,100 USD 
 Zone D:
 $185,200 — $277,800 USD 
 Application Guidelines 
 Candidates may submit up to 9 active applications within a 60-day period. Reapplications to the same role are accepted 90 days after a previous application has been reviewed.
 Use of AI in Our Hiring Process 
 We may use automated AI tools to evaluate job applications for efficiency and consistency. These tools comply with local regulations, including bias audits, and we handle all personal data in accordance with state and local privacy laws. 
 Contact us here  with hiring practice or data usage questions.
 Every benefit we offer is designed with one goal: empowering you to do the best work of your career while building the life you want. Remote work, medical insurance, flexible time off, retirement savings plans, and modern family planning are just some of our offering.  Check out our other benefits at Block.

Each of our brands unlocks different aspects of the economy for more people.  Square  makes commerce and financial services accessible to sellers.  Cash App  is the easy way to spend, send, and store money.  Afterpay  is transforming the way customers manage their spending over time.  TIDAL  is a music platform that empowers artists to thrive as entrepreneurs.  Bitkey  is a simple self-custody wallet built for bitcoin.  Proto  is a suite of bitcoin mining products and services.  Act as a consultant and trusted advisor — seamlessly flexing across BDR, AE, and AM responsibilities when needed.
 Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Implementation, and Operations to deliver cohesive solutions.
 Maintain disciplined pipeline management and forecasting accuracy in Salesforce.
 Consistently hit and exceed revenue goals — monthly and quarterly.
 You Have 
 1-2 years of full-cycle B2B sales experience with consistent quota achievement.
 Proven success in outbound prospecting and net-new business creation (SaaS or fintech preferred).
 Experience closing complex, multi-threaded deals  
 Ability to build pipeline from scratch using targeted, strategic outreach.
 Exceptional communication, presentation, and negotiation skills across phone, video, and written channels.
 Strong consultative selling skills — diagnose business challenges and map tailored solutions.
 A hunter’s mindset — resilient, creative, and driven to win.
 Ability to work independently while contributing to a team-first environment.
 Advanced proficiency with Salesforce and modern sales tools.
 BA/BS degree or equivalent experience .

 Lead your market with disciplined, in-person execution

jobs.title: Compensation Analyst II (Programs & Partnerships)
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
 About the People Team  
 The People team helps Affirmers cultivate a high-performing, inclusive organization. We focus on three core areas: attracting talent aligned to our mission, enabling growth through people and team development, and retaining employees through thoughtful experiences and rewards. We develop Affirm’s people programs and systems to create a workplace where all employees can thrive and contribute meaningfully. By investing in our people, we create a long-term advantage for the business.
 About the Role 
 The Compensation Programs & Partnerships (P&P) team designs, executes, and maintains some of the people programs and partnerships that enables Affirm to provide thoughtful experiences and rewards to Affirmers. We are seeking a detail oriented, collaborative Compensation Analyst who is passionate about delivering compensation programs and partnerships that helps drive Affirm’s success. In this role, you will report to the Senior Manager of Compensation and work closely with the Senior Manager and broader Compensation team to strategize, build, refine, maintain, and implement various programs and initiatives. You will also work closely with the team to help provide partnership and support for the Technology and Business functions as well as other cross functional partner groups. 
 What You’ll Do 
 Lead the end to end project management of the mid-year and annual compensation cycles in close alignment with the Compensation team and other key People team partners including: proactive and ongoing project planning, creating timelines, building training / enablement resources, facilitating project meetings, creating communications, and providing ad-hoc support during the cycles.
 Leverage existing tools and sources (such as Sigma Dashboards, the Radford Global Compensation Database, and Pave) to provide team ad-hoc compensation analyses and story-building support, translating data elements into sound recommendations and insightful presentations. This could include conducting robust research to prepare analyses on actual vs. market pay positioning, leveling distributions vs. market practices, offer and candidate trends, retention risk, spans / layers, or other workforce related priorities. 
 Partner with the Compensation Programs & Partnerships team to provide ongoing partnership support for various business related initiatives across Affirm’s Technology and Business functions.
 Partner with the Senior Incentive Compensation Manager to provide operational support for the incentive compensation design process (which can include coordinating kickoff meetings, facilitating focus group feedback sessions with leaders, creating and / or updating incentive plan documents). 
 Engage in ongoing processes and special projects to refine and uphold Compensation’s programmatic frameworks.
 Serve as subject matter expert, alongside other compensation team partners, to provide education and consultation to stakeholders on our compensation structure, guidance, and various compensation programs.
 Maintain our standard job architecture catalog in Workday and internal team documents.
 May participate in sessions with external survey companies (such as AON) to stay up to date on market trends and share insights that can help the team maintain competitive rewards structures and programs.
 What We Look For 
 5+ years of experience in compensation with the ability to demonstrate an understanding of core compensation concepts and programs.
 Experience with leading and managing projects from start to finish using a standard project management lifecycle approach.
 Strong team orientation with the ability to work effectively and collaboratively across the internal team and cross functional partners.
 Strong relationship management skills with the proven ability to consult, influence, and maintain positive relationships with business stakeholders.
 Passion for working with data elements and compiling analysis to “tell the story” and create solutions. Proficient with Google Sheets and Google Slides.
 Someone who can pay close attention to detail with the ability to multitask across several deliverables at the same time while maintaining a proactive approach to work assignments in a fast paced environment. 
 Ability to be flexible and adapt to using different methods by embracing innovation and experimentation.
 Experience working within the technology industry is a plus.
 Pay Grade - I 
Equity Grade - 4 
 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).
 CAN base pay range per year:  $89,000  -  $139,000 
 This posting is for an existing vacancy.

All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

 Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

 As a Manager of Sales Engineering, you’ll combine your People Come First leadership, technical depth, and communication skills to help enterprise merchant partners evaluate and integrate Affirm. You will lead and develop a team of Sales Engineers while actively participating in deals, guiding integration decisions, and building relationships with merchants’ technical and business leaders.
 You’ll develop a deep working knowledge of Affirm’s products and integration solutions, participate in and lead technical sales calls, and provide hands-on support when the team needs coverage or additional technical leadership. You’ll also strengthen the team’s ability to build, test, and troubleshoot integrations in sandbox environments, grounding merchant recommendations in practical experience.
 Sales Engineers are part of the Partner Engineering team and work closely with Affirm’s Revenue, Engineering, and Product teams. Together, you’ll solve merchant integration challenges, identify product enhancements, and build internal processes that scale.
 What you’ll do 
 Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Sales Engineers, setting clear expectations for technical proficiency, merchant engagement, and performance.
 Actively participate in deals alongside your team, supporting live technical discovery, integration discussions, and solution presentations.
 Partner with merchant technical and business leaders when an opportunity requires leadership involvement.
 Develop and maintain deep working knowledge of Affirm’s products, APIs, and integration options so you can evaluate solutions, explain tradeoffs, and help resolve technical blockers.
 Build, test, and troubleshoot integrations in sandbox or simulated merchant environments, and coach the team to develop the same practical capabilities.
 Use AI development tools in your own technical work and coach the team to apply them effectively when building prototypes, developing integrations, and testing solutions, with accountability for the quality and correctness of the resulting code.
 Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and Revenue to design effective merchant solutions, address integration gaps, and win new business.
 Translate merchant requirements and recurring technical challenges into actionable product feedback and improvements to internal processes.
 Create a respectful, supportive environment where diverse perspectives contribute to better decisions and team members receive clear feedback and opportunities to grow.
 What we look for 
 Passion and drive to change consumer banking for the better.
 BA/BS degree in business or technology.
 4–6+ years of experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a comparable customer-facing technical role, and 3–4 years of people management experience.
 A track record of developing technical talent, setting clear expectations, and holding teams accountable for results.
 Demonstrated ability and willingness to stay hands-on while managing a team, including personally leading technical customer conversations and helping advance deals.
 Practical experience building, testing, and troubleshooting API-based integrations, with proficiency in at least one programming language.

 Excellent communication skills, with the ability to build credibility with developers, business stakeholders, and senior leaders.

jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
 About the InfoSec team 
At Affirm, security is integral to our mission of building honest financial products and driving the company’s long-term success. The Security Operations and Resilience Engineering (SOR) program is the foundation of our prevention, detection, and response capabilities, helping safeguard Affirm’s assets and enterprise security ecosystem. As part of our Security Team, you’ll join a group of passionate, highly skilled professionals redefining fintech security through collaboration, innovation, and a team-first mindset.
 About the role 
We’re seeking an experienced security leader to lead Affirm’s global security investigations and incident response program as we expand internationally. This leader will guide complex investigations and incidents while building the operating practices, readiness, and technical capabilities needed to support consistent response across regions and scale with the business.
 In this role, you’ll lead a technically deep, engineering-oriented team that manages major incidents and builds better response capabilities. You’ll direct complex investigations while staying close to the technical work, bring structure to ambiguity, guide responders and executives through critical decisions, and turn incident findings into durable engineering improvements. You’ll also help shape AI-enabled investigation workflows, including agentic approaches to evidence gathering, analysis, and coordination, with human oversight and clear security, privacy, and operational safeguards.
 What you’ll do 
 Lead security incidents and investigations across the full lifecycle, from initial assessment through containment, remediation, recovery, and post-incident review.
 Serve as incident commander for major security events, set clear roles and decision paths, and coordinate large technical and cross-functional response groups through ambiguity.
 Guide technical investigations and root-cause analyses with engineering teams, validate fixes, and drive durable corrective actions across the business.
 Manage and develop a technical, engineering-oriented response team, set priorities, coach engineers, and build incident command depth and consistent execution across regions.
 Set operating objectives and global readiness practices, including playbooks, escalation paths, exercises, on-call readiness, postmortems, and measures of response effectiveness.
 Drive engineering improvements to response tooling, security telemetry, detection, and automation, including agentic AI workflows that support investigation and analysis with appropriate human oversight and security and privacy safeguards.
 Translate complex security and incident metrics into actionable executive dashboards and board-level risk reporting, surfacing trends and remediation priorities that drive cross-functional action.
 What we look for 
 10+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, or a related security field.
 Proven ability to lead major security incidents and investigations in technology-driven, cloud-native environments, from detection and assessment through containment, remediation, and recovery.
 Strong technical foundation in security operations, with depth in investigations, incident response, detection, root-cause analysis, and/or digital forensics across cloud and enterprise environments. Experience in fintech or payments, and familiarity with using threat intelligence to inform response, are nice to have.
 Experience managing and developing technical or engineering teams, setting direction and priorities, coaching engineers, and guiding hands-on incident work alongside engineering improvements.
 Track record of building scalable response capabilities through repeatable practices, on-call readiness, exercises, postmortems, operational measures, and security tooling such as SIEM, EDR, or SOAR.
 Excellent written and verbal communication, including translating complex incidents, security metrics, and customer or business impact into clear executive updates and board-level reporting, and aligning cross-functional partners.
 Demonstrated ability to independently move ambiguous work forward, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and drive investigations, remediation, and program improvements to completion with measurable results.
 An AI-forward mindset and sound judgment in applying AI to security operations, including agentic investigation or automation workflows with human oversight and appropriate security, privacy, and operational safeguards.

jobs.description:

We pride ourselves on our culture across engineering of engaging in thorough technical design review, operational excellence, and capable incident response and analysis.
 The Compute Platform team owns the EKS foundation that Affirm's products run on, from cluster provisioning and lifecycle through the safety standards that keep thousands of workloads reliable at scale. Affirm operates 90+ EKS clusters across environments and regions, and this team is responsible for making that fleet standardized, automated, observable, and self-healing, while establishing and enforcing the workload configuration standards that protect availability. Our mission is to provide a secure, reliable, and scalable Kubernetes platform that lets infrastructure and application teams deploy and operate with confidence and minimal operational friction.
 What you’ll do 
 As a member of the Compute Platform organization, you will collaborate with other teams - including Product, Infrastructure, Traffic, Cost & Capacity Engineering to:
 Architect and evolve Affirm's EKS platform, driving strategy across cluster lifecycle, node management, and shared cluster components

 Own the reliability of core shared components across the fleet (Karpenter, CoreDNS, VPC CNI, Kube Proxy, Metrics Server, etc) and the CI/CD pipeline that ships them consistently

 Mentor engineers across the Compute Platform teams and set the bar for operational excellence

 Deep EKS and Kubernetes internals expertise, including cluster upgrades, node lifecycle, scheduling, and autoscaling (Karpenter, Cluster Autoscaler)

 Experience designing and enforcing platform standards through policy (admission control, OPA/Gatekeeper or equivalent) and automated frameworks
 Infrastructure as Code fluency with Terraform and a GitOps or pipeline-driven delivery model (ArgoCD, kube-applier, or similar)
 Observability instincts: defining SLOs, building metrics, logs, and alerting coverage, and running data-driven baseline audits

 Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Spacelift a plus) and GitOps-style deployment pipelines
 Expert-level proficiency in Go or Python and a proven track record building production-grade Kubernetes controllers, operators, and platform tooling that other engineering teams depend on
 Track record designing and enforcing standards across many teams without becoming a bottleneck
 Exceptional problem-solving and systems-thinking skills
 Demonstrated leadership and cross-functional influence

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend (Observability)
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
 The Observability team builds the platform every Affirm engineer relies on to understand the behavior and performance of our systems. Our platform ingests 200+ TB/day of metrics, logs, and traces from hundreds of services across 80+ Kubernetes clusters, and when a user's checkout fails, our data is how engineers find out why. Over the next year, we’re moving to wide events, with one context-rich event per request, improving the signal-to-noise ratio to make debugging faster. We’re also introducing log sampling and building observability best practices into agentic development and code review, so that AI-assisted code is well instrumented by default.
 We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to be the technical lead for Observability. You’ll spend most of your time hands-on while defining the roadmap, driving cross-functional projects, mentoring a team of six engineers, and partnering closely with infrastructure and product teams.
 What You'll Do 
· You will own the architecture of Affirm’s telemetry pipeline, balancing reliability, query performance, and cost at 200+ TB/day.
· You will design log sampling strategies that significantly reduce volume and cost without losing the signal engineers need during incidents.
· You will shape how observability fits into agentic development, so that AI coding agents and code review catch instrumentation gaps before code ships.
· You will be responsible for setting technical strategy for your team on a year-long time scale, and help your team tie it together with critical, business-impacting projects.
· You will collaborate across teams in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics to ensure technical sustainability, risks and trade-offs are well understood and managed.
· You will act as a force-multiplier for your team through your definition and advocacy of technical solutions and operational processes.
· You take ownership of your team’s operations and availability by ensuring you have the right monitoring, triage rotations, playbooks, polcities, testing and alerting in place to support “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
· You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.
· You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.
 What We Look For 
· You have 8+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.
· You have an extensive track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL, Flink and Kubernetes.
· You have built or operated high-volume telemetry systems (metrics, logs, and/or traces) using technologies like OpenTelemetry, Kafka, and Terraform.
· You have a well-informed point of view on modern observability practices such as structured and wide events, sampling, cardinality management, and SLOs.
· You have driven adoption of a platform standard across many engineering teams, through both tooling and engagement.
· You have experience delivering major features, system components or deprecating existing functionality in a system through the definition of a technical and execution plan. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
· You thrive in ambiguity, and are comfortable moving from low level language idioms all the way to the architecture of large systems to understand how they work.
· Your growth and impact trajectory demonstrates that you have mastered gathering and iterating on feedback from your engineering and cross-functional peers.
· You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.

 This is a high-visibility opportunity to own the health, evolution, and strategic value of a member operations ecosystem at Chime's only onshore customer operations center. 
 You will lead as one part Operator (running the operations with rigor), one part Strategist (improving the operations by challenging what exists), and one part Influencer (informing the business by turning frontline signals into company decisions). The role carries real executive presence: you'll be the person in the room translating what's happening on the frontline into decisions senior leaders act on. This is an on-site role (location TBD -  Austin, San Antonio) — you'll be embedded with the operation you own, not managing it from a distance, and you'll serve as a cultural ambassador for Chime within the partnership (BPO) and a highly effective motivator of front line staff. You will play a hands-on role in daily partner governance, business reviews, escalation management, and operational initiatives that improve frontline execution and member outcomes. 
 In this role, you can expect to 
 Run the Operations 
 Own performance governance for assigned Partner/BPO operations, including SLAs, quality, productivity, staffing adherence, operational efficiency, and member experience outcomes. 
 Lead daily, weekly, and monthly partner performance reviews with clear metrics, action plans, owners, timelines, and expected business impact.

 Challenge existing processes, technology, staffing models, and site/channel strategy rather than optimizing within them. 
 Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives that improve member and service experience, from problem definition and stakeholder alignment through execution, change management, and post-launch measurement. 
 Identify automation and AI opportunities within the partner operation, and help redesign the operating model as routine volume shifts to AI Agents. 
 Influence the Business  
 Operate with a level of entrepreneurship and ownership consistent with running a business unit, not administering a contract. 
 Translate operational performance trends into root-cause insights, risk assessments, and data-backed recommendations. 
 Develop concise, executive-ready updates that connect frontline performance, member impact, risks, tradeoffs, and recommended next steps — with a point of view. 
 Build the Chime Culture Onsite 
 Establish and sustain a shared Chime culture in our onshore BPO partner location. 
 Partner with Chime and BPO leaders to translate Chime’s values—including member obsession and financial peace of mind—into observable behaviors, coaching expectations, hiring standards, and recognition programs.

 10+ years of experience in leading on site Customer Experience operations, Partner/Vendor Management, BPO operations, or a related operational leadership role, ideally within financial services or another highly regulated environment.

 The role: 
 We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to own the long-term networking vision for all of SoFi. SoFi runs almost entirely in AWS, and every member interaction, from opening the app to moving money, travels over the cloud networks this role will shape: the internet edge, DNS, CDN and WAF, load balancing and ingress, VPC and multi-account connectivity, service-to-service traffic, and connectivity to our partners. You will sit on the Cloud Platform team, but your scope and impact are company-wide.
 You will define the north-star cloud network architecture and the multi-year path to get there. That includes multi-region and multi-cluster traffic management, incremental rollout and progressive delivery at the network layer, and a network that is resilient, secure, and fast for our members. You will also guide the strategy for our small on-premises colocation footprint, including how it connects to the cloud. You will identify the hard problems others miss, make the critical tradeoffs, and lead them from idea through execution.
 You will lead how we use AI to run networking and infrastructure. We are moving toward an AI-accelerated SDLC for infrastructure, and you will design and build the automation, agentic workflows, and guardrails that let us change the network faster and more safely, and help other infrastructure teams do the same.
 This is a hands-on, high-influence role. You will partner with engineering, security, risk and compliance, SRE, architecture, and business leaders across SoFi and its technology platform businesses. Your partnership with Security and Compliance is especially important: you will help shape the network policies and standards that govern how SoFi's network is built and changed, and make sure they are practical to implement and automate. Beyond networking, you will bring enough depth in compute, Kubernetes, identity, and infrastructure as code to give strategic guidance and feedback across the broader Cloud Platform.
 The ideal candidate is a recognized networking expert and a mentor who is equally comfortable writing the design doc, reviewing the code, and leading the incident bridge. They have a solid sense of ownership and can explain a hard tradeoff to engineers and executives alike.

 Network strategy and architecture: Own the long-term technical vision for networking across SoFi, defining a north-star architecture and an incremental, multi-year roadmap. Lead the architecture of member-facing networking. Design multi-region and multi-cluster networking. Enable incremental rollout and progressive delivery. Set direction for service-to-service and multi-account connectivity. Drive network automation end to end.
 AI and automation: Lead the use of AI to design, operate, and change networks and infrastructure. Define the guardrails, policy checks, and success criteria that make AI-guided infrastructure changes safe in a regulated environment.  Leadership and influence: Serve as a strategic technical advisor to Infrastructure and Technology leadership on networking, influencing roadmaps, investment, and vendor and build-versus-buy choices. Champion AI adoption across infrastructure. Lead design reviews for network-impacting changes, driving clear outcomes on one-way doors. Be the technical partner to Security, Compliance, and Risk on network policies and standards.
 Operational excellence: Be the subject matter expert and lead resolver for company-critical network incidents. Define SLOs and outcome metrics for networking, such as member-facing latency, availability, and change lead time. Build observability into the network so we detect issues before our members and partners do.
 Mentorship and talent: Mentor Staff and Senior Staff engineers and emerging technical leaders. Raise the bar for design and code review.
 What you’ll need: 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
 10+ years of professional engineering experience, including 2+ years in a senior technical leadership role (Staff or above) with company-wide or multi-department scope.

jobs.title: Economist, Macro & Economic Insights
jobs.location: San Francisco HQ; New York City Office
jobs.description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.



The Economics Team uses economic research and data science to deepen our understanding of economic, credit, and financial trends. We combine rigorous empirical analysis with clear communication to inform decisions across and beyond Plaid.



You will conduct applied economic research, develop reliable analytical methods, and turn complex findings into clear, useful insights. Working with economists and data scientists, you will own research projects from question framing and data preparation through validation and written communication. This is a hands-on role for an economist who enjoys working with large datasets, exercising sound judgment, and explaining evidence and limitations to a range of audiences. You will have opportunities to develop a research specialty and take on broader ownership as the team grows.



We're guided by our principles including impact, growing together, embracing openness and positivity, and inventing tomorrow; we're looking for leaders who are motivated by those same principles






Responsibilities

 - Investigating economic questions and trends through rigorous empirical research, from framing the question through analysis, validation, and communication

 - Working with large, complex datasets to develop reliable measures and reproducible analytical workflows

 - Evaluating findings against established research and public benchmarks, assessing data quality and representativeness, and clearly communicating uncertainty and limitations

 - Applying econometric and time-series methods to test hypotheses, assess robustness, and distinguish meaningful patterns from noise

 - Writing clear research briefs and presenting findings to technical and nontechnical audiences; partnering with colleagues across research, data science, and the business to identify useful questions and inform decisions






Qualifications

jobs.description:
About the team

Plaid’s Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team enables the business by proactively managing information security risk and maintaining effective controls. We partner across the company to keep Plaid’s platform secure, resilient, and aligned with industry and regulatory expectations.

Our assurance program builds trust with customers, consumers, and data partners. Core compliance is how we prove it. We run the certifications, audits, and regulatory obligations that let banks, customers, and regulators rely on Plaid, and we keep them aligned with a product that keeps changing.



About the role

As Security Compliance Lead, you’ll be the single accountable owner of Plaid’s core security compliance program: SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, and their governance obligations. Banks, enterprise customers, and regulators rely on what you own when they decide to work with Plaid, and your work keeps those certifications and commitments reliable and on time as the business grows.

You will set the program’s structure and direction, with a roadmap and KPIs that turn compliance from a pass/fail event into a program leadership can steer. The control catalog you build will sit behind every audit, so one control and one piece of evidence can satisfy many obligations, from SOC 2 to FedRAMP. Your internal audits will find gaps before an external auditor, customer, or regulator does. You will make sure compliance shapes product decisions before launch instead of reacting to them.

As Plaid expands into new products, markets, and frameworks, you will build a program that keeps pace without adding headcount, using AI and automation.



Responsibilities

 - Own the compliance program and governance calendar: Lead SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, and ISO 27701 end to end. Run the annual and quarterly governance obligations (policy reviews, access and change-management reviews, security training, vendor reviews, and regulatory, bank, and partner assessments), each with an owner, a date, and evidence of completion.

 - Build and own the control catalog: Design and maintain one control catalog mapped across every framework Plaid reports against, built to FedRAMP and NIST 800-53 depth, with clear control owners, quarterly owner certification, and testing.

 - Run internal audit and policy assurance: Build a risk-based internal audit plan that tests operating effectiveness and whether policies are followed, and own the policy lifecycle. Track findings to remediation, and partner with Finance on ITGCs.

 - Set direction and measure the program: Define what a mature program looks like, set the roadmap and KPIs to get there, and report progress to security leadership each quarter.

 - Embed GRC by design: Track product roadmaps and supporting infrastructure with Product and Engineering. You will assess how launches and material changes affect audit scope and system boundaries, and build lightweight checkpoints into product discovery.

 - Scale through AI and automation: Build repeatable processes, runbooks, and AI-driven automation for evidence, testing, scoping, and audit requests.



Qualifications

Must haves:

 - Compliance program ownership:
   
   - Has been the accountable owner of SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001/27701 programs through multiple audit cycles, including setting the roadmap and KPIs that matured them
   
   - Has built or rebuilt a common control framework mapped across multiple frameworks, with control owners and testing

 - FedRAMP:
   
   - Hands-on FedRAMP experience (Rev5 or 20x): NIST 800-53 control implementation, boundary and SSP documentation, third-party assessment, and continuous monitoring

 - Internal audit, policy assurance, ITGC, and SOX:
   
   - Has planned and run risk-based internal audits that test operating effectiveness and policy adherence, and has driven findings to remediation
   
   - Has worked with Finance or internal controls teams and external auditors on ITGCs and SOX

 - Governance obligations and product-aware compliance:
   
   - Has partnered with Product and Engineering to scope launches and infrastructure changes into audits, and has embedded compliance checkpoints into product development
   
   - Has run a recurring governance calendar (policy, access, training, vendor, and regulatory or partner reviews) and translated obligations from customers, banks, regulators, or government agencies into control and audit requirements

 - AI fluency and tooling:
   
   - Takes an AI-first approach: has built AI workflows or automations that materially reduced manual compliance work, and shares what works with the team

jobs.title: CDD KYC Knowledge & Training manager
jobs.description:
This is Adyen 
 Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.  
 For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.
 The Role 
 Adyen is moving fast, and our Merchant Operations (MOps) team is the engine ensuring we grow responsibly. We’ve recently centralized our Quality Assurance function into the MOps Excellence domain, transforming it from a standard checkpoint into a strategic partner that drives quality and efficiency across the globe. Role is based in EMEA.
 As our operations continue to scale globally, there is a key opportunity to streamline knowledge, standard operating procedures, and quality benchmarks across teams — elevating our QA standards to better support operational excellence. This is a senior specialist role with a specialization in knowledge and training: you own the global QA benchmark, build the single source of truth behind it, get analysts to standard through onboarding and continuous training, and design smarter, scalable ways to assess whether work is done correctly. The standards, documentation, and training you build become the operating baseline for a ~400-person global risk and compliance organisation — this is a rare chance to shape how an entire function works
 What You Will Do 
 Knowledge Management — maintaining a single source of truth: Build and maintain a trusted, up-to-date, searchable space where first-line teams reliably find current SOPs, procedures, and guidance. Lead the consolidation of fragmented documentation into one coherent structure.
 SOP Governance & Change Communication: Run and initiate a clear governance process and communication cadence for SOP and procedure changes — versioned, approved, published, and actively communicated, so updates land with the teams rather than getting lost.
 Training, Onboarding & L&D: Design a framework for delivery of onboarding and continuous training for analysts — covering core risk assessment,operational efficiency , and proactive customer communication— and identifying the gaps in the existing training frameworksPartner with QA and other MOps Excellence project managers, and Operational Academies to coach analysts, using gaps identified to target training and prevent recurring errors. 
 Guideline Creation & Transparency: Uplift and maintain clear QA guidelines so that quality benchmarks are transparent, easily accessible, and strictly aligned with our global compliance procedures.
 Framework Development: Design and refine end-to-end QA frameworks that don’t just find errors, but actively facilitate the efficiency and accuracy of our operations — developing smart, scalable ways to assess whether work is done to standard.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with First line, Compliance, Project Managers (Excellence team), and Product to drive continuous improvement and foster a global culture of shared quality and accountability.
 Who You Are 
 You bring 5+ years of experience in CDD/KYC compliance control oversight, governance and/or QA roles — senior enough to set standards that others follow.
 You can translate complex risk concepts into practical guidance, teach analysts how to think through cases rather than follow a checklist, and provide actionable feedback that strengthens their judgement and written assessments.
 You have hands-on experience or strong aptitude in knowledge management, training/L&D, or building QA and SOP frameworks. You like turning messy, tribal knowledge into clean, usable systems.
 You have a deep-seated understanding of CDD frameworks and the regulatory nuances governing merchant onboarding and the wider customer lifecycle.
 You possess exceptional English communication skills and are an expert at tailoring your message to different audiences, delivering feedback that is both actionable and professional. You are a strong writer who can turn complex, changing procedures into clear documentation and training.
 You possess strong data analysis skills and the ability to synthesize complex information — comfortable diving into data to spot trends, identify root causes, and turn raw findings into strategic recommendations.
 You have a track record of working successfully cross-functionally with diverse stakeholders to drive initiatives and process improvements to completion.
 You don’t just “check” work — you own the outcome. You see Quality Assurance as a strategic business enabler that lets Adyen scale safely without sacrificing speed, and you build reusable systems rather than one-off fixes (“Build for Scale”).
 You have an “automation-first” mindset, naturally spotting manual bottlenecks, utilizing AI effectively, and challenging existing processes to find a better way.
 You can independently assess complex customer profiles, identify material risks, determine appropriate due diligence and mitigants, and reach clear, risk-based conclusions aligned with the risk appetite and compliance framework.
 You can distinguish between documenting facts and producing a clear, well-reasoned assessment that connects risk indicators, due diligence, mitigants, and the overall decision.
 You can evaluate whether a risk assessment is complete, well-reasoned, and appropriately risk-based, identifying gaps in both analysis and judgement.
 Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments  
 Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.  
 Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application! 
 What’s next? 
 Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here . Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility. 
 This role is based out of our Amsterdam office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles, our hybrid work setup is 3 days a week in office.

More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

You’ll build and lead Airwallex’s Sales Development function in Bangalore, owning the outbound pipeline engine for the SME & Growth business.

 - You’ll hire, coach and develop a high-performing SDR team, set clear performance expectations and build repeatable processes that generate high-quality pipeline at scale.

 - You’ll partner closely with Marketing, Account Executives, Revenue Operations and People & Talent to improve targeting, qualification, Salesforce handovers, funnel conversion and pipeline health.

 - You’ll scale an AI-assisted outbound engine, using prospecting technology and workflow automation to improve lead sourcing, account research, personalisation and sequence testing while maintaining appropriate quality and compliance guardrails.

 - You’ll contribute to regional go-to-market strategy by refining value propositions, pitch narratives and local-market outreach.

This is an in-office role — you’ll be in our Bangalore office five days a week.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


ESSENTIALS

 - Experience leading an outbound SDR or sales development team in a high-growth technology company.

 - A track record of hiring and developing early-career sales talent and building repeatable processes that deliver against ambitious targets.

 - Strong cross-functional partnership skills across Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations and People & Talent.

 - Experience with Salesforce or another modern CRM and sales engagement tools, plus a track record of implementing AI-enabled prospecting or workflow automation to improve personalisation and SDR efficiency.

 - Comfort operating in a metrics-driven environment, owning targets including opportunity creation, pipeline value, conversion, activity levels and reporting.

 - Excellent written, numerical and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complexity and coach effectively.

 - Strategic thinking, pragmatic execution and a bias toward action, continuous improvement and ownership.


PREFERRED

 - Familiarity with payments, FX, cards, treasury, spend management or complex B2B SaaS.

 - Experience contributing to regional go-to-market strategy, including value propositions, pitch narratives and local-market outreach.


YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You have a track record of hitting your numbers, and you’re motivated by stretch goals.

 - You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

 - You're consistently looking to take on new and diverse challenges, expand your knowledge beyond your current areas of expertise, and are comfortable stepping outside your comfort zone to do it.

 - You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and mid-market businesses solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales.

It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward.

If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.
