jobs.title: Analyst, Banking Operations (Domestic)
jobs.location: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
jobs.description:
Why join us 
 Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.
 Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.
 Operations at Brex 
 Operations is the backbone of Brex’s mission to power businesses through our Intelligent Finance Platform. We own credit, fraud, money movement, and payments, protecting our customers and our company. From product operations that ensure flawless launches to scalable systems that drive innovation and precision, we operate at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and customer success. If you want to work at the heart of the business, Operations is where you belong.
 What you’ll do 
 Brex is building the operating system for growing companies, and reliable funds movement is at the core. As a Banking Operations Analyst on our Domestic Payments team, you will work the US payment rails (ACH,checks, domestic wires, stablecoin) and investigate returns and exceptions, and keep our customers’ money moving accurately and on time. You’ll combine precision and rigor in controls with cross-functional collaboration to keep customers’ funds safe, timely, and accounted for. If you meet most, but not all, of the qualifications, we encourage you to apply.
 Where you’ll work 
 This role will be based in our Salt Lake City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!
 Responsibilities 
 Work the domestic payments queue across ACH, checks, domestic wires and stablecoin, resolving cases in Salesforce with clear, customer-safe explanations.
 Monitor ACH and wire returns, interpreting return codes and running the right procedure for each.
 Watch for trends before they become incidents and escalate with clear context and urgency.
 Work exceptions with external banking partners, bringing the right identifiers and evidence to speed resolution.
 Keep the queue healthy by maintaining Salesforce routing and hygiene, balancing case quality and attention to detail.
 Write and maintain documentation (SOPs, training materials) and help onboard and cross-train new analysts.
 Leverage data and AI (Hex, SQL/Snowflake, Retool, LLMs) to investigate cases faster, build monitoring and dashboards, and automate repeat work.
 Identify process gaps, determine whether each is a manual error, data break, or process gap, and bring clear requirements to Engineering and Product.
 Collaborate cross-functionally with CX, CSMs, AEs, Accounting, Compliance, Engineering, Product, Design, and external banking partners to resolve exceptions and prepare for new flows.
 Participate in the coverage rotation on some holidays for urgent cases.
 Requirements 
 1+ year of experience in banking, fintech, payments, or operations (CX/Support, Operations, or Treasury) at a fintech, broker-dealer, or bank. Relevant internships count.
 Exposure to payments, returns, reconciliations, or settlements.
 Strong control discipline: follows SOPs, maintains audit-ready documentation, and escalates anomalies with clear context.
 Clear communicator and high-velocity collaborator under time pressure: responsive, decisive, and highly effective at partnering cross-functionally with CX, Engineering, Accounting, Compliance, and banking partners to drive swift resolutions.
 Proactive self-starter with strong communication skills and a commitment to continuous feedback and improvement.
 AI-native operator mindset, using LLMs/copilots to draft SOPs, triage exceptions, and generate first-pass analyses with strong output validation.
 Bonus points 
 2+ years of experience in banking, fintech, payments, or operations (CX/Support, Operations, or Treasury) at a fintech, broker-dealer, or bank. Relevant internships count.
 Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Economics or Information Systems. 
 Working knowledge of ACH and NACHA rules, return codes, and the lifecycle of wires and checks (including Reg CC and UCC 4A basics).
 Data fluency: intermediate Excel/Google Sheets (lookups, pivots) and comfort analyzing operational dashboards (e.g., Hex) to monitor volumes, returns, and exceptions.
 Comfort with SQL/Python for operational analytics, building checks and alerts, or automating workflows (e.g., Retool, Zapier).
 Experience with Salesforce case management and queue routing.
 Exposure to audits or control testing
 Experience with fraud, OFAC, or compliance-adjacent investigations.
 Compensation 
 The expected salary range for this role is $58,700 - $73,375.  However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.
 Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.
 Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a  brex.com  domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

About Belltower Fund Group:
Belltower, AngelList’s funds services division, is empowering world-changing fund investments.
Belltower was formed in 2019 as AngelList’s native fund administrator. Belltower provides fund administration services to the venture space. Our coverage spans syndicates, venture funds, and first-of-their-kind rolling funds. Our full-service fund management offering streamlines the complexity of running a fund by integrating financial reporting, tax, compliance, portfolio management, and other services that managers typically have to cobble together from multiple vendors. Our services, combined with AngelList’s software, enable us to launch and scale a fund efficiently, allowing fund managers to focus on what they do best: investing.
Since 2019, Belltower has supported 27k+ funds representing over $25B in assets under administration, leveraging AngelList’s fund admin software to power the service layer for funds launched on the AngelList platform.


About the Role:
The Fund Accounting Senior Associate is a key member of the team responsible for supporting the accounting, valuation, and reporting functions for 27,000+ funds run on the AngelList platform. This position is part of our team that prepares fund accounting work that is not yet automated, resolves exceptions, addresses investor inquiries, and researches new technical issues.
This role is responsible for reviewing post-close actions in order to process valuation and accounting updates, review management and administrative fee calculations, perform ad hoc and scheduled financial reporting. There will be direct collaboration and interface with both GPs and LPs regarding any of the above.
 Evaluate portfolio company events and data, and determine the appropriate valuation action for each investment.
 Help prepare both audited and unaudited financial statements and work with audit firms to ensure completion of annual audits.
 Ensure that accounting treatment for portfolio company investments is in accordance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), and evaluate special situations.
 Work with engineering teams to continue the push toward increased automation and process improvement.
 Be directly responsible for specific team functions and workflows.
 Work on ad hoc projects. 3-4+ years of demonstrated operational excellence in the financial sector, including experience in fund administration and/or public accounting focused on VC and/or PE clients, supported by a superb academic track record and a CPA license (strongly preferred).
 The ability to communicate effectively and with polished professionalism with portfolio companies and lead investors.
 Superb attention to detail: you need to be able to catch the corner case every time.
 Exceptional organizational skills and a love of process. We oversee a portfolio of investments in the thousands, which can only be managed systematically.
 Willingness to get your hands dirty: good data usually takes hard work and determination.
 Mastery of core financial concepts and a strong interest in the nuts and bolts of venture finance. Your day-to-day work will touch on the legal, accounting, tax, and finance components that underlie the venture financing ecosystem.
 A great attitude and the ability to embrace regular change as we continually improve products and processes. Working Here

Private markets are the new public markets. The most important companies of this era are private, and almost no one can own them.  At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.
 As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.
 We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

 The Team:  
 Upstart is seeking a results-driven Account Executive, Home Equity to accelerate the expansion of our third-party origination (TPO) business across wholesale and correspondent lending channels.
 This role will focus exclusively on identifying, developing, negotiating, and closing new partnerships with independent mortgage banks (IMBs) and mortgage brokers.
 With industry leading HELOC and consumer loan products, extensive brand awareness, and supporting marketing and growth teams, you are enabled for and positioned to rapidly build partnerships and help drive production. As an Account Executive you will play a critical role in developing, guiding, improving and scaling our sales initiatives that will position Upstart as a HELOC industry leader.
 How you’ll make an impact 
 Taking opportunities from prospecting through negotiations and signed agreements.
 Build Upstart's presence across wholesale brokers and correspondent lenders.
 Bring on partners capable of generating meaningful HELOC origination volume.
 Collaborate with marketing teams to develop tactics and outbound marketing campaigns
 Collaborate with marketing teams to efficiently capture inbound opportunities
 Attend and prospect at relevant industry conferences 
 Effectively handoff accounts to implementation and onboarding teams
 Provide clear market feedback to product teams to improve our programs
 Collaborate with the consumer product team on cross-sell and strategic partnerships
 Minimum Qualifications  
 3 years of related work experience
 2-3 years of mortgage sales experience or leading mortgage function in a financial institution
 Experience with 2nd lien or Home Equity products
 Understanding of mortgage lending regulations and industry best practice
 Preferred Qualifications 
 5 years of related work experience
 3-5 years of mortgage sales experience or leading mortgage function in a financial institution
 Prior TPO Account Executive experience
 Proven mortgage sales track record with an industry network
 Understanding of TPO mortgage lending operations
 Naturally brings people together, builds strong cross-functional relationships, and recognizes that the best outcomes come from working as one team.
 Moves with urgency, takes initiative, and finds practical ways to move opportunities forward without waiting for perfect information.
 Takes accountability beyond getting a deal signed, proactively working through obstacles and ensuring a successful handoff and launch.
 Makes thoughtful decisions, balances speed with risk, and knows when to act independently versus when to bring others into the conversation.
 Open to feedback, willing to roll up their sleeves, and focused on team success rather than individual credit.

 Time zone requirements The team operates on the East/West coast time zones.

jobs.title: Field Engineer
jobs.description:
Who We Are 
 Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
 The Role 
 As a Field Engineer you will embed directly with clients to architect and build mission-critical integrations, automations, and data solutions. Operating at the intersection of engineering and client success, you will serve as Addepar's technical vanguard - translating complex business requirements into production-grade systems while driving onboarding efficiency and operational scale. You will be the technical expert across Addepar's full solution suite - from API integrations and automation frameworks to advanced data platforms (including our white-labeled Databricks offering, ADX) and AI-driven tooling - solving our clients' most challenging problems. This role combines a forward-deployed model with deep technical expertise in modern software engineering and financial data systems.
 Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment-based visas such as H-1B, F-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment.
 What You’ll Do 
 Deploy directly to client sites (virtual or in-person) to architect, build, and deliver custom integrations, automations, and data pipelines using Addepar's APIs, ADX (Databricks), and modern engineering tools
 Design and implement production-grade solutions that dramatically improve client onboarding efficiency, reduce time-to-value, and enable operational scale
 Build intelligent automation leveraging AI, LLMs, and machine learning to solve complex data transformation, validation, and reconciliation challenges
 Serve as the technical owner for ADX implementations, designing robust data infrastructure within Databricks to streamline client data onboarding and analytics
 Translate ambiguous client requirements into flexible, scalable technical solutions through deep discovery, prototyping, and iterative delivery
 Write production-quality Python code for ETL pipelines, API integrations, data validation frameworks, and automation tooling
 Lead technical workstreams end-to-end, from requirements gathering through production deployment, owning outcomes and client success
 Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Services teams to identify opportunities for productization and influence platform roadmap
 Develop internal tools, frameworks, and best practices that accelerate delivery across the broader team
 Effectively set, manage, and communicate technical expectations with both client stakeholders and internal cross-functional teams
 Prioritize and context-switch effectively across simultaneous client engagements, seeing each through to successful completion
 Act as a technical advisor and trusted partner to clients, proactively identifying opportunities to drive additional value
 Who You Are  
 Minimum 3+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or forward-deployed technical roles
 Advanced proficiency in Python with experience building production-grade applications, APIs, and data pipelines
 Strong understanding of REST APIs, authentication patterns, and integration architecture
 Hands-on experience with Databricks, Spark, and distributed data processing frameworks
 Proficiency in SQL and experience working with large-scale datasets across relational and NoSQL databases
 Experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines for complex data transformations
 Familiarity with AI/ML tools and experience implementing LLM-driven automation solutions
 Strong understanding of financial data domains including portfolio management, performance analytics, and multi-asset class portfolios
 Exceptional problem-solving abilities with a solutions-oriented mindset and bias for action
 Outstanding communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences
 Proven ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments while maintaining high-quality standards
 Experience with version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and modern software development practices

jobs.title: Compliance Associate
jobs.description:
About Betterment 
 Betterment is a leading, technology-driven financial services company that offers investing, savings and retirement solutions for retail investors and investment advisors as well as financial wellness solutions, including a 401(k) for small and medium-sized businesses. Our team is passionate about our mission, to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease.  We’re headquartered in NYC and offer hybrid NY-based positions (four days/ week in-office, with no required office days during the summer and winter holidays).
 About the Role 
 You're a natural systems thinker who gets energized by turning complex, ambiguous requirements into something clean and usable. In this role, you'll sit at the intersection of regulatory compliance and operational execution — taking dense regulatory frameworks and translating them into workflows, procedures, and documentation that the rest of the business can actually act on.
 This isn't just a "keep the lights on" compliance role. You'll be building and maintaining the structural backbone of Betterment's compliance programs — designing how processes work, not just following them.
 This role is based out of our NYC office, with in-office attendance required Monday through Thursday. Salary range is disclosed per NYC requirements; actual compensation varies based on experience and performance. 
 This role is based out of our NYC office. Below we've reflected the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Betterment’s total compensation package for employees. 
 New York City: $90,000 - $105,000
 A Day in the Life: 
 Translate SEC and FINRA regulatory requirements into clear, actionable compliance workflows and process documentation
 Design and maintain compliance program infrastructure — building and managing workflows in tools like Jira and Claude to track, route, and execute compliance processes at scale
 Build and maintain procedures, process maps, and control documentation that are accurate, readable, and built to scale
 Identify where compliance processes break down or create friction, and propose structured solutions
 Partner with teams across the business to implement compliance requirements in ways that are practical and well-understood
 Support day-to-day program management across a range of compliance workstreams, keeping processes moving
 What We’re Looking For: 
 1–2 years of experience in compliance, operations, program management, or a related field
 A systems-oriented mindset — you naturally want to understand how things work end-to-end, and you notice when something's missing or misaligned
 Strong documentation instincts: you write clearly, organize logically, and leave processes better than you found them
 Comfort with ambiguity — you can take a messy regulatory requirement or undefined workflow and find the through-line
 Attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger picture
 Ability to work across business units and communicate compliance requirements without the jargon
 Curiosity about how technical systems and process flows are built, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves on the structural elements of program design
 Join a team built on these core values 
 We change lives 
 Be a part of a community of innovators working to transform financial outcomes for real people. Your work will make an impact, always laddering up to our mission; to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease . 
 We set audacious goals 
 We set them for the company, our customers, and ourselves, and we won’t stop until we reach them. We don’t just show up; we give our all, then celebrate our wins.
 We value all perspectives 
 When we collaborate, we're at our best. We believe diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes and strive to uphold our supportive and inclusive community.
 We simplify financial services 
 We’re financial services pioneers, always finding new ways to improve, optimize, and enhance. Constant improvement is in our DNA.
   Our Commitment to Your Total Well-being: 
 We offer a competitive suite of benefits , including medical, dental, and vision coverage; life and AD&D insurance; short- and long-term disability; infertility support and WPATH-aligned transgender health benefits; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); transit benefits and FSA and HSA options
 Ownership: Equity for all employees, including new hire and refresher grants.
 Time: Flexible paid time off, paid parental leave, and a fully paid four-week sabbatical in your sixth year.
 Growth: Company-paid professional coaching for all employees.
 Wealth: Day-one 401(k) match plus matching on qualified student loan payments.
 What happens next 
 We’ll take a few weeks to review all applications. If we’d like to spend more time with you, we’ll reach out to arrange next steps, which will include 3-4 sets of meetings with your future colleagues.
 In the interview process, we’ll look to learn more about your skills, experiences, capabilities, and motivators. Many of our questions will be aimed at understanding how you might operate here at Betterment. Depending on the role, we may ask you to complete a case study exercise or technical assessments, as we want to collect a robust set of data points to better inform our decisions.
 On average, it takes us around 3-5 weeks to make a hiring decision, depending on your availability and sense of urgency. As a best practice, we aim to interview at least 2-3 final round candidates before making a hiring decision. Please note that, as we usually receive an overwhelming number of  applications for open positions, we’re unable to offer individual feedback during the interview process. 
 We recognize that interviewing for a new role is a big deal. We appreciate you considering Betterment as the next step in your career, and our Recruiting Team is here to support and advocate for you through the interview process!
 Betterment is dedicated to providing accommodations to candidates upon request. If you need accommodations at any point throughout the interview process, please reach out to your recruiter.  
 Please note that in any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information. 
 Come join us!  
 We’re an equal opportunity employer and comply with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We strictly prohibit and do not tolerate discrimination against employees, applicants, or any other covered persons because of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex, gender (including gender nonconformity and status as a transgender or transsexual individual), sexual orientation, marital status, age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current or prospective service in the uniformed services, predisposing genetic characteristic, domestic violence victim status, arrest records, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state or local law.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Analyst
jobs.description:
About Us 
 DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options. 
 There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing! 
 About the Role 
 As a Product Marketing Analyst, you’ll help shape how our products are understood, valued, and adopted in the market. You’ll support the team by turning customer needs, market insights, and product capabilities into clear, compelling stories that connect with customers and support business growth.
In this highly collaborative role, you’ll work closely with Product, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to support product launches, strengthen our competitive position, and help equip customer-facing teams with the tools they need to succeed. You’ll learn from experienced marketers, contribute your own ideas, and see your work directly contribute to engagement and adoption.
 What You’ll Do 
 Support product launches by coordinating timelines, tasks, and deliverables across teams 
 Contribute to product positioning and messaging by drafting and refining copy and key materials 
 Gather and summarize market and customer insights to share with the business 
 Partner with cross-functional teams and help bring the customer perspective into conversations 
 Track and report on campaign and launch performance, and recommend improvements 
 Help drive product adoption through supporting campaigns and resources 
 Create and maintain sales enablement materials such as one-pagers, battle cards, and decks 
 Conduct market and competitive research and keep competitor profiles up to date 
 Assist with content development and marketing campaigns
 You Bring 
 1-3 years of experience in marketing, product marketing, market research, or a related area 
 Clear, confident writing and presentation skills, with a knack for explaining complex topics simply 
 A curiosity about the market, including hands-on experience with research, competitor tracking, or gathering customer feedback 
 Comfort with tools like PowerPoint or Google Slides, and experience building decks, one-pagers, or other marketing content 
 A team-first attitude and a willingness to work with Product, Sales, and Customer Success 
 Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to juggle multiple projects and deadlines 
 Comfort working with data, such as pulling together campaign metrics or survey results to spot trends 
 A customer-first mindset and an interest in understanding what drives customer decisions
 Location 
 This role is open to candidates in the following locations: New York City, NY - Hybrid 
 This role is expected to come into the office on a cadence set by the Hiring Manager/Team. 
 If you're not based in one of the locations listed above, this role is not a fit, and we cannot accommodate remote work outside these locations. 
 Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. DriveWealth does not sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.
 Pay Range : $100,000 – $120,000 USD 
 Working at DriveWealth 
 We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule. We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions. 
 To support that work, we provide competitive compensation, equity, and a 401(k) match. We also offer Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Disability insurance, and Paid Parental Leave, along with a wellness reimbursement, a company-provided phone, and a personal development allowance. Finally, we value the time you spend away from the office with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and observed holidays. 
 Work Authorization 
 Applicants must possess the legal right to work in the country where the position is located at the time of application. DriveWealth requires all employees to provide original documentation verifying their work authorization on or before their first day of employment. 
 For US-based roles: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. DriveWealth does not provide visa sponsorship or support for employment authorization, including transfers, at this time. Offers of employment are strictly contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the Company. 
 How We Think About AI 
 We leverage AI to work smarter and move faster. We seek AI-curious talent who are proactive about using emerging tools to increase signal quality, reduce friction, and improve outcomes to deliver products faster, provide better service to our partners, and to streamline processes. Your ability to leverage our internal tools and technology to drive results is as important to us as your core domain expertise. 
 Compensation 
 Pay is generally based on the level, complexity, responsibility, location, and job duties/requirements of the specific position. We then source candidates with the requisite skills, expertise, education, training, and experience.  If you are selected for an interview, please feel welcome to speak to a recruiter about our compensation philosophy and other available benefits. This role is eligible for base, bonus, equity, 401(k) match, and heavily subsidized benefits and perks. 
 Equal Employment Opportunity 
 To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.  
 Agency Disclaimer 
 DriveWealth does not accept agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other organization location. DriveWealth is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

 As a Sourcer on our Talent Acquisition team, you will be a key partner to our recruiters and hiring managers, building and nurturing the candidate pipelines that fuel our growth.  Track and report: Monitor sourcing metrics such as outreach response rates, screen-to-submit ratios, and pipeline diversity, and use the data to continuously improve results.
 Deliver a great candidate experience: Communicate clearly and promptly, represent Vestwell's brand and culture, and ensure candidates feel respected whatever the outcome.
 Contribute to the team: Share best practices, help improve sourcing playbooks and templates, and support employer branding and recruiting events as needed.
 Own the end-to-end candidate interview process, from conducting initial interview screens to coordinating virtual and on-site interview panels across multiple time zones and stakeholder groups.
 Requirements

 1–3 years of experience in sourcing or recruiting, in an agency, in-house, or high-growth environment

 Experience working in startup and or FinTech environment(s)

Your work will provide a reliable operational foundation that enables the team to scale marketing channels and pursue growth initiatives while helping consumers make informed financial decisions.

 - Process lender-initiated compliance updates, including APRs, disclosures, and regulated content, across landing pages and internal systems. Coordinate with external partners to maintain marketplace accuracy and regulatory compliance.

 - Ability to quickly learn and use new platforms and internal tools, such as Voluum, Ironclad, WordPress, Amplitude, Databricks, and custom internal systems.

jobs.title: Account Executive - Midmarket (Dallas)
jobs.description:
Who We Are: 
 
At Emburse, you’ll not just imagine the future – you’ll build it. As a leader in expense intelligence, we are creating a future where technology drives business value and inspires extraordinary results. Our AI-powered platform helps organizations modernize financial operations, increase visibility, and optimize spend across the enterprise.


We are hiring a high-velocity Account Executive to lead net new logo acquisition across our Mid-Market
segment. This is a closing role for a true hunter, backed by a real engine: our marketing and SDR teams
generate up to 75% of your pipeline, and you are expected to self-source the other 25%. That balance is
intentional. You get the support of a world-class demand generation machine, and we get an AE who
never waits for pipeline to arrive.
 
You will own the full sales cycle, sell directly to CFOs, VPs of Finance, and their teams, and have a direct,
measurable impact on top-line revenue growth. The bar here is high. We are building a team of
overachievers, and we are selective about who joins it.
 Own the full sales cycle, from first conversation through negotiation and close, landing net-new
mid-market logos.
 Convert pipeline into revenue. Work the opportunities our marketing and SDR engine delivers (up
to 75% of your pipeline) while self-sourcing the remaining 25% through targeted, strategic
outbound.
 Develop and execute a territory plan that prioritizes the right accounts, buying committees, and
timing, partnering with SDRs and channel partners while driving your own pipeline creation.
 Engage credibly with C-level executives and their direct reports, leading consultative conversations
and product demonstrations tailored to CFOs, VPs of Finance, and AP operations leaders.
 Quantify business value. Analyze complex AP and expense workflows, build ROI cases grounded in
risk, compliance, and margin, and defend them in front of senior finance leaders.
 Map complex buying committees, establish executive sponsorship, and navigate tough
negotiations to drive high-margin outcomes.
 Maintain accurate Salesforce forecasting and CRM hygiene, and provide real-time market feedback
to sales leadership. •   3+ years of full-cycle B2B SaaS sales experience in mid-market or commercial segments, ideally in
financial software or FinTech.
•   A proven track record of overachieving quota and consistently closing 5-figure and 6-figure ARR
deals, with new logos, not renewals, at the center of your results.
•   Strong business and financial acumen. You can dissect AP and expense workflows, debate ROI,
working capital, and operating efficiency, and hold your own with a CFO.
•   Executive presence. Demonstrated ability to engage C-level executives and their direct reports,
earn trust quickly, and drive multi-threaded deals.
•  Mastery of self-sourced outbound prospecting alongside SDR and inbound support, you know how
to build pipeline momentum on your own.
•  Technical fluency with Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, and modern sales tech stacks and experience using AI as part of your sales motion. • A True Hunter: You appreciate a strong pipeline engine behind you, but you never depend on it.
Building your own momentum is instinct, not obligation.
• Financially Fluent: You speak the language of finance leaders, risk, compliance, margin, and
working capital, and use it to reframe how prospects think about spend.
• An Overachiever: Hitting your number is the floor, not the goal. Your track record shows a pattern
of exceeding targets, not just meeting them.
• Resilient and Resourceful: You thrive in fast-paced, PE-backed environments where speed,
execution, and adaptability win the day.
• A Skilled Negotiator: You comfortably push back to protect contract value while securing win-win
outcomes. • Real pipeline support: Up to 75% of your pipeline is generated for you. Your time goes into closing,
not just hunting for at-bats.
• Product-market fit: An AI-native platform solving a universal finance problem, with a value
proposition CFOs immediately understand.
• A high-performance team: You will be surrounded by people who hold the same bar you do, and
led by a hiring manager who is directly invested in your success.
• Direct impact: Net new logo acquisition is the growth engine of the business. Your wins are visible,
valued, and rewarded. Why Emburse?
 
Finance is changing—and at Emburse, we’re leading the way. Our AI-powered solutions help organizations eliminate inefficiencies, gain real-time visibility, and optimize spend—so they can focus on what’s next, not what’s slowing them down. 
• A Company with Momentum – We serve 12M+ users across 120 countries, helping businesses modernize
 their finance operations.
• A Team That Innovates – Work alongside some of the brightest minds in finance, tech, and AI to solve real-
 world challenges.
• A Culture That Empowers – Competitive pay, flexible work, and an inclusive, collaborative environment that
 supports your success.
• A Career That Matters – Your work here drives efficiency, innovation, and smarter financial decision-making 
 for businesses everywhere. 
 
Shape your future & find what’s next at Emburse. 
 
Emburse provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Emburse complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location where the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment.

jobs.title: Change & Communications Manager
jobs.description:
We are customer-obsessed at Navan, and we move fast. We are constantly looking for ways to optimize the Travel & Expense customer experience, so our environment is dynamic, ever-evolving, and anything but traditional corporate.
 To help our global colleague community feel informed, valued, and ready to take on the world, we’re seeking a forward-thinking Change & Communications Manager . Within our Centre of Excellence, you’ll connect colleagues to our purpose, culture, and operational goals.
 You’ll create engaging communications that keep colleagues informed and aligned with what’s happening across the business, while maintaining our internal communications standards. You’ll also support end-to-end change management for initiatives of all sizes by developing tailored change plans and leading enablement that builds resilience.
 What You’ll Do: 
 Manage communications and change requests: Assess and own incoming requests, keep them aligned with the strategic roadmap, and manage key communication channels day to day.
 Create multimedia content: Produce engaging communications in formats such as video, newsletters, visual assets, and Slack updates.
 Bring structure to change: Develop tailored communication and change plans for a diverse hybrid workforce. Turn complex organizational objectives, product changes, and operational updates into clear narratives and deliverables.
 Build relationships and influence: Work as a trusted advisor, coach, and practitioner with stakeholders at all levels. Collaborate across teams and departments to understand the needs and impact of change and communications on colleagues.
 Measure and improve performance: Analyze qualitative and quantitative data to assess the effectiveness of communications and change efforts. Measures may include asset-level engagement, colleague sentiment, and enablement time.
 What We’re Looking For: 
 Relevant experience: At least two years of experience in change management or internal communications, and at least two years in customer service. Change management certification, such as Prosci or CCMP, and leadership experience are preferred.
 Agility: Experience in a fast-paced travel, technology, or SaaS environment. You navigate ambiguity, adapt quickly, and are comfortable working with streamlined processes.
 Storytelling and influence: Ability to turn complex operational information into compelling narratives and influence diverse stakeholders at all levels.
 Cross-functional partnership: A track record of collaborating across teams to build alignment, engagement, and strong working relationships.
 Digital fluency: Familiarity with modern communication channels such as Slack, video, and intranet, and interest in using AI tools to improve colleague enablement.
 Data-informed approach: Comfortable using qualitative feedback and quantitative metrics to track performance, share insights, and adapt communication strategies.
 Ownership and growth: Accountable, self-directed, and able to deliver against clear guardrails and deadlines, with a commitment to continuous learning.

jobs.title: Director of Private Equity Partnerships
jobs.description:
We are seeking an entrepreneurial commercial leader to build Navan’s private equity partnerships program into a measurable, scalable growth channel. The successful candidate will deepen and activate Navan’s existing PE relationships while significantly expanding coverage across priority sponsors and portfolio companies. They will turn that broader reach into commercial opportunities by setting the strategy, building repeatable engagement motions, and working closely with Sales. This hands-on leader will initially own key relationships, support active deals, establish the commercial model, and prove a repeatable approach before building a team as the program scales.

 Develop portfolio-level campaigns that generate qualified introductions to portfolio-company decision-makers.
 Work directly with Sales leadership and account executives on active opportunities: coordinate outreach, make relevant sponsor introductions, identify deal blockers, and help advance opportunities through the sales cycle.
 Build repeatable programs for portfolio mapping, account targeting, executive engagement, partner activation, and follow-through.
 Establish clear accountability for partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, bookings, and revenue, using consistent definitions with Revenue Operations.
 Track results and refine the program based on commercial outcomes, partner engagement, and portfolio-company adoption.
 Engage across the PE investment lifecycle 
 Develop a strong understanding of how PE firms engage with portfolio companies, including value-creation priorities, acquisitions, carve-outs, and integration needs.
 Build relationships with M&A advisors and deal teams to create entry points around acquisitions and portfolio transitions.
 Help operating partners connect Navan to portfolio value-creation plans.
 Build a scalable partnerships organization 
 Create the processes, playbooks, systems, collateral, and reporting infrastructure needed to scale the program.
 Develop the team structure and coverage model as the business grows, with differentiated approaches for strategic sponsors and the broader PE market.
 Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing partnerships team as the program expands.
 Collaborate across Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Corporate Development, and other functions to integrate PE partnerships into Navan’s go-to-market organization.
 Who You Are 
 8+ years of relevant experience in one or more of the following: PE value creation, PE partnerships, or commercial roles at high-growth B2B software or technology companies.
 Experience building a PE partnerships program from the ground up, including channel strategy, partner activation, value-creation initiatives, and events.
 Track record leading commercial teams and consistently achieving pipeline and revenue targets.
 Experience hiring and managing high-performing teams.
 Established network across PE firms, operating partners, and portfolio-company finance leaders.
 Understanding of the PE investment lifecycle; M&A, acquisition, or carve-out experience preferred.
 Strong commercial judgment and analytical skills; able to prioritize with data and work with Sales on complex enterprise deals.
 Hands-on, independent operator who can build the systems and processes to scale a new program.
 Excellent communicator and relationship builder who earns trust while translating PE relationships into commercial outcomes.
 Willingness to travel regularly to engage sponsors and portfolio companies.

You’ll also manage media vendors and partners to ensure campaigns reach the right audiences, deliver quality placements, and produce measurable results. The ideal candidate combines deep channel expertise, a strong understanding of account-based marketing (ABM), and sound creative judgment. You understand that different campaigns serve different purposes and know how to measure success at each stage of the buyer journey.
 What You’ll Do: 
 Execute campaigns that build awareness and create demand 
 Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across LinkedIn, Meta, X, Reddit, YouTube, Google Demand Gen,programmatic display and emerging channels, including audience setup, bidding, budget pacing, tracking, and reporting.
 Support major brand moments that build awareness, credibility, and consideration among relevant audiences in priority markets.
 Activate demand-creation programs through content syndication, industry publishers, newsletters, and sponsored email, with clear audience requirements and lead-quality standards.
 Put ABM strategy into practice 
 Translate priority account lists, engagement signals, and buying-group needs into actionable paid media audiences.
 Build distinct campaigns to introduce Navan to unengaged accounts, reach missing buying roles within engaged accounts, and support progression where paid media can add value.
 Partner with Marketing Operations to maintain audience syncs, exclusions, and suppression rules, and troubleshoot match rates and delivery issues.
 Support one-to-one and one-to-few customer expansion campaigns in partnership with Customer Marketing and account teams, validating audience size and reach before launch.
 Familiarity with 6Sense, Demandbase, StackAdapt or comparable programmatic and account-targeting platforms.
 Partner with Creative and Conten t 
 Develop clear creative briefs that connect the campaign objective, audience, message, offer, and channel requirements.
 Work with Creative, Content, and Product Marketing to produce paid social, display, and sponsored-content assets.
 Run structured tests across messaging, concepts, formats, and landing pages, and turn results into clear recommendations for the next creative iteration.
 Manage production timelines and asset refreshes so campaigns launch on time and stay relevant.
 Measure, learn, and improve 
 Set campaign KPIs that match the objective, from qualified reach and consideration lift to account engagement, buying-group coverage, opportunities, and pipeline.
 Partner with Analytics to design controlled tests, establish baselines, and evaluate incremental impact over appropriate measurement windows.
 Validate account matching, placement quality, viewability, reach, and frequency, and resolve delivery issues before increasing investment.
 Work with Marketing Operations and Sales to connect meaningful campaign responses with clear follow-up and feedback.
 Communicate what is working, what remains uncertain, and where to scale, adjust, or stop investment.
 What We’re Looking For: 
 8+ years of experience in performance marketing or paid media, including meaningful experience in B2B marketing.
 Deep, recent hands-on experience with LinkedIn Ads and multiple channels across paid social, YouTube, Google Demand Gen, and programmatic display.
 Practical knowledge of ABM, including account segmentation, buying committees, audience activation, and long B2B buying cycles.
 Experience executing both brand-awareness and demand-creation campaigns, with a clear understanding of how their objectives, creative, and measurement differ.
 A track record of managing budgets, optimizing campaigns directly, and making thoughtful investment decisions.
 Experience partnering with creative teams to develop briefs, test concepts, and improve campaign assets.
 Strong vendor management skills and experience working with media partners, publishers, or agencies.
 Confidence using campaign, CRM, and analytics data to assess audience quality and downstream performance.
 Strong project management and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple campaigns and cross-functional partners.

jobs.title: Brand Manager - Marketing Effectiveness
jobs.description:
Brand Manager, Marketing Effectiveness 
 Location: London Contract: Full time, permanent
 Team description 
 Central Brand & Marketing builds the campaigns, trackers and insight that show whether SumUp's marketing actually works, across six markets and two very different audiences: consumer and business owners. This role sits at the centre of that picture, turning tracker data into targets, forecasts and recommendations that media, creative and the wider business act on, and taking the lead on a new competitive insights hub that will become the company's source of truth on competition and market performance. It's a chance to shape how SumUp reads its market from the ground up, working closely with the Media & Strategic Partnership, Creative, Growth, Sales and Operations teams along the way.
 What you'll do 
 Run SumUp's consumer and B2B brand trackers across six markets, keeping the data accurate and the targets realistic
 Turn tracker results and market insight into clear recommendations that shape campaigns, pricing and sales conversations
 Own upper and mid funnel campaign reporting with the Media team, then share what worked and why with other marketers
 Build and launch a new competitive insights hub that becomes the single place the business goes for market intelligence
 Track vendor deliverables and contracted rights so partnership data and trackers are fully used, not left on the shelf
 What you'll bring 
 Experience in brand management, brand marketing or market research, gained in an agency or in-house team.
 Solid understanding of brand tracking and how to measure upper and mid funnel campaign performance.
 Ability to connect data and insight to real business decisions, not just report on numbers.
 Comfort working independently across ambiguity, multiple markets and tight deadlines.
 Strong communication skills, with a track record of presenting findings clearly to a non specialist audience.
 Nice to have: experience managing brands in FMCG or another brand driven industry, and hands-on use of Tableau, Google Analytics or similar tools.
 You're likely to thrive here if you're curious, strategic, a good listener and communicator, determined, productive, deadline driven and independent.
 Why you should join SumUp 
 🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our London Bridge location, wrapped in historic charm and modern flair. This involves an office-first setup 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced 🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success 🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave, plus bank holidays and special leaves 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education 🏥 Health matters: private health insurance, including optical and dental 🚗 Life made easier: salary-sacrifice commuter benefits via Gogeta 💼 Financial security: retirement scheme (SumUp matches 7% when you contribute 5%) 🛡 Peace of mind: life insurance from MetLife for 2× your salary 🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service 🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team
 About SumUp 
 Be empowered to do more that matters.
 At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 39 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.
 Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 4,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.
 SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website , and follow our journey on LinkedIn , Instagram , and TikTok .

 Você gosta de estar na rua, criar conexões e ver seu esforço virar resultado? É isso que a gente faz aqui.

 Sobre a SumUp 
 A SumUp é uma empresa de meios de pagamento global fundada em 2012, presente em dezenas de países, com mais de 1.000 pessoas de mais de 20 nacionalidades.
Nossa missão: simplificar a vida de micro e pequenos empreendedores.
Oferecemos um ecossistema completo com maquininhas conta digital gratuita, Pix, link de pagamento, Tap to Pay, loja online, gestão de cobranças, empréstimos e antecipação de recebíveis. Tudo simples, transparente e com taxas competitivas.

 Lombardia, Italia 
 Contratto CCNL Terziario, retribuzione fissa più bonus uncapped al raggiungimento del target mensile.
 Il team
 In SumUp, il team Field Sales Italia è la prima linea di contatto fra l'azienda e le piccole imprese del Paese: ogni giorno aiuta ristoranti, negozi e professionisti a scoprire soluzioni di pagamento semplici, affidabili e su misura. Come Field Sales Associate per la Lombardia, avrai un ruolo diretto nella crescita di SumUp sul territorio, costruendo relazioni autentiche con i merchant e portando i nostri lettori di carte e le nostre soluzioni di pagamento in centinaia di nuove attività. Riporterai al Territory manager Lombardia e lavorerai a stretto contatto con i team di SDR per garantire ai nuovi clienti un avvio semplice e senza intoppi.
 Cosa farai
 Individuare e contattare nuove attività commerciali in Lombardia
 Incontrare i merchant di persona per capire le loro esigenze e presentare le soluzioni di pagamento SumUp più adatte
 Gestire l'intero ciclo di vendita, dal primo contatto alla negoziazione fino alla chiusura
 Costruire relazioni durature con i merchant e sviluppare progressivamente il proprio territorio
 Lavorare per il raggiungimento degli obiettivi di acquisizione e performance commerciale, con il supporto costante del team durante i primi mesi
 Rappresentare SumUp a eventi locali, fiere di settore e nella comunità imprenditoriale del territorio
 Il profilo che cerchiamo
 Esperienza nella vendita B2B sul campo, idealmente in fintech, pagamenti, SaaS o settori affini.
 Sicurezza nell'avvicinare nuove attività e avviare conversazioni dirette con i decision maker.
 Approccio consulenziale alla vendita, con capacità di tradurre le esigenze dei clienti in soluzioni concrete.
 Piena padronanza dell'italiano e una buona conoscenza dell'inglese, insieme a forti capacità di comunicazione e negoziazione.
 Patente di guida B valida e disponibilità a spostamenti regolari nel territorio della Lombardia [dettaglio su auto aziendale o rimborso spese da confermare].
 Cosa ti offriamo
 📄 Inquadramento CCNL Terziario

 🚗 Mobility allowance di €4.800 all'anno
 📱 Internet/travel allowance di €39 lordi al mese
 ⛽ Rimborso carburante fino a €300 al mese tramite carta aziendale Navan
 🍽️ Buoni pasto da €7 per ogni giorno lavorato
 📚 Budget per la formazione fino a €2.000 all'anno
 💪 WellHub (piano Silver)
 Perché scegliere SumUp
 🌎 Opportunità di lavorare in un team globale e multiculturale, nella nostra sede di Milano, un ambiente che ispira ogni giorno.
 🌈 Impegno per la diversità e l'inclusione: fai parte di un ambiente di lavoro che valorizza e promuove la diversità, favorendo un contesto inclusivo in cui le prospettive di ognuno vengono rispettate e valorizzate

 Essere protagonisti di qualcosa che conta davvero.

Le decisioni di assunzione e di impiego non si basano su razza, colore, religione o credo religioso, origine etnica o nazionale, nazionalità, sesso, identità di genere, orientamento sessuale, disabilità, età o qualsiasi altra caratteristica tutelata dalla legge applicabile o vietata dalle policy aziendali. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Golang) - Card Acquiring
jobs.description:
SumUp  enables businesses to get paid easily, process orders quickly, sell online instantly and manage their money more efficiently. We create the tools businesses need to make their business and their customer experience thrive. 
 The  payments processing platform,  consisting of other sub-platforms, has powered SumUp’s global business for more than 10 years now. It’s developed in Sofia by the Payments Tribe, composed of several teams (squads). Each squad is cross-functional, autonomous and co-located, working on its part of the platform  end-to-end.  
 Now, we are taking a major step forward in our Payments journey: building our own acquiring capability in Europe.
 About the team
 You’ll join a growing Payments team working on the next generation of SumUp’s payment capabilities. The team is building and evolving foundational systems that will improve the reliability, scalability and flexibility of our products.
 This is an opportunity to work on a new and important area of our platform, where your technical decisions will help shape how SumUp supports millions of small businesses around the world. You’ll have the chance to contribute from an early stage, solve complex engineering challenges and see the impact of your work in real-world payment experiences.
 About the role 
 As a Senior Software Engineer in our own acquiring team, you’ll help build and evolve the systems that power SumUp’s payment experiences. You’ll work on foundational, greenfield components that improve the reliability and scalability of our platform while enabling us to deliver new payment capabilities to small businesses around the world. This is an opportunity to influence architectural decisions, shape engineering practices and work on highly critical infrastructure from the ground up.
 What you’ll do:
 Design and build core acquiring capabilities, including authorisation, clearing and settlement processing.
 Develop the APIs, data models and services that will form the foundation of our acquiring platform.
 Build reporting, back-office and operational tools for a reliable day-to-day acquiring operation.
 Ensure our systems meet card-scheme, security and compliance requirements.
 Create strong observability, monitoring and incident-response foundations for an always-on payments platform.
 Work closely with teams across Processing, Reconciliation, Risk, Compliance, Finance and Treasury.
 Contribute to architecture discussions and make sound technical decisions in an ambiguous, evolving domain.
 Take ownership of medium-to-large technical initiatives that span multiple teams.
 Identify and help prioritise technical debt, operational risks and opportunities to improve the platform.
 Support the growth of the team through mentoring, code reviews and shaping testing and on-call practices.
 You’ll be great for this role if you have:
 Solid programming experience, including with Golang, and a track record of building reliable backend systems.
 Experience building and consuming APIs in production environments.
 Understanding of software architecture, design principles, data modelling, API design and SOLID principles.
 Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases; experience with PostgreSQL and Kafka is valuable.
 Practical experience with Docker, AWS and Kubernetes.
 A DevOps mindset and an interest in building, operating and improving the systems you own.
 Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to investigate complex issues methodically.
 A collaborative approach and openness to feedback.
 A strong sense of ownership and accountability for your work.
 It would be a great advantage if you have:
 Experience with Elixir or another functional programming language.
 Experience with AWS Prometheus and Grafana.
 Experience in fintech, payments or another regulated domain.
 Knowledge of card schemes, acquiring, authorisation, clearing or settlement.
 You do not need to know the acquiring domain already. What matters is your technical foundation, curiosity and willingness to learn. You will work alongside colleagues who are building this capability together, with plenty of room to ask questions and make an impact.
 Why you should join SumUp 
 Make an impact on a global scale - our systems serve millions of merchants
 Learn from experienced engineers while working on complex, real-world problems
 Be part of a tech-agnostic team that uses the right tools for the job
 Collaborate with SumUppers worldwide on large-scale fintech products used by millions, based in our Sofia office (office-first setup).
 Access a €2,000 annual L&D budget to attend conferences or advance your career through education.
 Enjoy 25 days of paid leave (increasing with tenure), plus paid vacations for special occasions and a 1-month sabbatical every 3 years.
 Benefit from extra perks like health and life insurance, co-sponsored Multisport cards, childbirth/adoption bonuses, discounts, a referral program, 100 EUR monthly food vouchers, 40 EUR flexible benefits, and more.
 About SumUp 
 We believe in the everyday hero.
 Small business owners are at the heart of all we do, so we create powerful, easy-to-use financial solutions to help them run their businesses. With a founder’s mentality and a 'team-first’ attitude, our diverse teams across Europe, South America and the United States work together to ensure that the small business owners we partner with can be successful doing what they love. 
 SumUp is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. SumUp does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. SumUp also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind. 
 SumUp will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate.

 We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

jobs.title: Bilingual Hybrid Development Representative - Mandarin
jobs.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.
 The Hybrid Development Representative (HDR) role is the foundational entry point into our high-performing sales organization, designed specifically to develop the next generation of Account Executives. This is not a static job - it is a dedicated, supportive launchpad and structured path for your professional sales career. We invest in HDRs with the clear expectation that high performers will advance through our specialized sales program, Toast Sales Academy , and become future full-cycle Account Executives.
 The Journey of a High Performer: HDR → All Bound Sales Development role → Account Executive (AE)
 The Timeline of a High Performer: 12-18 months, training to become an Account Executive 
 What you'll do (Responsibilities): 
 As a Bilingual Hybrid Development Representative (HDR), you serve as the critical first step in our sales pipeline, responsible for building and qualifying the opportunities that drive our growth. You will execute high-volume outreach to a mix of prospective businesses with the strategic goal of determining mutual fit for our all-in-one digital platform, ensuring Account Executives receive high-quality engagements ready for closing.
 Complete at least 100 high-quality outreach activities daily (warm/cold calls, emails, and social touch points).
 Host qualification calls to develop an understanding of the prospect’s needs and determine how they can benefit from leveraging our all-in-one digital platform.
 Schedule meetings for qualified prospects, ensuring a seamless handoff to the appropriate Account Executive.
 Learn and execute on various inbound and outbound outreach methods to prepare for specialization into an All-Bound Sales Development Role with the ultimate goal of developing into an Account Executive.
 What you'll need to thrive (Requirements): 
 Bilingual Fluency: Must be fluent in Mandarin and English - able to read, write, and speak.
 Career Ambition:  Must be driven by a long-term goal of becoming a full-cycle Account Executive (AE) and working in a commissioned closing role.
 Proven Drive and Refusal to Fail : Possesses the self-discipline and sustained effort necessary to achieve ambitious daily activity goals and recover quickly from rejection.
 Growth Mindset: Actively seeks and immediately applies feedback, while proactively self-assessing performance to identify and vocalize specific areas for growth and development.
 High Self-Accountability : Driven by measurable results and takes full ownership of daily performance metrics and pipeline contribution.
 High Customer Empathy and Resilience: Demonstrated ability to handle rejection and objections with professionalism while driving positive outcomes for prospective customers.
 Aptitude for Critical Thinking : Naturally curious, resourceful, and thrives on quickly processing new information to solve complex problems and qualify prospective customers.
 Exceptional Communication Skills : Clear, professional, and persuasive communicator across high-volume calls and written outreach (email/social).
 Strong Organizational Skills : Meticulous attention to detail and ability to manage time effectively to balance 100+ daily outreach activities.
 What will help you stand out (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves): 
 Previous Sales or Sales Internship experience
 Experience participating in Collegiate Sales Competitions
 Direct experience working in the hospitality or retail industries
 Note : Toast will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this role. 
 AI at Toast 
 At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.
 Our Total Rewards Philosophy 
We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits .
 The estimated Total Targeted Cash compensation range for this role is listed below. Total Targeted Cash for this role includes base salary, commission, and bonus (if eligible). This role qualifies for uncapped commissions. The starting salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location. In addition to cash compensation, our total rewards components include benefits and equity (if eligible). You can learn more about how we align pay with local labor markets in our Geographic Pay Zone Philosophy . 
 Zone A
 $75,000 — $120,000 USD 
 Zone B
 $65,000 — $104,000 USD 
 Zone C
 $59,000 — $94,000 USD 
 How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process 
 Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring 
 Our Approach to Hybrid Working 
We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region:  https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast 
 People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success 
 At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.
 Apply today! 
 Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. If you need an accommodation to access the job application or interview process, please contact candidateaccommodations@toasttab.com .

jobs.description:

Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.”  learn more about working at Coinbase .
 As a Deputy MLRO on the Institutional AML/CTF Compliance team, you'll execute anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing programs across Coinbase's international entities, including Coinbase Bermuda Services Limited, Coinbase Bermuda Limited, Coinbase Custody International, and the CBIE Trust. This team protects Coinbase's customers and licenses by maintaining robust AML/CTF controls, transaction monitoring, and regulatory reporting across multiple jurisdictions. You'll act with delegated authority from the Chief Compliance Officer and MLRO, leading day-to-day compliance operations including suspicious transaction reporting, customer due diligence reviews, governance reporting, and regulatory correspondence across Ireland and Bermuda.
 What you'll do: 
 Lead day-to-day AML/CTF compliance operations with delegated authority from the Chief Compliance Officer and MLRO, including transaction monitoring, alert review, and escalation of suspicious activity across all covered entities.
 Drive the development, preparation, and presentation of materials for required AML Compliance Governance Committee meetings, ensuring leadership has clear visibility into program health and risk.
 Prepare and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings for assigned entities, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely submission to the relevant authorities in each jurisdiction.
 Conduct customer due diligence (CDD) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews, assessing customer risk profiles and escalating complex or high-risk cases as appropriate.
 Monitor regulatory developments across Ireland and Bermuda, flagging relevant changes to the MLRO and contributing to policy and procedure updates.
 Partner with internal teams including CX, Legal, and Operations to ensure consistency in compliance processes and support responses to regulatory inquiries or examinations.
 Required Skills and Experience: 
 6+ years of experience in AML/CTF compliance, financial crimes, or a related compliance function within financial services, fintech, or a regulated entity, with experience operating in a Deputy MLRO or senior compliance role with delegated authority.
 Working knowledge of AML/CTF legislation in Ireland and/or Bermuda, including the Criminal Justice (Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing) Act 2010 (as amended), CBI guidance, EU Anti-Money Laundering Directives, and/or the Bermuda Proceeds of Crime Act and Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA) requirements.
 Demonstrated experience conducting customer due diligence (CDD/EDD) reviews, transaction monitoring, and preparing suspicious transaction reports or equivalent regulatory filings across multiple entities or jurisdictions.
 Proven ability to contribute to compliance governance processes, including preparing reporting and materials for governance committees and senior leadership.
 Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

 Motivated by Coinbase’s mission and creating a flawless support experience for our global customer base.

 Minimum of 2-3 years of relevant experience in customer support and/or financial services, crypto, technology.

 Phenomenal communication skills in order to operate globally across multiple departments and stakeholders.
 Flexible and adaptable to meeting the evolving needs of a high-growth and fast paced organization.

 Experience at crypto exchanges or in financial services, ideally in payments, trading operations or technical support.

 Finance Analytics builds Coinbase's financial data and reporting foundations so Finance, Accounting/Controllership, Treasury and FP&A can run accurate, timely and auditable operations. We sit at the intersection of data engineering, data science and business analytics: we own the source-of-truth financial datasets in Snowflake/Databricks, the pipelines that produce them, and the reconciliation, month-end close, safeguarding and reporting workflows built on top. We partner closely with Product Engineering to make sure upstream financial data is complete, reconciled and traceable.
 What you'll be doing: 
 As the Staff Analytics Engineer on Finance Analytics, this person sets the technical direction for Coinbase's financial data layer and works side by side with Accounting, Controllership and FP&A. They need to understand how the books are closed, audited and controlled, not just how the data moves:
