jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
About Figure 
 Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale, and trading of tokenized assets. More than 480 partners use its loan origination system and capital marketplace. Collectively, Figure and its partners have originated over $30 billion of loans to date, among other products. The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure’s on-chain lend-borrow marketplace. Figure’s ecosystem also includes DART (Digital Asset Registry Technology) for asset custody and lien perfection, and $YLDS, a yield-bearing stablecoin registered with the SEC as a security under the Securities Act of 1933.
Figure is the market leader in real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The company has received triple-A ratings from S&P and Moody’s on multiple loan securitizations, the first of its kind for blockchain finance.
We’re proud to be recognized as one of Forbes’ Top 50 Fintech Companies and CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies .
 About the Role 
 We are seeking a Solutions Engineer to architect and scale technical integrations for mortgage lending partners. This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Engineering and is responsible for designing integration solutions, accelerating onboarding, and ensuring partners fully leverage our API, webhook, and identity infrastructure.
 You will work with enterprise and institutional partners from technical discovery through integration and early scale as a trusted technical advisor. You will work directly with partners to ensure implementations are robust and scalable. Your core responsibilities will include:
 Designing and documenting integration architectures, workflows, and data exchanges.
 Guiding partners through implementation using clear technical best practices.
 Proactively mitigating integration risks to accelerate onboarding and troubleshoot complex issues during implementation and early production.
 Over time, you will help build more scalable onboarding infrastructure - including documentation, integration templates, and reusable patterns - to enable efficient, repeatable partner launches.
 What You'll Do 
 Technical Discovery & Solution Architecture 
 Lead technical discovery sessions with prospective and signed partners.
 Understand partner systems (CRM, LOS, servicing platforms, identity providers).
 Design scalable API and webhook integration architectures.
 Recommend preferred implementation patterns and identify edge cases and platform constraints early.
 Document solution designs for internal and external stakeholders.
 Integration Enablement & Acceleration 
 Serve as the primary technical advisor during API onboarding.
 Guide partners through REST API, webhook, authentication, and SSO flows.
 Support sandbox testing and production readiness.
 Reduce integration time by standardizing implementation patterns.
 Bridge partner engineering teams with internal Product and Engineering.
 Post-Launch Optimization & Expansion 
 Identify opportunities to expand API and real-time data usage.
 Improve partner workflows to increase throughput and ROI.
 Surface product gaps with structured technical feedback.
 Contribute to improved documentation and integration playbooks.
 What We’re Looking For 
 5+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Technical Consulting, Solution Architecture, or a similar customer-facing technical role. Fintech and Lending experience is a big plus. 
 Strong fluency with APIs and integration patterns (REST, JSON, webhooks), including the ability to design and debug end-to-end integrations.
 Deep understanding of authentication and identity standards (OAuth 2.0, SAML, SCIM) and secure system design principles.
 Proven experience partnering with enterprise engineering teams to implement scalable, production-grade integrations.
 Ability to architect full system workflows and data exchanges — not just explain endpoints — with clear tradeoff analysis.
 Experience translating ambiguous partner requirements into structured technical implementation plans and strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose complex technical issues across distributed systems.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills with an affinity for technical documentation.
 Comfortable influencing cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Compliance, Partnerships) and providing actionable product feedback.
 Experience in fintech (or regulated financial services environments) and familiarity integrating with CRMs, Loan Origination Systems (LOS), and other financial platforms is a plus.
 Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures.
 Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes.
 Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team.

 Base Compensation Range: $131,398 - $197,097/yr
 25% annual bonus target, paid quarterly

While most offers are generally made within the middle of the range, final compensation is determined based on the factors above.

 Welcome to Fireblocks , the industry-leading digital asset infrastructure technology company responsible for 15% of all crypto transactions!

jobs.title: User communications Product leader
jobs.description:
We're looking for a User communication Product leader to own and evolve how Lemonade communicates with customers - across every product surface, channel, and AI-powered experience we ship.

This isn't a traditional writing role. Lemonade puts the written word at the core of everything, and you get to lead it. You'll own our internal system that enables humans and AI to explain complex insurance moments simply, consistently, and at scale. You'll set the bar for what "Lemonade-y" means in practice, and work through the most advanced and nuanced communication challenges we face.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.


IN THIS ROLE YOU'LL:

 - Own product voice and communication quality through our internal system, setting the bar for clear, concise copy that reduces friction and turns confusing moments into intuitive ones - getting to the mind and heart of our users to drive real outcomes

 - Define how we use and scale UX copy, support macros, and AI-generated product communication across human and automated channels

 - Continuously improve output quality through training, evaluation, and feedback loops, and monitor copy quality across all product surfaces

 - Maintain and evolve communication guidelines in collaboration with stakeholders, positioning automation and scalable systems that enable teams to produce Lemonade-quality communication efficiently

 - Act as the subject-matter expert on what makes communication "Lemonade-y," ensuring alignment between human and automated experiences so customers receive a consistent voice regardless of channel

 - Define and promote best practices for integrating AI into customer-facing experiences while maintaining clarity, trust, and brand consistency

 - Bridge Product and customer-facing teams to ensure consistent, clear explanations across support macros, partner comms, inside sales, and agents

 - Partner with Support to identify recurring confusion points and address them at the source through copy, flows, automation, and education


WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

 - 7+ years of experience in UX writing, content design, content strategy, or a related role within a product-led company

 - A portfolio that demonstrates your ability to turn complex, confusing moments into clear, intuitive experiences

 - Deep understanding of microcopy best practices across flows, modals, error states, and onboarding

 - Experience working with AI writing tools and a genuine curiosity for how automation shapes customer communication

 - Strong cross-functional collaboration skills - you're comfortable working with Product, Engineering, Support, and CX teams simultaneously

 - An eye for consistency and the ability to build systems, guidelines, and workflows that scale across teams

 - Data-driven mindset with comfort tracking copy quality, support ticket trends, and adoption metrics

 - Excellent written English with full professional fluency

 - Ability to work in an office environment most days of the week

 - Enthusiasm about learning and adapting to the exciting world of AI – a commitment to exploring this field is a fundamental part of our culture

jobs.title: CLX Property Advocate, NL
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a technically savvy Actuarial Pricing Associate to join the UK team and support pricing adequacy, accuracy, and competitiveness of our European products. You will contribute your actuarial expertise as part of an interdisciplinary team that includes data scientists, insurance Product and Underwriting professionals. Working in collaboration, you’ll help develop and implement new pricing capabilities that blend actuarial approaches with predictive modeling, machine learning, and artificial intelligence.


IN THIS ROLE YOU’LL

 - Help shape our UK pricing strategy, balancing profitable growth, competitive prices and great customer outcomes.

 - Turn trading data into action, digging into conversion, retention, risk mix and profitability to spot opportunities and explain what’s changing.

 - Build a deep understanding of competitor pricing and our position on price comparison websites, using those insights to improve how we price.

 - Own pricing changes from idea to launch, testing their impact and tracking what happens once they’re live.

 - Partner with Data Science, Product and Underwriting to bring together predictive models, customer behaviour and commercial insight.

 - Bring your UK insurance expertise to our global team, sharing knowledge and challenging assumptions to help us make better decisions.

 - Help build a faster, smarter pricing engine through automation, experimentation and thoughtful use of AI.

 - Further your actuarial education through industry research and stay on top of changing regulatory requirements


WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - 3–5 years of UK personal lines pricing experience, including hands-on commercial or street pricing.

 - A strong understanding of how the UK insurance market works, with practical experience of price comparison websites, competitor pricing and customer behaviour.

 - A track record of turning analysis into pricing changes that deliver measurable results.

 - Strong SQL and Python or R skills, with confidence exploring data independently and checking that your conclusions hold up.

 - Commercial judgement and curiosity: you ask good questions, challenge assumptions and connect the numbers to what’s happening in the market.

 - Clear communication skills and enthusiasm for sharing your UK market knowledge with colleagues across the business.

 - Working knowledge of UK pricing/insurance regulations

 - Enthusiasm for learning and working with AI, and exploring how it can improve the way we price and work.

 - UK home pricing experience is a strong plus, as are actuarial qualifications and experience with demand modelling or optimisation.

 - Ability to work from our London office.

 - Commitment in obtaining FIA (Fellow of the Institute of Actuaries) or FFA (Fellow of the Faculty of Actuaries)

 - Master’s degree in mathematics / econometrics / actuarial science / related field preferred

jobs.title: Manager, Enterprise Technical Consulting
jobs.location: New York, NY (HQ); San Francisco, CA
jobs.description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE 

Technical Consulting is Ramp's post-sales technical delivery team. When a finance org needs Ramp to work the way their business actually runs, this is the team that takes customers through that transformation, from complex accounting issues to integration errors to everything in between.

The Senior Manager, Technical Consulting, Strategic leads the team responsible for Ramp's largest and most strategic accounts. You'll own post-sales technical implementation for this segment end to end — from technical discovery and solution design through go-live, adoption, and expansion — working shoulder-to-shoulder with our Customer Activation team, with whom you'll co-own activation milestones and time-to-value.

Strategic customers arrive with multi-entity structures, legacy ERPs, in-flight finance transformations, procurement and treasury requirements, and executive sponsors who expect a named technical leader in the room. Your team is the last line of technical escalation for these accounts — there is no tier above you.

This role suits an experienced leader who can hold two things at once: the operating rigor to run a delivery function at scale, and the technical credibility to sit across from a Controller or VP of Finance and design the solution live.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead and grow the Strategic Technical Consulting team — coach senior and principal-level consultants, own hiring, onboarding, performance, and career architecture, and build a bench deep enough to scale with the segment

 - Own post-sales technical implementation for Ramp's largest accounts — accountable for solution quality, delivery timelines, and technical outcomes across the portfolio

 - Co-own activation milestones with Customer Activation — build a joint operating model where TC drives technical design and Activation drives adoption and enablement, with shared accountability for time-to-value and a single, coherent customer experience

 - Serve as the terminal escalation point for complex technical and delivery challenges — ERP integration failures, custom API work, at-risk go-lives, and commitments made pre-sales that need to be re-scoped

 - Define the Strategic delivery model — scoping standards, solution design review, rules of engagement with CSM/Activation, staffing and capacity models, and quality bars that hold up under enterprise scrutiny

 - Run the function with operational rigor — forecast capacity, balance workload across accounts, instrument the team with KPIs (time-to-value, go-live on-time rate, escalation volume, adoption and expansion attach), and use the data in coaching and planning

 - Partner cross-functionally at the leadership level — Customer Activation, Strategic CSM and AM, Sales, Product, Engineering, and GTM Ops — to align on roadmap, feedback loops, and segment strategy

 - Turn field insight into product influence — synthesize what Strategic customers actually need, champion it with Product and Engineering, and close the loop back to the field

 - Set precedent where none exists — make sound calls in ambiguous, high-stakes situations, document the reasoning, and teach the team to do the same




WHAT YOU NEED

 - 5+ years in technical consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, or professional services — with substantial time on enterprise or strategic accounts

 - 2-3+ years managing individual contributors and owning team-level outcomes; experience managing senior or principal-level ICs strongly preferred

 - Proven track record owning post-sales implementation for large, complex customers — multi-entity, multi-system, executive-sponsored engagements

 - Deep fluency in ERP and financial systems (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Oracle, Workday Financials, Microsoft Dynamics), APIs, SSO/HRIS integrations, and core accounting workflows (chart of accounts, subsidiaries, approval hierarchies, month-end close)

 - Ability to assess and guide technical solution design at enterprise complexity — and to tell the difference between a configuration problem, a product gap, and a customer process problem

 - Experience building the operating model between two functions — e.g. delivery and onboarding, or services and customer success — and making shared accountability actually work

 - Executive-grade communication — able to hold the room with a CFO or Controller, advocate for your team internally, and translate technical trade-offs into business consequences

 - Demonstrated judgment in ambiguity and a bias toward ownership in a fast-changing, high-growth environment




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience at an ERP or financial systems vendor (Workday, NetSuite/Oracle, Sage Intacct, Coupa) or in a Big 4 / systems integrator implementation practice

 - Background in fintech, spend management, or AP automation

 - Experience standing up or scaling a technical consulting / professional services function from an early stage

 - Experience managing managers or team leads, or building the career ladder for a technical IC track




BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

 - Flexible PTO

 - Centralized home-office equipment ordering

 - Health and wellness stipend

 - Budget for intra-office travel

 - Weekly coffee stipend




UNITED STATES

 - 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

 - One Medical annual membership

 - 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

 - Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

 - Pet insurance

 - In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

 - Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)
   
   


CANADA

 - Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

 - Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

 - Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

 - Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

 - Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health




UNITED KINGDOM

 - Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

 - Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay




REFERRAL INSTRUCTIONS

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

 


OTHER NOTICES

Ramp is hiring Customer Activation Manager for Stack, Ramp's purpose-built AI accounting platform https://ramp.com/stack for accounting firms and in-house finance teams. Its agents follow each team's processes across connected systems to complete reviewable accounting work, from recurring tasks through close and reconciliations. You will help customers identify use cases, translate their accounting process into a practical implementation plan, and build trust in agentic bookkeeping through results, impact, and deployment. You will own the customer-facing path from discovery through adoption, partner with specialists on technical setup, and help shape the playbook as the product grows. This role calls for accounting judgment, experience bringing software or process change to life with customers, and an understanding of agentic workflows.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Learn how each customer handles close, reconciliations, journal entries, exceptions, and review today; identify where Stack and agentic workflows can deliver useful value.

 - Translate the current process into an implementation plan with clear inputs, owners, dependencies, validation steps, and human review.

 - Guide Controllers, accountants, and other stakeholders from discovery through first use, training, and repeat adoption; adjust the plan when confidence or usage stalls.

 - Coordinate with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and other Ramp teams on deployments as well as process, systems, and product improvements

 - Act as an advocate and expert on AI-assisted accounting work

 - Turn early customer learnings into reusable discovery questions, launch steps, and adoption practices for the next implementation.


WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - Roughly 4+ years of relevant experience in customer success, software implementation, accounting systems implementation, finance transformation, consulting, or a related customer-facing role; level is flexible based on experience.

 - Hands-on accounting fluency: you can explain source data, close or reconciliation steps, exceptions, controls, and sign-off with concrete examples.

 - Experience translating an accounting or finance workflow into a software implementation or process change, with evidence of what improved.

 - Ownership of customer or client adoption beyond setup, including stakeholder alignment, training, troubleshooting, and follow-through.

 - Clear communication with both finance leaders and hands-on accountants, especially when a proposed automation needs validation or a change in scope.

 - Comfort creating a plan and reusable process when the product and implementation motion are still evolving.


NICE TO HAVES

jobs.title: Growth (Russian speaking)
jobs.description:
ABOUT COLUMN

For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand — builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. All of this results in a complex (and often expensive) banking supply chain involving a user, fintech, BaaS middleware provider, bank, core and the Federal Reserve.


At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. We are a bank and a software company built from the ground up, offering builders and developers technology-forward banking solutions that cut out the hundreds of vendors, middleware providers, and abstraction layers. This means a safer, more transparent, and less costly banking supply chain. Come build with us!




THE OPPORTUNITY

Column's Growth team is focused on managing our highly strategic customer relationships. As a member of the Growth team, you’ll be responsible for building and overseeing all aspects of our customer management while acting as a trusted partner, advisor and advocate for a wide variety of customers. You will also be in charge of designing and implementing the strategy, processes, and content needed to help us scale this key function.

This role has a unique international focus, helping build one of Column's most strategic expansion initiatives from the ground up. At least have of your work will be dedicated to building and managing partnerships with banks across the CIS and Eastern Europe. The rest of your time will go to working with Column's core fintech partners.

Column's Growth team is not your typical Customer Success or Account Management team in that Column is a critical, often existential, partner for our customers, our customer relationships are deeply collaborative and complex, and each customer contributes meaningfully to our revenue. We're therefore looking for team members who are analytical, demonstrate great critical thinking, and have experience managing very strategic relationships.

This role is highly cross-functional and collaborative, partnering closely with Column’s Executive, Solutions Engineering, Sales, Compliance, and Correspondent Banking teams to ensure customers are onboarded smoothly, that we can anticipate and address both issues and opportunities for growth, and that these relationships are healthy and mutually beneficial. You’ll also represent the voice of the customer to help inform Column's strategy, including the product roadmap, go-to-market motions and more.

Success in this role also means having a desire to become an expert on the Financial Technology space and on how companies partner with Column (our customers include many key industry players such as Brex and Carta).

This role reports to the Head of Growth and is an in-person role, where you’ll be expected to work out of our San Francisco Presidio-based office 3+ days a week.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Help establish our customer-facing strategy, processes, playbooks, systems and best practices. Identify patterns and build repeatability at every step

 - Manage all aspects of a customer’s relationship with Column, from onboarding and implementation to ongoing management and expansion of the account

 - Onboard and manage our emerging markets bank partners: Serve as the day-to-day lead for banks across the CIS and Eastern Europe. Guide them through onboarding and own the ongoing relationship once they’re live.

 - Build and nurture relationships across various functions within a customer's organization, identifying and creating advocates wherever you go, and helping find new use cases for partnering with Column

 - Proactively identify challenges and opportunities for growth, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to find solutions in order to move the relationship forward

 - Share key findings and recommendations on market feedback and trends to inform Column’s growth strategy and product roadmap

 - Perform day-to-day activities consistent with safe and sound business practices and regulatory requirements

 - This role includes periodic travel to the CIS region and Eastern Europe to meet with our bank partners in person.


WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL

 - 5+ years of relevant work experience -- strong preference for a mix of Consulting, Private Equity, Investment Banking, VC or an equivalent role plus operating experience in an early stage company and/or selling a new line of business

 - Professional fluency in Russian

 - A desire to become very knowledgeable on the financial technology and payments space. Prior experience in financial services can be helpful but certainly not required.

 - A growth and critical thinking mindset: You’re comfortable navigating ambiguous environments and are energized by the prospect of helping build processes with little guidance

 - Excellent project management: You’re organized, can manage all aspects of partnering with customers, and effectively work with other internal teams.

 - Ability to turn naysayers into champions: You’re a persuasive communicator and understand the importance of being helpful, responsive, and solutions-oriented.

 - Curiosity: You know what questions to ask to uncover and understand customer needs and proactively learn more about the industry, competitive landscape, and product offerings to better support your customers

 - Insatiable hunger for improvement: you’re a naturally curious person, enjoy digging into the data, and regularly solicit feedback




WHAT YOU’LL GET FROM US

 - 🏥 Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans, including options that are 100% covered by Column for you and 100% covered for your dependents!

 - 🐣 Comprehensive family planning and fertility benefits via partnership with Carrot, including reimbursement of up to $20,000 in qualified expenses

 - 🏡 Up to $2,000 (post-tax) monthly rent subsidy for employees living within 2 miles of Column’s office

 - 💳 FSA and HSA account options to enable use of pre-tax money for medical and dependent care expenses

 - 📈 401k plan, including self-directed brokerage options

 - 🌴 Flexible time-off policy - take the time off that you want and need to relax and recharge

 - 🧳 Sabbatical Program - Reach your 5-year anniversary to take up to 8 weeks of fully paid leave to rest, recharge, and pursue personal interest - with full salary and benefits

 - 👶 100% paid parental leave, including 16 weeks for birth mothers, 12 weeks for primary caregivers, and 8 weeks for secondary caregivers

 - 😇 Up to $4,500 in annual reimbursements for backup childcare

 - 🍽️ Catered lunches and dinners for SF employees

 - 🚆 Commuter benefits, including paid transportation to-and-from the office

 - 🎉 Regular team building events, including annual offsite
   
   


PAY TRANSPARENCY

Compensation packages at Column include base salary, equity, and benefits. New hire offers are made based on a candidate's experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers.

The annual base salary range for this position is $140,000 - $250,000 + equity.




WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOU

Column is committed to working with the best and brightest people from the broadest talent pool possible. We value bringing together a team with different perspectives, educational backgrounds, and life experiences, and believe a diversity of ideas is what allows us to develop the best solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.


If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application and recruiting process, please reach out to accommodations@column.com.



We participate in the E-Verify program in certain locations

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products.



Our culture:

 - We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation. 

 - We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

 - We're a remote-first team spread across time zones, so no office to report to - work from wherever helps you do your best work. Just a couple of things to keep in mind: pay is based on where you're located, and you'll need to keep a home base in the country you're hired in. So while we love the "coffee shop today, mountains tomorrow" life, this isn't a passport-optional, work-from-anywhere-on-Earth kind of remote - think flexible within your country, not borderless.



Location:

 - Remote - Dubai



About the Role:

Sardine is rapidly acquiring new customers and executing on an ambitious roadmap. As a result, we're building a world-class customer success team to support our fraud, payments, and compliance-related products as we grow. As an Account Manager, you'll manage a handful of customers and act as their stakeholder within Sardine, helping maximize the value of our products and services. In addition, you will collaborate daily with Sardine teams to help customers meet their risk, fraud, compliance, and payment needs, including risk analytics, data science, integrations, and products.  



What you’ll be doing:

 - Be the primary point of contact for our customers, attending to day-to-day and 'big picture' problems and opportunities and helping maximize the customer's ROI in Sardine

 - Build a thorough understanding of our product, technology, and strategy and be able to message these succinctly to customers.

 - Translate complex product and technology problems into simple and actionable solutions. Be able to manage the solution process both internally and externally.

 - Speak knowledgeably and advise on best practices relating to fraud and compliance

 - Build, monitor, and communicate KPIs to clients.

 - Provide strategic analysis and critical thinking as we plan long-term expansion.

 - Work with Sardine's risk analytics teams to proactively solve new fraud typologies and actively communicate findings to customers.


What you’ll need:

 - 7+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Risk Management, or Solutions Architecture within B2B SaaS, with an understanding of how customers integrate API's

 - Domain experience in fraud, payments, compliance, fintech, or AML/KYC 

 - Experience working within the banking vertical is highly preferred

 - Strong presentation skills for both virtual and in-person meetings with various stakeholders

 - Previous customer-facing experience, preferably with a technical product

 - Exceptional project management skills and the ability to synthesize all inputs and balance the needs of multiple stakeholders

 - Proficiency in using business intelligence tools

 - Your analytical skills are second to none; you excel at number crunching and drawing insights

 - You're capable of translating complex strategies into actionable processes and outcomes

 - You're a natural at building relationships and collaborating with others

 - You constantly think about ways to improve processes

 - You love making customers more efficient as much as we do!



Benefits we offer:

 - Generous compensation in cash and equity

 - Early exercise for all options, including pre-vested

 - Work from anywhere: Remote-first Culture

 - Flexible paid time off and Year-end break

 - Health insurance, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents - US and Canada specific

 - 4% matching in 401k / RRSP - US and Canada specific

 - MacBook Pro delivered to your door

 - One-time stipend to set up a home office — desk, chair, screen, etc.

 - Monthly meal stipend

 - Monthly social meet-up stipend

 - Annual health and wellness stipend

 - Annual Learning stipend



Join a fast-growing company with world-class professionals from around the world. If you are seeking a meaningful career, you found the right place, and we would love to hear from you.



To learn more about how we process your personal information and your rights in regards to your personal information as an applicant and Sardine employee, please visit our Applicant and Worker Privacy Notice https://www.sardine.ai/applicant-and-worker-privacy-notice.

jobs.title: IT Support Engineer
jobs.description:
WHY SOCURE?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As an IT Support Engineer, you are the face of IT for our San Francisco office and a core member of the wider IT team. You will resolve end-user issues across macOS and Windows, keep our collaboration stack (Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom) working, and run the office AV and device lifecycle. You work independently on most tickets, escalate well when needed, and leave behind documentation and automation so the same issue does not come back.

You will be onsite in our SF office at-minimum three days a week and will also be available to provide remote support to the rest of the workforce globally.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Resolve requests and incidents. Own tickets end to end for hardware, software, access, and collaboration issues, meeting SLAs and communicating clearly with the requester.

 - Provide deskside and remote support. Support employees at every level, including executives, in person in the SF office and remotely for distributed teams.

 - Manage endpoints. Provision, enroll, deploy, repair, and retire macOS and peripherals through MDM (e.g., Jamf, Intune), including onboarding and offboarding hardware. Experience with VDI’s a plus.

 - Support identity and access. Handle routine Okta and Google Workspace tasks: MFA and FastPass enrollment, lockouts, group and application access, and shared drive permissions, following least-privilege and approval requirements.

 - Support collaboration tools. Troubleshoot Google Workspace, Slack, and Zoom for end users, including account, calendar, sharing, and meeting issues, and escalate platform-level problems with clear detail.

 - Run office technology. Maintain conference room AV (Zoom Rooms and similar), first-line Wi-Fi and wired network troubleshooting, and coordinate with other IT engineers on escalations.

 - Track assets. Keep hardware inventory accurate across the lifecycle, from procurement and deployment to return and disposal.

 - Improve the system. Write knowledge-base articles, spot recurring ticket patterns, and automate repetitive work with scripts or workflows. Propose root-cause fixes, not workarounds.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - 2-4 years of hands-on IT support experience in a corporate or SaaS environment.

 - Working proficiency in macOS and Windows troubleshooting, including imaging or enrollment, disk encryption, and common application issues.

 - Experience with an MDM platform (Jamf, Intune, or similar).

 - Familiarity with Okta and Google Workspace administration at the support level.

 - Working knowledge of Slack and Zoom administration or end-user support.

 - Networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and Wi-Fi troubleshooting.

 - Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain technical issues to non-technical colleagues calmly and without jargon.

 - Good judgment on security: you verify identity before granting access and know when to escalate.

 - Ability to work onsite in San Francisco three days per week and lift up to 50 lbs for equipment handling.




BONUS POINTS

 - Experience with ITIL practices, Jira Service Management, or SLA-driven support queues.

 - Scripting in Bash, Python, or PowerShell, or low-code automation (Zapier, Okta Workflows).

 - Certifications such as Apple Certified Support Professional, Jamf 100/200, CompTIA A+ or Network+.

 - Demonstrated curiosity and willingness to experiment with AI tools to augment technical problem-solving and streamline IT support workflows.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Product Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT HEBBIA

The AI platform for investors and bankers that generates alpha and drives upside.

Founded in 2020 by George Sivulka and backed by Peter Thiel and Andreessen Horowitz, Hebbia powers investment decisions for BlackRock, KKR, Carlyle, Centerview, and 40% of the world's largest asset managers. Our flagship product, Matrix, delivers industry-leading accuracy, speed, and transparency in AI-driven analysis. It is trusted to help manage over $30 trillion in assets globally.

We deliver the intelligence that gives finance professionals a definitive edge. Our AI uncovers signals no human could see, surfaces hidden opportunities, and accelerates decisions with unmatched speed and conviction. We do not just streamline workflows. We transform how capital is deployed, how risk is managed, and how value is created across markets.

Hebbia is not a tool. Hebbia is the competitive advantage that drives performance, alpha, and market leadership.



THE ROLE

We are looking for a Forward-Deployed Product Manager to help financial institutions put AI to work in their own workflows. You will own customer engagements from identifying the right problem and agreeing on success through implementation, rollout, and measurable business impact. You will work directly with customers and engineers to build solutions using Hebbia's products and platform.

You will be the product lead for your engagements, working with users, business sponsors, and technical teams to make decisions and keep delivery moving. This means spending time onsite, testing workflows with real data, and addressing constraints around integrations, permissions, and adoption. You should enjoy being accountable for a working solution and helping successful approaches become reusable across customers.



RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Lead customer discovery to understand the business problem, current workflow, available data, and implementation constraints; agree on scope and measurable success criteria

 - Work with sales and customer teams to assess new opportunities, shape a feasible first engagement, and identify where AI can deliver meaningful value

 - Translate customer needs into requirements, workflow designs, prototypes, and delivery plans that engineers can build against

 - Partner with engineers on integrations, data access, permissions, and AI behavior; make product decisions and resolve dependencies throughout implementation

 - Lead the day-to-day delivery relationship with customer stakeholders, communicating progress, surfacing risks early, and managing changes to scope and priorities

 - Validate solutions against representative customer tasks, define acceptance criteria, and resolve quality and reliability issues before rollout

 - Own rollout, user enablement, and adoption; measure whether the deployed workflow delivers the agreed business outcome and address gaps

 - Identify patterns across engagements and work with product and engineering teams to turn successful solutions into reusable capabilities and deployment practices

 - Work onsite with customers and travel regularly for discovery, implementation, and rollout
   


WHO YOU ARE

 - Experience shipping software with engineering teams and independently leading customer implementations from discovery and scoping through launch and adoption

 - Experience delivering for customers under pressure, navigating conflicting stakeholder priorities, and constructively challenging requests to protect quality and outcomes

 - Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, and data systems, with the ability to investigate problems and make practical tradeoffs with engineers

 - Strong product and commercial judgment: able to define a valuable first release, assess delivery effort, and make clear recommendations with incomplete information

 - Clear communication with executives, end users, and engineers; able to explain technical constraints and build agreement on a practical plan

 - Hands-on use of AI tools to build prototypes, analyze data, and investigate workflow problems

 - Willingness to own the details of delivery, test the solution yourself, troubleshoot issues, and follow through until customers are using it successfully

 - Comfortable traveling regularly and working onsite with customers, including multi-day visits during discovery and deployment

 - Experience with enterprise software deployments, financial services workflows, or AI-powered applications is a strong plus
   


COMPENSATION

The salary range for this role is $180,000 to $320,000. This range may be inclusive of several career levels at Hebbia and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications. Adjustments outside of this range may be considered for candidates whose qualifications significantly differ from those outlined in the job description.



LIFE @ HEBBIA

 - PTO: Unlimited

 - Insurance: Medical + Dental + Vision + 401K

 - Eats: Catered lunch daily + DoorDash dinner credit if you ever need to stay late

 - Parental leave policy: 3 months non-birthing parent, 4 months for birthing parent

 - Fertility benefits: $15K lifetime benefit

 - New hire equity grant: competitive equity package with unmatched upside potential

#LI-Onsite

jobs.description:
About AlphaSense:  
 AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com . Come join us. 
 About the Role:  
 AlphaSense runs a large-scale, Kubernetes-native platform built on a modern microservices architecture, serving the majority of the Fortune 500. We are moving it to a cell-based architecture, where each cell is an independent deployment of the platform. 
 The hardest part is data. Our platform relies on a broad ecosystem of data platforms and storage systems, including Vespa, MongoDB, ClickHouse, Redis, ScyllaDB, PostgreSQL, Temporal, and Kafka, to name a few. This role is focused on the Data Platform: the capabilities that let engineering teams build, run, and scale their storage at large scale without each team becoming an expert in every system.
 You will help set the technical direction for the Data Platform and build it rather than only specify it. A central part of the work is building the capabilities for large-scale data migrations, so we can create, move, split, and rebalance data across cells and geographies as the cell-based architecture rolls out.
 We prefer managed solutions over self-hosted ones, and we expect engineers to own their storage. Teams run what they build, and this role makes that model work at scale: you build it, you run it, and you scale it. Your job is to give teams the platform, standards, and tooling to do that safely, and to own the reliability and scalability of the platform itself.
 Responsibilities: 
 Help set the architecture and roadmap for the Data Platform and the storage ecosystem behind it
 Build the capabilities for large-scale data migrations across cells, regions, and geographies, including tooling for moving, splitting, validating, and rolling back data with minimal downtime
 Enable product teams self-service ways to provision, operate, and scale their own storage
 Drive the data-layer changes that cell-based architecture requires, including data placement, tenant routing, replication, and isolation
 Define and apply the managed-first approach: choose managed services where they fit, and build and run self-managed systems only where there is a clear reason
 Find and close scalability gaps in data stores across regions, cells and deployment models
 Build shared libraries that give product teams self-service storage capabilities 
 Closely partner with Cloud Platform, SRE, and DevEx teams
 Raise the architectural bar across the organization and mentor Staff and Senior engineers
 Apply AI tooling to data platform work, such as slow query reviews and incident diagnosis
 Requirements:  
 Deep hands-on experience designing and operating data platforms and storage systems
 Production large-scale experience with storages (e.g. MongoDB, ClickHouse, Redis, PostgreSQL)
 Cloud-native data storage experience, including managed data services on AWS
 Strong background in Kubernetes and containers
 Track record of designing and running large-scale data migrations, including live migrations 
 Experience with cell-based, multi-tenant or multi-region architectures
 Experience building platforms and tooling that other engineers use, and comfort with a model where engineers own their storage and run what they build
 Demonstrated ability to land significant changes in code owned by other teams
 A record of spotting data scalability and reliability limits before they turn into incidents
 Ability and desire to design, lead, influence, and deliver on ambitious technical roadmaps
 Nice to have:  
 Experience running storage systems on top of Kubernetes 
 Experience building control planes with Crossplane
 Experience with private, isolated, on-premises, or air-gapped deployments
 For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.
 You may also be offered a performance-based bonus, equity, and a generous benefits program.
 Base Compensation Range
 $246,000 — $339,000 USD

All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. THE ROLE

You'll lead marketing operations and analytics at Cohere. That covers the team, the martech stack, how we measure marketing's contribution to pipeline, and the budget and pipeline numbers marketing plans against. When leadership asks what marketing produced last quarter and what to fund next, the answer starts with your numbers.

The role reports to the VP of Brand. You'll work most closely with the Marketing Chief of Staff and the heads of Growth and Demand and Product Marketing, and every week with Revenue Operations, Sales Operations & Finance. Web operations is part of marketing but doesn't report to this role.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN



THE TEAM

You'll manage the marketing operations, automation, and analytics and data operations staff, and hire where you find gaps. Marketing is growing rapidly, so you'll also bring acquired companies' systems and data into our stack.



MEASUREMENT

The attribution methodology is yours, documented and signed off by Marketing, Revenue Operations and Finance. Each quarter you'll present marketing's pipeline contribution to the executive team and say what you'd change. Your analysts do the same for the program teams in Growth and Demand, Events and Product Marketing, showing which campaigns and channels are paying back their spend.



SYSTEMS AND DATA

Marketo, Looker, GA4 and 6sense are yours end to end, along with the campaign and lead side of Salesforce. That includes forms, nurture, lead lifecycle, scoring and routing. Campaign data needs to be structured well enough that analysts don't need workarounds, and target-account data has to reconcile to the governed account list. With Revenue Operations, you'll make sure the data behind marketing's pipeline numbers can't change without a record, so a bulk edit can't quietly rewrite marketing's results. A/B testing on nurture and forms sits with you too, sized so the results can be read.

Over time we want fewer tools and fewer dashboards, with one governed source for each metric.



BUDGET AND PLANNING NUMBERS

You'll own the martech and operations budget and track budget and headcount across marketing. You'll also build the pipeline and capacity models marketing plans against. The Marketing Chief of Staff runs planning and the business reviews and leads the trade-off conversations with your numbers in hand. Marketing and Sales need to count pipeline the same way, every time.



YOUR FIRST YEAR


In the first 90 days, you'll document the attribution methodology and get it signed off by Marketing, Revenue Operations and Finance. By then we should also have an inventory of every reporting surface, each with a named owner, and your order for fixing the data problems you inherit.

By three months, one governed executive dashboard has replaced the competing decks in business reviews, and rebuilt lead routing is in production.

By six months, target-account reporting reconciles to the governed list, and anyone on the team can reproduce quarterly attribution from the documented method, with change control on the data underneath it. The stack is smaller than when you arrived, and some marketing workflows run on agents in production. Annual planning runs on your budget, headcount and pipeline models.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



MUST HAVE

 - 10+ years in marketing operations or marketing analytics in B2B or enterprise software, including at least one high-growth company.

 - You've managed a marketing operations and analytics team and its martech budget, setting priorities across ops, automation and analytics specialists and hiring to fill gaps.

 - Hands-on Marketo and Salesforce experience with lead lifecycle, campaign structure, routing and the sync between the two. You've configured these systems yourself.

 - You've owned a multi-touch attribution model end to end and defended its definitions to a CFO or executive team.

 - SQL, and enough comfort in a governed BI layer like Looker to check a number yourself before you present it.

 - You've run the data side of an account-based motion, including the hygiene that makes a target account list reportable.

 - You've worked closely with Revenue Operations and Sales Operations without duplicating their work.

 - Experience in enterprise, regulated or public-sector buying environments, including GDPR and CASL as they apply to lead handling.

 - You already use AI and automation in your own team's work.

 - Enterprise AI, infrastructure or developer-platform marketing.

 - You've built agentic or LLM-based workflows in GTM operations and measured what they saved.

 - Product-led funnel instrumentation running alongside a sales-led pipeline.

 - You've consolidated an inherited martech stack, or merged systems after an acquisition.

jobs.title: IP Paralegal
jobs.description:
Perplexity AI is looking for a highly organized and resourceful IP Paralegal to serve as the operational backbone of a fast-growing, full-stack intellectual property program, with a primary responsibility for patent and trademark prosecution and portfolio management, and additional support work across copyrights, trade secrets, and open source compliance.  This role reports to the Director of Intellectual Property and offers significant responsibility and direct exposure to novel questions at the intersection of artificial intelligence and IP law, as well as growth potential across other areas of an in-house practice group.

You will partner closely with outside counsel, engineering stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to run the workflows behind a growing patent and trademark portfolio, maintain copyright and trade secret practices, and support open source compliance review.  You will own day-to-day docketing and portfolio hygiene, manage outside counsel requests and billing against budget, and run intake and matter tracking so that nothing slips.  You will also run our patent rewards program end-to-end and be a go-to resource for IP diligence support and IP-adjacent needs, including commercial and litigation support as needed.  This role requires a genuine curiosity about using agentic AI systems to make the IP program run faster and more consistently, rather than treating AI tooling as an afterthought.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is detail-obsessed, comfortable moving across multiple IP disciplines in the same week, fluent with AI and legal-technology tooling, and energized by building repeatable systems from the ground up so that a lean team can run a large, technically complex portfolio.  If you are a curious person and your instinct when something breaks is to redesign the process, you will do well here.

Key Responsibilities

 - Manage end-to-end workflows across the patent and trademark portfolios, including docketing, deadline tracking, filing coordination, portfolio maintenance, and status reporting to internal stakeholders.

 - Support trade secret protection practices and open source compliance review, including tracking disclosure and license obligations and flagging issues for attorney review.

 - Administer copyright matters, including registration filings, recordation, and portfolio record keeping.

 - Own intake and triage for new invention disclosures, trademark clearance requests, and other IP matters.

 - Manage outside counsel relationships and billing, including matter budgets, accrual tracking, invoice review against outside counsel guidelines, rate negotiation support, and matter-management hygiene in billing systems.

 - Run the patent rewards program.

 - Prepare and file U.S. trademark applications and coordinate foreign filings through local counsel.

 - Run preliminary clearance searches for new products and features.

 - Coordinate trademark office action responses, review watch notices, and recommend enforcement actions.

 - Manage the domain name portfolio and the online brand protection and takedown programs.

 - Conduct IP portfolio analysis, including filing trend tracking, competitive landscape monitoring, and gap identification, to support portfolio strategy and prosecution priorities.

 - Provide support on IP-adjacent matters as needed, including commercial contract IP terms and litigation support (e.g., document gathering, chronologies, and coordination with outside counsel).

 - Maintain and improve internal file management systems, trackers, and dashboards, keeping matter data, deadlines, and portfolio status current and audit-ready.

 - Build and improve the systems behind the work, including intake workflows, filing playbooks, matter templates, and escalation paths, so that recurring problems are solved structurally rather than absorbed by heroics.

 - Use and help evolve agentic AI tools to support IP workflows such as docketing, disclosure intake, prior art gathering, and portfolio reporting, and bring ideas for where automation can meaningfully improve program efficiency.

Qualifications

Need to have:

 - A sense of humor and a team mindset

 - 10+ years of experience as an IP paralegal, with a mix of in-house and law firm experience

 - Demonstrated AI tool fluency and genuine curiosity about applying agentic AI systems to IP program operations

 - Hands-on experience supporting a mix of patent and trademark prosecution workflows, including docketing, filing coordination, and portfolio maintenance

 - Working knowledge of copyright administration and trade secret protection practices

 - Experience managing outside counsel relationships, including invoice review, budget tracking, and adherence to outside counsel guidelines

 - Experience managing a high volume of concurrent matters and deadlines with strong organizational skills and exacting attention to detail

 - Ability to multitask and effectively manage competing priorities in a fast-paced startup environment

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to correspond directly with outside counsel, inventors, and internal stakeholders

 - Demonstrated discretion and sound judgment when handling confidential and privileged material

 - Genuine interest in IP diligence work and in stepping into IP-adjacent needs as they come up, including commercial and litigation support

Nice to have:

 - Paralegal certificate, associate's degree in paralegal studies, or bachelor's degree

 - Direct experience with open source license compliance review

 - Experience running or supporting an inventor recognition or patent rewards/incentive program

 - Experience supporting IP diligence for M&A, financing, or commercial transactions

 - Litigation support experience (e.g., discovery, document review, case file management)

 - Experience with IP portfolio analytics, competitive filing intelligence, or landscape mapping

 - Direct experience with docketing platforms, IP management software, and legal billing or matter management systems

 - Experience at a high-growth technology startup

 - Interest in artificial intelligence laws and regulations

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff (Software Engineer, Acceleration)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

The AI Acceleration team’s mission is to make Perplexity the best place to build and ship software with AI agents. We build the infrastructure that engineers and agents rely on, and develop new ways for agents to write, test, review, and ship code. Our work helps teams move from an idea to production faster, without compromising quality or reliability.



We own the end-to-end development experience at Perplexity, from the environment where code is written to the systems that ship it to production. That includes local and cloud coding environments, build and test infrastructure, code review, and release management. We’re also building autonomous software development systems, where agents take on increasingly complex engineering work with explicit evaluation, verification, and safety controls. We own both the infrastructure these systems depend on and the workflows that make them useful.



As an AI Acceleration Engineer, you’ll turn emerging agent capabilities into dependable systems used across Perplexity. You’ll work directly with engineers to understand where development slows down, experiment with new approaches, and take promising ideas through to production. This role combines systems engineering, developer experience, and hands-on agent development, with a direct measure of success: helping teams spend less time on delivery overhead and more time building products.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Identify, prioritize, and deliver the highest-impact opportunities to accelerate how Perplexity builds and ships software with AI.

 - Work directly with engineering and business teams to understand their workflows, constraints, and bottlenecks, and build solutions that address how they actually work.

 - Build and operate the infrastructure that engineers and agents depend on, including development environments, build and test systems, code review, and release tooling.

 - Make our codebases, systems, and internal knowledge easier for agents to navigate, understand, and use through better tooling, interfaces, documentation, and context.

 - Take agent-driven workflows from prototype to production, building the evaluations, verification, and controls needed to delegate increasingly complex engineering work safely.

 - Improve delivery speed and software quality together. Measure the impact of your work on development time, review effort, and production reliability, and use those results to guide what comes next.

 - Evaluate emerging models, tools, and approaches through hands-on experimentation. Turn the evidence into clear technical decisions, and drive adoption of the technologies that prove useful.

 - Use AI extensively in your own engineering work, share what works, and help colleagues adopt effective practices. Partner with engineering leadership and recruiting to strengthen how we hire and develop engineers who work effectively with AI.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years of software engineering experience, ideally with substantial work in infrastructure, platform engineering, or developer productivity in technically complex environments.

 - Daily, hands-on use of AI models and coding tools, with practical judgment about where they perform well, where they fail, and how to verify their output.

 - Strong proficiency in one of the languages – Python, Go or Rust, along with the willingness to learn other languages as the work requires.

 - Broad familiarity with the systems used by AI product and applied research teams, including cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, data pipelines, and ML tooling. You don’t need deep expertise in every layer, but you should understand how they fit together.

 - An ability to understand how engineers and researchers across disciplines work, paired with curiosity about the needs of business and operations teams. You build tools around users’ actual workflows and constraints.

 - A drive to make codebases, systems, and processes easier to understand, operate, and change. You look for ways to replace brittle workflows and implicit knowledge with clear interfaces and reliable automation.

 - Sound technical judgment about when to experiment, when to commit, and when to ship a pragmatic solution. You can balance immediate delivery with investments that make future work faster and more reliable.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff (Software Engineer, API Platform)
jobs.location: San Francisco; Seattle; New York City; Toronto
jobs.description:
PERPLEXITY API PLATFORM

Perplexity innovates at the frontier of AI infrastructure, search, and orchestration to serve the world's most discerning users. The Perplexity API Platform brings our technology to the world's most discerning developers. From exabyte-scale knowledge indexes to codegen-first agent runtimes, the building blocks behind Perplexity's applications are some of the most battle-tested AI systems in the industry.

We believe these same building blocks can and should power the aspirations of builders everywhere. It's one thing to solve planet-scale retrieval, long-horizon orchestration, and other foundational AI challenges within a single product ecosystem. The true measure of success is to turn those solutions into elegant APIs that delight developers and agents alike. Our API Platform delivers frontier intelligence to thousands of customers: startups, trillion-dollar enterprises, U.S. and allied governments, and everyone in between.

We've achieved incredible scale, yet we're just getting started. Join us to build tools for curious minds.




ABOUT THIS ROLE

Perplexity is seeking strong engineers with a passion for delivering frontier intelligence and infrastructure to developers. Our company builds technology that reshapes how people search, reason, and interact with the world around them. Week after week, we observe increasing demand for programmatic interfaces to that technology. The API Platform engineering team is charged with designing, implementing, and scaling these interfaces.

As a member of our team, you'll work on an eclectic portfolio spanning distributed systems, performance optimization, agent orchestration, and frontier topics that often change with each passing month. Throughout this work, you'll prioritize great developer and agent experience alike. You'll also define technical strategy for how we scale to meet compounding growth exponentials (number of customers, agents per customer, compute/retrieval per agent, etc.).




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Design, build, and operate mission-critical APIs that provide our customers the building blocks for frontier intelligence.

 - Own and evolve the API gateway and routing layer: authentication, authorization, rate limiting and quotas, usage metering, and request routing across heterogeneous upstream services.

 - Build the paved road for API services: standardized service scaffolding, container builds, CI/CD, Kubernetes and Helm deployment, and progressive rollouts with fast rollback, so a new API product goes from idea to production in days, not weeks.

 - Build API governance into the platform: contract-first schemas, breaking-change detection in CI, versioning and deprecation workflows, and SDKs and documentation generated from a single source of truth.

 - Unify cross-cutting capabilities (billing and usage, rate limiting, organization and identity settings, analytics and observability) so every API product gets them by default instead of rebuilding them.

 - Ensure low latency and high throughput through aggressive performance optimization (including on upstream systems).

 - Harden system security and reliability across heterogeneous compute environments, and operate what you build: SLOs, on-call, and incident response.

 - Collaborate across teams to bring novel frontier capabilities into the API Platform, and partner with infrastructure teams on compute, networking, secrets, and security.

 - Continually reimagine the customer needs of tomorrow (and the architectures to serve those needs), while faithfully serving the customer workloads of today.

 - Uphold engineering excellence through design reviews, code quality, and internal documentation.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years of backend engineering experience with Python, Go, or Rust, including significant time building platforms or infrastructure used by other engineering teams.

 - Strong understanding of high-traffic API design: schema evolution & versioning, idempotency, authentication patterns, rate limiting, and performance tuning.

 - Hands-on experience building and operating API gateways, reverse proxies, or routing layers: authentication and authorization, rate limiting and quotas, request routing, traffic shaping, and per-request observability.

 - Experience building API governance tooling: contract-first API design, breaking-change detection and API linting in CI, versioning and deprecation workflows, and SDKs and documentation generated from the contract.

 - Platform depth across the build and deploy path: you have owned CI/CD pipelines, container builds and base images, infrastructure as code, and progressive delivery (canary or blue-green) on a major cloud.

 - A track record of owning a platform end to end: identifying the need, designing it, aligning the teams that depend on it, shipping it, and operating it, while raising the engineering bar for the teams building on it.

 - Strong customer empathy and product sense, ensuring the APIs you build are ergonomic, well-documented, and easy to adopt for developers and agents alike.

Strong plus:

 - Experience with modern AI APIs (including latency tuning, streaming, model orchestration, emerging technical standards).

 - Usage-based billing and metering systems, multi-tenant organization and identity models, and usage analytics pipelines.

 - Observability for API platforms: structured logging pipelines, metrics, tracing, and SLO tooling.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff (Secure Intelligence Institute)
jobs.description:
Perplexity is seeking energetic researchers and engineers to join our Secure Intelligence Institute (SII), Perplexity's flagship research center for advancing security, privacy, and trust in frontier intelligence. SII’s goals are to advance frontier AI security research, translate those advances into concrete improvements in Perplexity's systems, and share knowledge and resources that strengthen the broader AI ecosystem.

As a member of SII, you'll conduct original and impactful research on improving the security and privacy of frontier intelligence systems. Your goal will be to conduct research that is not only rigorous in theory, but practical enough to improve the systems people rely on every day. This work will be informed by the realities of operating general-purpose AI systems used by millions of people and thousands of enterprises, and you'll be expected to translate both your own research and advances from the broader community to practical improvements that protect and defend Perplexity's users.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Develop threat models for emerging attack surfaces in AI-native products, including browser, search, and autonomous agents.

 - Identify and analyze security and privacy threats across AI systems, infrastructure, and user-facing products.

 - Develop novel defenses, mitigations, and detection mechanisms for security and privacy in AI-native products.

 - Build security evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and datasets to measure the effectiveness of different defense mechanisms.

 - Partner with Perplexity’s Security Engineering team to translate state of the art research into shipped security features and hardened system architectures.

 - Collaborate with top-tier academic and industry researchers in SII's external research network.

 - Publish findings at premier venues and contribute to the broader security research community.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - Hold a PhD (or equivalent research experience) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with a primary focus on security and/or privacy.

 - Experience publishing at top security conferences (IEEE S&P, USENIX Security, ACM CCS, NDSS) demonstrating original, impactful research contributions.

 - Deep expertise in one or more of: security of agentic systems, systems security, web and applications security, program analysis, and software security.

 - Proficiency in Python (bonus points for TypeScript, Go, and/or Rust).

 - Ability to operate with high independence, willing to dive in and take ownership, and comfortable in a fast-paced environment where research directly informs product.

 - Clear and concise communcation, translating complex attack narratives into actionable insights for engineering and leadership.

Responsibilities

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff (AI Policy and Strategic Initiatives)
jobs.description:
Perplexity is seeking an intrepid Member of Technical Staff to take on one of the AI industry's most unique engineering roles. You'll work directly with Perplexity's senior leadership to spearhead a broad portfolio of strategic technology initiatives across policy, law, operations, and corporate affairs.

As a Member of Technical Staff in the Policy & Strategic Initiatives group, you'll occupy a front-row seat to the foremost policy issues animating the AI ecosystem. You'll also get a panoptic view of how leading AI companies operate, make decisions, and engage with broader society.

Those seeking to marry technical expertise and broader interests in law, policy, and corporate affairs will find a home in this role. You'll make contributions to Perplexity that defy traditional boundaries, with a bench of mentors who will push you to learn and grow day after day.







WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Your work will be both highly interdisciplinary and firmly grounded in engineering rigor. On any given day, you might:

 - Harness AI agents to research high-stakes policy and regulatory issues pertaining to Perplexity.

 - Build automated platforms for harvesting, prioritizing, and patenting Perplexity's inventions, in collaboration with our AI researchers and intellectual property attorneys.

 - Work hands-on with our Legal team and outside counsel in support of high-tech litigation matters in U.S. federal court.

 - Engineer privacy and compliance systems that efficiently scale with our growing portfolio of frontier AI products (such as Comet https://www.perplexity.ai/comet and Computer https://www.perplexity.ai/products/computer).

 - Contribute to regulatory filings and responses that require impeccable command of AI technology, Perplexity's own systems, and the broader policy landscape.

 - Embed with our People team to implement first-party software solutions for recruiting, labor compliance, and performance management.

 - Participate in meetings with Capitol Hill, executive branch officials, international partners, and civil society as a subject-matter expert on both AI technology and policy.

The above is a small sampling of activities; no two days will be the same, and your work will take you to all corners of our company. You'll interact each day with Perplexity's senior leaders, who will come to rely on you as a creative problem solver for simple and complex matters alike.




WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

No single profile defines our ideal candidate for this role. Here are some examples of people who might thrive here:

 - Exceptionally talented early-career engineers (new grads welcome) who are (1) well-read in law, tech policy, or economics, and (2) wish to grow in both technical and non-technical disciplines.
   
   - We welcome candidates who plan to attend law school or PhD programs in the future; we ask for a minimum 2-year commitment (i.e., you would apply for the entering class of 2028 or later).

 - Experienced engineers at top tech companies who wish to develop policy, business, and operations chops.

 - Lawyers or economists (new JD or PhD grads welcome) who've kept their engineering skills sharp and are excited to reimagine their fields in the age of AI.

 - This is a non-exhaustive list; other profiles may also be great fits.

No matter which profile describes you, we'll also be looking for:

 - Evidence of exceptional ability and 99th-percentile work ethic.

 - Strong technical skills at or above Perplexity's hiring bar for software engineers.

 - Fluency with frontier intelligence tools (such as Perplexity Computer https://www.perplexity.ai/products/computer).

 - High intrinsically-enforced standards for the craft and quality of your work.

 - Strong communication and writing skills, ideally demonstrated via samples of past written work product.

 - Curiosity and excitement about new and unfamiliar fields; eagerness to redefine your job every 3-6 months.

 - Ability to quickly dive deep in any given field and develop mastery rivaling that of domain experts.

 - Unimpeachable judgment, integrity, and discretion to be entrusted with the company's most important matters.

 - A service-oriented attitude that continually questions how company systems and processes might better serve stakeholders.

jobs.title: Procurement Lead
