The Security Applied Field Engineering (AFE) organization is at the forefront of this effort, ensuring that security is a strategic accelerator rather than a bottleneck.

As a Senior Security Architect on the Applied Field Engineering team, you will drive strategic customer engagements and build the prescriptive frameworks required for the modern era. You will transition customers from legacy, siloed security tools to a unified Security Data Architecture. You will partner closely with Sales, GTM, Engineering, and Marketing to help customers transform their business within the Snowflake AI Data Cloud while maintaining a world-class security posture.

 
 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


FIELD ENGINEERING & SECURITY ARCHITECTURE

 - Security Architecture Foundation: Drive strategic engagements focused on the Security Architecture, ensuring robust foundations across Identity, Data, and Infrastructure for applications built on Snowflake.

 - AI Security & Trust Foundations: Support customer strategy for secure AI adoption, leveraging Snowflake Cortex to bring state-of-the-art LLMs directly to customer data within a secure environment.
   
   - Architect trusted Agentic AI frameworks where Cortex Agents operate within governed boundaries, autonomously orchestrating tasks while inheriting Snowflake's native security perimeter.
   
   - Deploy Cortex Guard and AI Observability to filter harmful content and provide transparent, explainable AI interactions through rigorous monitoring and tracing.
   
   - Ensure AI governance by enforcing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and data masking across all AI-driven insights and automated actions.

 - Modern Security Operations (SecOps): Deliver workshops and hands-on engagements to transition customers from legacy infrastructure to advanced SIEM Augmentation, Log Ingestion (Otel/Logs into Snowflake), and Cybersecurity Data Lake.

 - Governance & Identity: Build repeatable reference architectures and frameworks for Identity (IAM), Data Governance, Row-Level Security, and Encryption to accelerate well-architected deployments.

 - Resilience & Compliance: Guide customers through end-to-end journeys for BC/DR (Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery), including multi-region deployment patterns and measurable recovery outcomes.

 - Tooling and Content: Drive the creation of relevant technical content and tooling to showcase security best practices, accelerate new use case deployments, and adoption of new platform functionality.

 - Voice of the Field: Influence product roadmaps by serving as the Voice of the Field to Snowflake's product and engineering teams, translating customer needs into actionable feedback.


CORE EXPERIENCE

 - 5+ years of industry experience in Data, Security, Networking, Infrastructure or AI Engineering

 - Communication Skills: Strong technical communications skills with the ability to deliver compelling demos, whiteboard sessions, and presentations to both technical and business stakeholders.

 - Customer-facing Skills: The ability to act as a trusted advisor and establish credibility with senior leadership and enterprise architects.


RELEVANT SECURITY SKILL SETS

 - Generative AI Security: Deep understanding of LLM security risks (e.g., prompt injection, data leakage) and mitigation strategies using tools like Cortex Guard.

 - Agentic AI Governance: Expertise in governing Autonomous Agents, ensuring "Human-in-the-loop" controls and auditability for agent-driven actions.

 - Data Privacy for AI: Mastery of techniques like Differential Privacy, Data Masking, and Secure Sandboxing to protect sensitive training and inference data.

 - Platform Observability: Proficiency in observability techniques including logging, monitoring, and distributed tracing on a platform level.

 - Identity and Access Management (IAM): Expertise in modern authentication/authorization protocols (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect) and implementing robust Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) models across cloud and on-premises environments.

 - Secure Networking: Hands-on expertise in securing cloud and hybrid network architectures, including micro-segmentation, zero-trust principles, and secure deployment of services like Apache NiFi.

 - Programming: Hands-on expertise with SQL, Python, and APIs.

 - Container and Kubernetes Security: Proficiency in securing the container lifecycle, from build (image scanning) to runtime (Pod Security Standards, network policies, service mesh), and managing secrets within Kubernetes.

 - Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC): Strong background in aligning security programs with regulatory frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR) and managing security risk through continuous monitoring and auditing.


COMPLIANCE & STANDARDS (NICE TO HAVE)

 - AI Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of emerging AI regulations (e.g., EU AI Act) and their impact on enterprise data strategy.

 - Trust Certifications: Familiarity with how Snowflake’s AI Trust Center maps to SOC2, HIPAA, and HITRUST requirements for AI/ML workloads.

 - Industry Certifications: CISSP

 As a Sales Development Representative, AKA "Strategic Growth Partner" (SGP) at Compass International Holdings, you are the face of the company and the engine of our market expansion, directly responsible for driving net-new pipeline for our Strategic Growth Team. In its simplest form, you will educate our agent community on the benefits and importance of contributing to the Strategic Growth of Compass International Holdings, identifying who in their network of prospective agents should be introduced to our closing team.
 SGPs are the future of the Strategic Growth organization. In addition to the direct impact this role has as a partner to the Strategic Growth Managers (SGMs), AKA Account Executives, in the market, you will ultimately be working toward the goal of becoming an SGM yourself. From onboarding all the way through a formal SGP-to-SGM training program, your focus will be on developing the skills and knowledge that line a direct path into a closing sales position within an incredibly driven, high-performing team.
 What You’ll Do 
 Generate new business opportunities to build a sales pipeline through strategic inbound and outbound efforts.
 Outreach directly to prospective agents that fit our ideal persona via cold-calls, text, emails, integrated marketing campaigns, LinkedIn campaigns, and other methods.  
 Articulate our value proposition (technology, marketing, culture, and growth) and handle objections to create qualified opportunities in your market.  
 Partner with Agents to identify referral opportunities and seamlessly transition them to a Strategic Growth Manager for full-cycle closing.
 Collaborate closely with Strategic Growth Managers and Team Leaders to develop successful prospecting strategies, adding value to each SGM’s sales process.
 Drive active engagement with new and existing leads through creative follow-up communications.
 Analyze addressable markets in emergent geographies and create demand for our disruptive technology.
 Collaborate cross-functionally to create new processes and refine existing ones through innovative thinking.
 Document all activities within our CRM, maintaining flawless data management.
 What This Role Offers 
 A formal SGP-to-SGM training program designed to fast-track your career into a closing sales position.
 Direct partnership and mentorship from top-performing Strategic Growth Managers and market leaders.
 A highly collaborative environment where you can actively innovate on processes and outbound strategies.
 Operate with a "glass-half-full" mentality, making a tangible impact on the company's market expansion.
 How You’ll Be Measured This role is measured by pipeline generation and the volume of qualified opportunities successfully created for the Strategic Growth Managers.
 Location Based in our Houston office, this onsite role will have you engaging directly with the local Compass Agent Community and collaborating in person with the Strategic Growth team.
 Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s degree with 2+ years of relevant experience and a history of strong performance (SDR, Customer Success/Service, Direct Sales, Account Management).
 Strong interpersonal and rapport-building skills; a natural leader with a positive, solutions-oriented mentality.
 Self-starter attitude with the ability to exercise judgment, solve difficult problems without direct supervision, and comfortably navigate ambiguity.
 Excellent communication skills; ability to effectively lead client meetings and presentations.
 Highly organized with the ability to handle multiple deadlines simultaneously.
 Track record of excellence across strategic, operational, and detail-demanding functional responsibilities.
 Compensation The base pay range for this position is $38.46–$43.27 per hour ($80,000–$90,000 annualized); with an annual target bonus of $10K-$15K and uncapped bonus potential. We provide a full range of benefits. Base pay is based on market location. 
 Perks that You Need to Know About: 
 Participation in our incentive programs (which may include eligible cash, equity, or commissions). Plus paid vacation, holidays, sick time, parental leave, and recharge leave; medical, tele-health, dental and vision benefits; 401(k) plan; flexible spending accounts (FSAs); commuter program; life and disability insurance; Maven (a support system for new parents); Carrot (fertility benefits); UrbanSitter (caregiver referral network); Employee Assistance Program; and pet insurance. 
 Do your best work, be your authentic self. 
 At Compass, we believe that everyone deserves to find their place in the world — a place where they feel like they belong, where they can be their authentic selves, where they can thrive.  Our collaborative, energetic culture is grounded in our Compass Entrepreneurship Principles  and our commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, growth and mobility. As an equal opportunity employer, we offer competitive compensation packages, robust benefits and professional growth opportunities aimed at helping to improve our employees' lives and careers.

You will partner with top-producing real estate agents—true CEOs of their own businesses—and influence them to grow their business with us. 
 In this role, you will work alongside an incredibly high-performing and driven team, with colleagues coming from diverse and rigorous backgrounds including investment banking, management consulting, law, and enterprise sales. You’ll operate in a uniquely high-impact environment—our Strategic Growth Managers (SGMs) are conservatively generating 15x more revenue per head than top global tech firms, driven by the strength of our market, talent, and business momentum. 
 What You’ll Do  
 - Drive strategic growth by identifying, engaging, and structuring deals with top-performing real estate agents and teams, expanding our presence within your market. 
-Position our value proposition including technology, marketing, culture, and growth platform. 
-Build and manage a strong pipeline with a consultative and relationship-driven process. 
-Develop deep market expertise and maintain a strong local presence. 
-Collaborate with leadership, agents, and cross-functional teams. 
 What This Role Offers  
 -Work directly with decision-makers for faster, high-impact conversations. 
-Engage in a highly consultative, human sales process requiring high IQ and EQ. 
-Build trusted relationships with high-performing professionals. 
-Operate with high autonomy and ownership over your success. 
 How You’ll Be Measured  
 This is a quota carrying role measured by revenue attainment. Deal sizes range from $75K to $5M+ with an average 30-day sales cycle.  Revenue is measured by agent, team and brokerage production volume.
 Location 
 Based in our Houston office, this onsite, market-facing role will have you engaging clients in the field while collaborating in person with local teams and agents. 
 Qualifications 
 - Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of relevant experience 
- Proven success in a quota-carrying role 
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills 
- Self-starter with strong judgment 
- Highly organized with ability to manage multiple priorities 
- Track record of high performance

jobs.title: Data Solutions Analyst
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
In this role, the Analyst will join the Data Solutions team, serving as a domain-expert QA layer between VTS's AI engineering initiatives and its client-facing analytics. The Analyst will apply commercial real estate knowledge to help ensure the data our AI systems learn from, and the dashboards our clients rely on, are accurate and trustworthy.
 ** Please note that this opportunity is located in New York, NY, and requires this hire to work from our office 4 days a week. **  
What you can expect as a Data Solutions Analyst: 
 Apply commercial real estate knowledge to assist in training, launching, and maintaining VTS's AI tooling.
 Support the QA and migration of client-facing BI dashboards to a new data warehouse.
 Build, maintain, and troubleshoot dashboards in Looker to help deliver insights to clients.
 Partner with product, engineering and client-facing teams to resolve data quality issues.
 Develop deep domain expertise across VTS's AI tooling, data, and client dashboards.
What makes this job awesome: 
 Working at the intersection of AI, data, and commercial real estate.
 Direct exposure to VTS's most strategic AI initiatives and client-facing dashboards.
 Real ownership over the accuracy of what ships to clients and how our models perform.
 Room to grow as VTS's AI and analytics footprint scales.
What makes you a great fit?  
 3–4 years of experience in commercial real estate, including analyzing CRE data.
 Experience with a BI/visualization tool such as Looker.
 A track record of meticulous, structured QA or data-quality work.
 Strong communication skills across technical and client-facing audiences.
 Comfortable working in technical tooling and picking up new domains quickly.
 Nice to have: LookML, dbt, or data warehouse experience; prior AI/LLM QA exposure; familiarity with lease or CRE contract structures.
What VTS Values & How We Show It 
 Strive for Excellence  - We know your potential is unlimited. Take advantage of our executive coaches and our training and career development programs available to all employees! 
 Be Customer Obsessed - We’re employee obsessed too! VTS offers competitive compensation, comprehensive health benefits (including dental and vision), pre-tax commuter benefits, and a 401(k) plan. Not to mention the fun stuff - quarterly happy hours, wellness events, clubs, and team lunches! 
 Be Curious  - Benefit from a culture that promotes new learning. VTS offers an education stipend to all employees! 
 Move as One  - We work in an open floor plan to promote cross-functional collaboration. 
 Take Ownership  - Be an owner of the company you’re building with our equity packages. 
 Appreciate the Difference  - VTS embraces and celebrates diversity. We understand the importance of a strong work-life balance. We offer a flexible PTO policy, generous family leave program, and more!
 ABOUT VTS 
 VTS is the only AI-driven technology platform enabling intelligent real estate by unifying industry professionals, investors, and their customers at scale. In 2013, VTS revolutionized commercial real estate leasing operations with what is now VTS Lease. Today, VTS AI is the largest first-party insights and collaboration engine in the industry, transforming how strategic decisions are made and executed by the real estate industry globally.
With the VTS Platform, consisting of VTS Lease , VTS Market , VTS Activate , and VTS Data , every stakeholder in real estate is given real-time market information and workflow tools to do their job with unparalleled speed and intelligence. VTS is the global leader, with more than 60% of Class A office space in the U.S., and 13 billion square feet of office, residential, retail, and industrial space is managed through the platform worldwide. VTS is utilized by over 45,000 professionals and over 1.2 million total users each day, including industry-leading customers such as Blackstone, Brookfield Properties, LaSalle Investment Management, Hines, BXP, Oxford Properties, JLL, and CBRE. 
 VTS maintains offices in New York City, London, Toronto, Chicago. 
 To learn more about VTS and view our open roles, visit us at vts.com or follow us on Instagram (@WeAreVTS) or LinkedIn.  
Pay Transparency 
 At VTS, we pride ourselves on articulating a clear and transparent philosophy around equitable, impartial compensation that will allow us to recruit and retain an exceptional team. The base salary is market-driven at the time of offer and is based on tier 1 market data. The salary for this role will range between $110,000 and $125,000 and is determined by several factors, including your skills, prior relevant experience, quality of interviews, leveling, and geography. 
 EEO Guidelines 
 VTS embraces diversity and equal opportunity in a serious way. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be.
 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. For more information about what we collect and how we use it, please refer to the Candidate Privacy Statement.  
 If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation at any time during the recruitment process, please let us know at  ta@vts.com

jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Implementation is a critical moment in the customer journey: it's where clients first see VTS deliver the value  they bought, and where retention truly begins.  Collaborate with traders, developers, and researchers to evaluate, validate, and improve quantitative models used in IMC’s proprietary trading strategies through statistical analysis, simulation, and empirical research (10%).
 Design quantitative methods to gather and analyze market data, trading statistics, or new data sources and use the result of that research as the basis for new trading strategies (10%).
 Build research-oriented computational tools, simulations, visualizations, and backtesting frameworks to evaluate quantitative hypotheses and measure model performance before production deployment (10%).
 Formulate trading hypotheses as mathematical, statistical, and machine-learning models; prototype algorithms and coordinate with developers to integrate validated research into trading systems (10%).
 Apply statistical inference, optimization, numerical methods, and financial mathematics to diagnose model behavior, improve forecasting accuracy, and address complex research problems in proprietary trading (15%).
 Identify gaps in existing trading algorithms and propose new algorithmic approaches to improve pricing, execution, risk management, or trading performance (10%).
 Define design requirements for new quantitative trading algorithms, including the intended market behavior, data inputs, model assumptions, implementation constraints, and expected trading impact (10%).
 Drive complex quantitative research projects from initial problem definition through hypothesis testing, model validation, implementation planning, and post-deployment performance review (10%).
 Determine whether quantitative models or trading strategies are ready for production deployment by assessing statistical evidence, trading risk, operational constraints, and expected profitability (5%).
 Prioritize quantitative research initiatives by weighing expected PnL impact, technical feasibility, implementation risk, resource requirements, and strategic value to the trading desk (5%).
 Mentor graduate quantitative researchers and interns by reviewing research plans, challenging assumptions, evaluating analysis quality, and providing technical guidance on algorithm design, trading research, and model validation (5%).
 Partial telecommuting permitted.  Multiple positions available. Requisition ID: 4528527101 . 
 Your Skills and Experience 
 This position requires a Bachelors degree, or foreign equivalent, in Computer Science, Financial Mathematics, Financial Engineering, Computational Mathematics, or a closely related quantitative, mathematical, or computational field, and two (2) years of experience in the job offered or a quantitative, technical, and mathematical role or a related position.
 Must have two (2) years of experience with each of the following skills:
 Applying statistical inference, optimization, regression analysis, time-series analysis, algorithm design, and other analytical and quantitative techniques to solve complex problems;
 Designing and implementing mathematical models and algorithms, including optimization, signal-generation, and statistical learning methods;
 Analyzing large-scale, high-frequency financial time-series datasets — including market data, order book data, trade data, and derived quantitative signals — to identify patterns, evaluate hypotheses, and measure model performance, with experience handling data quality issues such as gaps and outliers;
 Applying statistical inference, time-series analysis, and model-validation best practices to analyze data and evaluate quantitative research results;
 Applying concepts from financial theory, financial mathematics, and financial engineering, including market microstructure, derivatives pricing, risk modeling, and portfolio management;
 Experience collaborating with traders and developers conducting quantitative research for use in a quantitative trading environment;
 Using Python coding libraries, including Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn, statsmodels, PyTorch, XGBoost, LightGBM, Numba, Polars, Dask, Matplotlib to assist in quantitative analysis;
 Applying quantitative research methodologies for use in quantitative proprietary trading;
 Using numerical optimization techniques;
 Building options portfolios; and
 Developing trading systems that trade on low latency scale at the milisecond granularity.

jobs.description:
ABOUT CANVAS 
On our proprietary research team—Market Intelligence—you’ll partner with our Investment Professionals and Compliance team to uncover insights about companies, industries, and the broader economy through deep fundamental research.
Canvas is the supply chain research group within Market Intelligence. Canvas conducts compliant supply chain research by developing deep industry expertise, talking with private company executives, and synthesizing information for portfolio managers and analysts – our team produces impactful research that will change the way you look at the world.
 WHAT YOU’LL DO 
When you join the Canvas team, you’re signing up for the learning experience of your life. You will never look at anything the same – from grocery stores to tires to semiconductors. Every day you will speak with some of the most successful private company executives and learn about the businesses they’ve spent their lives building. You will synthesize your findings in comprehensive reports that are consumed by our investment professionals.
Other Market Intelligence divisions do quantitative research to explain what is going on in an industry. As a fundamental researcher, your qualitative research will explain the why. In this role you will:
• Become a subject matter expert on an assigned industry
• Learn from small, medium, and large private company executives about their businesses and the industries in which they operate, including gathering qualitative data on what is happening (e.g., structural shifts; real-time changes in supply/demand dynamics; and emerging competitors, markets, and technologies) and, importantly, why it is happening
• Synthesize your findings in comprehensive reports that present a view of the industry
• Gain unparalleled exposure to, and learn from, business leaders across industries, including private company executives and your colleagues
• Interact directly with our investment professionals and learn the discretionary investment process to help drive more informed investment decisions
 WHAT EXCITES YOU 
• Staying current on the evolving alternative data market and its role in discretionary investing
• Speaking with experts both inside and outside the firm to understand data needs and offerings
• Analytical thinking and sifting through available data to find “the answer”
• Fast-paced work environments that at times require switching gears to address the needs of the business
• Working as part of a cross-functional team made up of investment, research, and compliance professionals
 WHAT EXCITES US 
• Excellent attention to detail, organization, and project management skills
• Superb business intuition and a solution orientated, methodological approach to problem solving
• Ability to collaborate and build relationships across multiple business units within the Firm
• People who “elevate the room” through their work ethic, curiosity, and solution-orientated attitude
• Adherence to the highest ethical standards working closely with the firm’s Compliance team
 WHAT’S REQUIRED 
• An undergraduate degree or advanced degree with demonstrated academic success
• Strong analytical skills
• Excellent written and verbal communication abilities
• An eagerness to find out if your conclusions are right or wrong
• An understanding of how companies work (their processes and outcomes) or an interest in learning
• Intellectual curiosity, creative thinking, maturity
• Highest standards of ethical decision making
 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 
• Integrity – You demonstrate 100% commitment to the highest ethical standards
• Ownership – You take charge of your work, uphold your commitments, and always do your best
• Commerciality – You focus on what matters most, ask questions when needed, and are cognizant about not wasting your time or that of others
• Humility – You welcome and are receptive to feedback and learn from past mistakes
• Adaptability – You can triage business needs and context switch quickly and efficiently
• Admirability – You elevate the room through your work ethic, domain knowledge, work product, and solution orientated attitude
 WE TAKE CARE OF OUR PEOPLE 
We invest in our people, their careers, their health, and their well-being. When you work here, we provide:
• health care benefits
• Generous parental and family leave policies
• Mental and physical wellness programs
• Volunteer opportunities
• Non-profit matching gift program
• Support for employee-led affinity groups representing women, minorities and the LGBT+ community
• Tuition assistance

Point72 Asset Management is a global firm led by Steven Cohen that invests in multiple asset classes and strategies worldwide. Resting on more than a quarter-century of investing experience, we seek to be the industry’s premier asset manager through delivering superior risk-adjusted returns, adhering to the highest ethical standards, and offering the greatest opportunities to the industry’s brightest talent. For more information, visit  www.Point72.com/working-here .

jobs.title: Creative Designer
jobs.description:
About the Client Service Department 
 The goal of Client Service is to build and grow meaningful relationships with the world’s largest, most sophisticated investors and help clients achieve their goals through high quality return streams and tailored insights. To this end, we deeply understand the global pools of capital, develop strategies to effectively develop relationships, and partner with clients on their most difficult investment and portfolio construction problems. We help our clients broaden their understanding of our investment process, strategies and performance as well as deepen their understanding of financial markets more generally.
 About Your Role 
 You will help shape the next phase of Bridgewater's visual identity and bring it to life across internal and external channels. This is a hands-on design role with significant creative ownership and room to experiment and build. You will move fluidly between building the visual design system and designing within it, and you will partner closely with the Creative Director and the Head of External Communications and Affairs to create the tools, standards, systems and assets that support it.
 You will drive the following responsibilities:
 Evolving Bridgewater’s visual identity: Help develop and refine our visual language including typography, color, imagery, graphic systems, iconography, and other core brand elements.  
 Build the brand system: Partner with the Creative Director and Head of External Communications and Affairs to co-develop practical brand guidelines and a scalable design architecture that creates consistency without sacrificing creativity.  
 Turn the system into exceptional work: Apply the brand system across a wide range of touchpoints from retail ads to recruiting materials to our website and social media and beyond.  
 Raise the creative bar: Bring exceptional taste and a strong point of view while being open-minded and able to quickly loop on feedback. Push beyond the obvious solution and continually look for ways to make our creative output more distinctive and original.  
 Create with independence: Take loose ideas and sketches and harden them into strong designs – know when to seek input and when to run.  
 Think beyond individual deliverables. Recognize when a design problem should become a re-usable system, template or principle rather than a one-time solution and help fold it into the architecture we co-create together.  
 Make complex ideas visual: Work with writers, investors and other partners to translate sophisticated concepts into clear and memorable graphics.  
 The anticipated onsite requirement for this role is four days per week, primarily at our New York City campus. A subset of teams, including our Client Service team, operates on a hybrid schedule alternating between our New York City and Westport campuses.
 Minimum Qualifications 
 The right person is much more than a graphic designer. They are a highly skilled maker and craftsperson with exceptional taste, but also a systems thinker.  Someone who understands how typography, color, imagery, layout, texture, and space work together to create a distinctive and coherent visual brand.
 We want someone who is a fountain of ideas, who is voracious for room to run, and who isn’t afraid to experiment and fail.  This person needs thick skin and needs to be able to ingest feedback and evolve quickly.  They need to channel and amplify our brand in a way that is impactful and memorable, which will require a lot of research and development.   This person should be a powerhouse graphic designer with a portfolio that immediately demonstrates exceptional craft, judgement, and taste.
 This person WANTS to spend most of their time doing hands-on-keys design.  They have strong opinions that are loosely held. They can articulate why something works while still being open to being wrong and having the agility to pivot. We’re looking for:
 5-7+ years of professional graphic design or brand design experience, ideally with a sophisticated in-house brand team, design studio or creative agency
 Advanced proficiency in the Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, etc.) and Figma
 Exceptional typography, composition, color and layout skills, with experience designing across both digital and physical applications
 Portfolio with a case study showing improvements through iteration, and proven experience creating or applying brand guidelines
 About Bridgewater 
 Bridgewater Associates is a global macro investment firm, founded in 1975, whose mission is to develop a fundamental, cause-and-effect understanding of how markets and economies work—and translate that understanding into insights, returns, and solutions that help the world’s leading institutional investors solve their most important investment challenges.
 Over five decades, we have codified our fundamental understanding into a systematic investment process—integrating human judgment with machine intelligence with the goal of applying our thinking consistently, testing it against reality, and continuously improving decision-making over time. We believe this has created a unique platform for applying AI within our process, positioning us at the frontier of integrating technology with investment decision-making.
 In financial markets—where reality is constantly evolving and outcomes are uncertain—sustained excellence requires continuous learning and improvement. Our culture—anchored in radical truth and transparency—helps us learn faster.
 Find more information about Bridgewater on our website .
 Our Culture 
 Bridgewater’s culture is anchored in the pursuit of excellence—tied directly to our mission. In financial markets, where the base case is failure and reality is constantly evolving, winning requires continuous learning and improvement. Truth is our most essential tool for improvement, and transparency helps us get closer to truth because it places many eyes on our decisions, problems, and mistakes. By understanding reality clearly, we can identify the gap between where we are and where we want to be—and use that knowledge to learn and get better. Our system that supports this way of being is an idea meritocracy, where we commit to finding and rewarding the best ideas regardless of hierarchy.
 Operating in these ways is hard. Finding truth and learning through it is inherently a high-friction cycle. It’s possible because we share a few core values: a commitment to honesty, high ownership, deeply meaningful work and relationships, and building Bridgewater as a big tent where vast differences are welcomed. These values create the common denominator that binds us together in good times and bad.
 Benefits 
 One of our core priorities at Bridgewater is to enable our employees to build a great life and career, and we believe our benefits are an important extension of that philosophy. As such, currently Bridgewater offers a competitive suite of benefits, including health insurance, retirement benefits, paid leave, and other fringe benefits. Find more information about Bridgewater’s benefits on our website .

jobs.title: Program Coordinator, Investor Talent
jobs.description:
About the Alpha Engine Department  
 The Alpha Engine is responsible for Pure Alpha, Bridgewater’s flagship alpha strategy launched in 1991. Our aim in Pure Alpha is to generate high and consistent returns, uncorrelated to markets and other managers over time. We pursue this by systematically deploying our fundamental understanding of markets and economies to trade long, short, and relative value across roughly 200 liquid public markets.
 About Your Role 
 The Investor Talent team partners with investors across Bridgewater’s investment departments on how the firm identifies, assesses, develops, and compensates its investors, at a time of significant change for the firm. The team is building as it goes, which leaves real room to shape how things run.
 The Program Coordinator role is an execution-focused role at the center of how the Investor Talent team runs. You’ll work directly with the team's manager, leads, and senior investors, bringing tight execution and project management skills to translate priorities into practical plans and drive investor programs from planning through delivery. Your book of work will shift with the calendar, with management of the team's operations and programs taking up the majority of your time during peak periods.
 We are a nimble, hands-on team where every member contributes to the operational work through to the outcomes that make our programs successful (e.g., attending the events that you help shape and plan). We’re looking for someone who takes pride in getting the details right, follows through reliably, and is equally willing to coordinate calendars, pull ongoing metrics, or improve and own a process. It’s a fast-moving environment with a lot to learn, so curiosity and adaptability will go a long way. Over time, the right person will take on broader project management ownership, improve how our programs run, and manage increasingly complex workstreams.
 You will drive the following responsibilities:
 Primary partner in running a tight talent ecosystem: Partner with the team’s manager and leads to understand the broad mission of investor talent, and own coordination at the goal level rather than the task level. In practice, this means owning the calendar, meeting logistics, agendas, and program sessions and materials, and anticipating needs before you’re asked.
 Owner of the team’s management machines: Build, run, and continuously improve the recurring processes that keep the team operating, including review cycles, security, and operations. Keep meetings, follow-ups, and commitments on track across these processes. Own knowledge management across SharePoint, Confluence, and distribution lists, with room to shape how it works and evolves.
 Project manager for key programs: Own day-to-day execution of the summer internship and investor class, from scheduling and communications to materials and events. Translate priorities into clear plans with timelines, owners, and dependencies, and adapt as needs change. Anticipate risks, resolve bottlenecks, and hold stakeholders accountable to their commitments, escalating with sound judgment when needed. Track engagement metrics to assess how well each program is working.
 Key driver of technology and AI to raise team productivity: Use technology and AI to improve how the team works, from automating coordination and communications to streamlining reviews and programs. Proactively look for ways to run things better, and connect the dots across workstreams so improvements spread.
 The anticipated onsite requirement for this role is four days per week, primarily at our New York City campus.
 Minimum Qualifications 
 You have a passion for running and improving processes and take pride in making others’ worlds run smoothly. You are proactive and comfortable holding others accountable directly and respectfully, including more senior colleagues.
 2+ years of experience in coordination, project management, business operations, or a similar role, in a fast-paced, stakeholder-facing environment
 Strong attention to detail and operational discipline, with the ability to prioritize across multiple concurrent workstreams and adapt to ambiguity
 Excellent written and verbal communication with a range of stakeholders
 Ability to work flexible hours as needed, e.g., some evenings or onsite additional days for key program events
 About Bridgewater 
 Bridgewater Associates is a global macro investment firm, founded in 1975, whose mission is to develop a fundamental, cause-and-effect understanding of how markets and economies work—and translate that understanding into insights, returns, and solutions that help the world’s leading institutional investors solve their most important investment challenges.
 Over five decades, we have codified our fundamental understanding into a systematic investment process—integrating human judgment with machine intelligence with the goal of applying our thinking consistently, testing it against reality, and continuously improving decision-making over time. We believe this has created a unique platform for applying AI within our process, positioning us at the frontier of integrating technology with investment decision-making.
 In financial markets—where reality is constantly evolving and outcomes are uncertain—sustained excellence requires continuous learning and improvement. Our culture—anchored in radical truth and transparency—helps us learn faster.
 Find more information about Bridgewater on our website .
 Our Culture 
 Bridgewater’s culture is anchored in the pursuit of excellence—tied directly to our mission. In financial markets, where the base case is failure and reality is constantly evolving, winning requires continuous learning and improvement. Truth is our most essential tool for improvement, and transparency helps us get closer to truth because it places many eyes on our decisions, problems, and mistakes. By understanding reality clearly, we can identify the gap between where we are and where we want to be—and use that knowledge to learn and get better. Our system that supports this way of being is an idea meritocracy, where we commit to finding and rewarding the best ideas regardless of hierarchy.
 Operating in these ways is hard. Finding truth and learning through it is inherently a high-friction cycle. It’s possible because we share a few core values: a commitment to honesty, high ownership, deeply meaningful work and relationships, and building Bridgewater as a big tent where vast differences are welcomed. These values create the common denominator that binds us together in good times and bad.
 Benefits 
 One of our core priorities at Bridgewater is to enable our employees to build a great life and career, and we believe our benefits are an important extension of that philosophy. As such, currently Bridgewater offers a competitive suite of benefits, including health insurance, retirement benefits, paid leave, and other fringe benefits. Find more information about Bridgewater’s benefits on our website .
 Bridgewater reserves the right to change its current benefits program at any time, in a manner that is consistent with applicable federal and state regulations. 
 Sponsorship 
 Please note that we do not provide immigration sponsorship for this position.
 Compensation 
 The wage range for this role is $120,000 - $175,000, inclusive of base salary and discretionary target bonus. The expected base salary for this role is between 80% - 90% of this wage range.

 Present results to your manager and discuss improvements, open questions, and next steps.

 Strong communication skills and ability to work well with colleagues across multiple regions.
 Ability to work well under pressure.
 Good familiarity with instruments of at least one liquid non-equity asset class (futures, FX, cash treasuries).
 Experience working with intraday bar data and researching intraday trading opportunities.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Platform Team
jobs.description:
Voleon is a technology company that applies state-of-the-art AI and machine learning techniques to real-world problems in finance. For nearly two decades, we have led our industry and worked at the frontier of applying AI/ML to investment management. We have become a multibillion-dollar asset manager, and we have ambitious goals for the future.



Your colleagues will include internationally recognized experts in artificial intelligence and machine learning research as well as highly experienced finance and technology professionals. In addition to our enriching and collegial working environment, we offer highly competitive compensation and benefits packages, technology talks by our experts, a beautiful modern office, daily catered lunches, and more.




YOUR TEAM

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Software Platform team, you will design and evolve the distributed systems that power research and trading workflows across on-premises and cloud environments. The team owns core distributed services, cloud platforms, job scheduling and execution systems, and standardized storage interfaces — delivering reliable, scalable services that abstract away infrastructure complexity.

 

Operating at the heart of the firm’s platform, this is a high-impact area: the systems you build directly shape the reliability, performance, and scalability of research and production workloads across the organization.

 

You will partner closely with Infrastructure, Security, application engineering teams, and ML researchers to deliver foundational platform capabilities that improve reliability, performance, and productivity firm-wide — enabling engineers and researchers to focus on domain-specific innovation. This role operates at the platform services layer (not bare-metal infrastructure) and emphasizes distributed systems design, strong abstractions, and operational excellence.

 

We look for engineers who are motivated by solving complex problems through strong fundamentals and thoughtful system design. You’ll work in a highly collaborative environment that values experimentation, clear ownership, and efficient execution. Our team includes experienced engineers from leading technology companies and top academic programs, working closely with infrastructure specialists and machine learning researchers to build resilient, high-leverage systems that power the firm.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Design and implement distributed scheduling and workflow systems

 - Improve job prioritization, resource allocation, and orchestration across hybrid environments

 - Build scalable, reliable platform services and storage abstractions

 - Lead complex projects from design through production delivery

 - Improve system reliability, observability, and operational performance

 - Provide technical leadership and mentorship across the team

 - Lead complex projects from start to finish, which includes gathering project requirements, translating them into a rational software design, reasoning effectively about supporting or dependent technologies, and communicating effectively with collaborators and teammates

 - Provide technical guidance to engineering and research staff

 - Mentor and grow individual contributors to continuously up-level the team

 


REQUIREMENTS

 - Computer Science / Engineering degree, or equivalent experience

 - 8+ years of software engineering experience

 - Proven track record of software design and implementation with focus on correctness, robustness, efficiency, and scale

 - Expertise in a modern programming language, such as Python, Go, Java or C++

 - Hands-on experience developing in a Linux/UNIX environment

 - Design and implementation of scalable services and APIs, highly-available systems, and/or large-scale data infrastructure

 - Experience with data storage and management technologies (e.g. PostgreSQL, Artifactory, Ceph, Redis)

 - Familiarity with job scheduling and orchestration technologies (e.g. Airflow, Slurm)

 - Familiarity with cloud-based data storage, querying, and processing technologies

 - Work with large codebases and experience building modular, extensible, and maintainable software

 - Strong communication skills and a proven ability to explain complex ideas with clarity and simplicity





“FRIENDS OF VOLEON” CANDIDATE REFERRAL PROGRAM 

If you have a great candidate in mind for this role and would like to have the potential to earn $15,000 if your referred candidate is successfully hired and employed by The Voleon Group, please use this form https://voleon.com/referrals/ to submit your referral. For more details regarding eligibility, terms and conditions please make sure to review the Voleon Referral Bonus Program https://voleon.com/assets/Voleon-Referral-Bonus-Program.pdf.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

The Voleon Group is an Equal Opportunity employer. Applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other factors prohibited by local, state, or federal law.

jobs.title: Quant Trading Associate - Options Theory Intensive
jobs.description:
Chicago Trading Company (CTC) is a premier proprietary trading firm specializing in options market making.  Our collaborative culture fuels innovation in quantitative research, systematic trading strategies, and cutting-edge trading technology.  For over three decades CTC has provided critical liquidity across derivatives exchanges worldwide - making them fairer, more transparent, and more efficient.
 We strive to be the most innovative firm in the industry today, tomorrow, and long into the future while upholding ethical excellence. We believe that CTC makes a positive impact on the markets, the lives of our employees, and all the communities to which we belong. Started in 1995 by a team of forward-thinking Traders, we are proud to call ourselves an industry leader that keeps making markets and each other better.
 Are you excited about collaborating in a dynamic trading environment that thrives on teamwork and innovation? 
 Chicago Trading Company (CTC) invites you to apply to our exclusive  5-day Introduction to Options Theory Program — an immersive educational experience designed to fast-track your path to becoming a Quant Trading Associate.   
 What’s included:   
 4 days of hands-on learning from seasoned trading professionals in CTC’s Chicago headquarters. 
 1 assessment day where top performers can earn a final round interview for the QTA role, job description below. 
 All expenses covered,  including travel to Chicago, meals, and hotel accommodation.   
 Key requirements:   
 Able to attend the full Options Theory Intensive from January 4, 2027 – January 8, 2027. Plan to arrive the evening of January 3rd . 
 Pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree. All majors and concentrations welcome.
 You graduate between December 2026-June 2027
 You have a demonstrated record of success (academics, awards, etc.)   
 This program is tailored for driven individuals eager to excel in a fast-paced, intellectually challenging environment. Ready to jumpstart your career? Apply now and seize this unique opportunity.   
 Quant Trading Associate Job Description   
 The Role  
 The Quant Trading Associate (QTA) role is our entry-level position within our Trading and Quant organization and gives you broad exposure to the whole business as you work towards graduating from the Associate Program and assuming a role as a Quant Trader or Quant Researcher.
 As a QTA, you will work in a high-impact role as a member of a trading or quantitative team. You will play a vital part in identifying trading opportunities and impacting your team through dynamic problem solving — including trade execution, strategy formulation, back-testing, data analysis, and the modeling and pricing of traded financial derivatives — while communicating with traders, risk managers, software engineers, and quants throughout the trading day. You will learn all aspects of the trading and quant operation and work towards a role that generates trading revenue or drives strategy development for the team. In addition to the trading and quantitative side of the business, you will have exposure to technology through our combined trading and technology curriculum.
 We encourage competitiveness and collaboration in equal measure and strive to better each other to win as one team.
 What to Expect  
 Due to the dynamic nature of this business, we cultivate an environment of continuous learning and growth through an in-house education department. Through formal classroom work, mock trading, and real-time practical exposure, you will gain a holistic introduction to the derivatives market while sharpening your quantitative skillset. You can expect:
 An introduction to options pricing, theory, trading philosophies, and programming courses
 Exposure to different product areas and responsibilities
 One-on-one mentorship from senior members in the firm
 Opportunities to grow quickly and start making autonomous trading decisions
 Participation in data-driven research for the purpose of alpha generation
 What it takes for you to be successful:  
 You have a competitive drive and are a highly motivated individual that only gets stronger as part of a collaborative team
 An aspiration to collaborate with traders, quants, developers, and other experts to further CTC's goal of providing world class liquidity to financial markets
 You love solving complex problems
 You're intellectually curious and like to challenge the status quo
 You can effectively communicate sophisticated ideas both written and verbally
 Strong quantitative and analytical abilities
 Basic programming skills or a willingness to learn Python
 No prior experience in finance is necessary, but a deep curiosity and a hunger to learn is essential
 Key requirements:  
 Pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree. All majors and concentrations welcome. 
 You will graduate between December 2026-June 2027 
 You have a demonstrated record of success (academics, awards, etc.) 
 You are willing to relocate to Chicago, IL  
 Why should you consider a career at CTC?  
 Be part of a fast-growing, industry-leading global trading company
 Work in an environment that actively explores and applies emerging technologies — including AI — to enhance trading, engineering, and research workflows
 Opportunity to work with and learn from forward-thinking leaders in our industry
 Experience innovation, teamwork, and fun while working in an intellectually stimulating environment
 Join an ambitious, collaborative workplace where there is no limit to what you can learn and what you will be able to contribute
 Excellent growth potential
 Competitive pay and comprehensive benefits package including free breakfast and lunch (and healthy snacks of course!) as well as a fitness center membership
 COMPENSATION 
 The salary range for this role is listed below. This role is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. The discretionary bonus will be dependent upon the individual’s skills, experience, qualifications, and firm performance. 
 Salary Range
 $200,000 — $200,000 USD 
 Most teams at CTC, with the exception of Trading, follow a hybrid workplace model, subject to change based on business need. 
 Our Benefits  
 We strongly believe in the well-being of our employees and their families so we offer outstanding benefits to support you both professionally and personally. These benefits include generous medical coverage, paid parental leave, free breakfast and lunch (plus healthy snacks, of course), wellness reimbursement, quarterly recharge days, and a variety of other benefits focused on providing the best employee experience.  
 (Disclaimer: interns and contractors are not eligible for benefits at CTC)  
 Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We are committed to having a diverse workforce and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, US; Remote, US
jobs.description:
About Pinterest: 
 Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
 Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the  flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.
 At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.
 Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .
 We are looking for a strategic, analytical, and highly collaborative B2B Growth Marketer to build and scale our SMB acquisition engine. This is a foundational role on the Paid Performance Marketing team and the first dedicated marketer focused on bringing small and medium-sized businesses to Pinterest.
 What you’ll do 
 Demonstrated experience developing, managing, or setting strategy for paid acquisition programs, with particular depth in Google Search, Performance Max, and other Google Ads products. Experience with Meta, LinkedIn, and Reddit is a plus.
 Define and lead the B2B acquisition strategy for SMBs, identifying the highest-potential customer segments, use cases, markets, messages, and channels to drive efficient growth.
 Build an integrated SMB acquisition roadmap centered on paid media and complemented by owned channels, partner opportunities, and other scalable levers.
 Develop compelling SMB value propositions and campaign narratives that clearly articulate why businesses should advertise on Pinterest.
 Own creative strategy in partnership with Creative.
 Own performance measurement across the acquisition funnel, including qualified sign-ups, activation, early advertiser success, cost efficiency, and downstream business value.
 Design and execute a rigorous testing agenda to improve targeting, creative, landing experiences, incentives, onboarding, and channel mix.
 Partner with Product Marketing, Product, Analytics, Sales, Business Development, Creative, Finance, and regional teams to bring programs to market and turn learnings into action.
 Translate customer research, market signals, and campaign data into actionable insights that inform growth strategy and product priorities.
 Establish clear operating rhythms, dashboards, and executive-ready communications that keep stakeholders aligned on performance, risks, decisions, and opportunities.
 Use AI and automation thoughtfully to accelerate research, analysis, ideation, and operational workflows, while applying sound judgment and maintaining ownership of output quality.
 What we’re looking for 
 Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Marketing, Business, Economics, Communications, Analytics, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
 Minimum 7 years of experience in growth marketing, demand generation, performance marketing, lifecycle marketing, product marketing, or a related B2B marketing discipline.
 Demonstrated experience acquiring and activating small-business, self-serve, or B2B customers in a measurable, performance-oriented environment.
 Strong command of growth strategy and experimentation, including audience segmentation, funnel analysis, channel optimization, messaging, and conversion-rate improvement.
 Exceptional analytical judgment: able to define success metrics, synthesize quantitative and qualitative signals, and make clear tradeoffs amid ambiguity.
 Track record of leading cross-functional initiatives without direct authority and aligning diverse stakeholders around a shared plan.
 Ability to move fluidly between strategy and execution—setting the direction while remaining close to the details of campaigns, creative, measurement, and customer experience.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders with clear, concise recommendations.
 Demonstrated experience using AI-enabled tools to accelerate marketing workflows or customer analysis, alongside a clear approach to validating accuracy, protecting quality, and applying critical thinking.
 Preferred qualifications 
 Experience marketing advertising, marketplace, SaaS, creator, ecommerce, or other self-serve business products.
 Experience building a new growth motion, channel, or customer segment from an early stage through scale.
 Familiarity with SMB needs, barriers, and buying behavior.

 Lead high-impact qualitative research in our most strategic ads areas : Embed in one or two high-priority problem spaces, such as Ads Integrity, and own the full research cycle from discovery through execution, delivery, and influence on product decisions.

 Influence strategy and roadmap : Partner with PMs and Designers to deliver informed, actionable recommendations, and communicate insights directly to leadership to help shape product direction. Author written POVs and cross-study syntheses that connect findings into a bigger picture.
 Assess where sustained research investment is needed: Evaluate whether an area warrants a long-term research presence, and make the case to leadership for where to invest.

 Provide vision and direction for large collaborative efforts: Lead cross-team research initiatives across the ads organization (and as needed across ads and consumer orgs), setting direction and aligning partners around a shared point of view.
 Mentor and raise the bar: Coach and develop other researchers, and elevate qualitative craft across the team.

 Deep expertise across the qualitative toolkit. Fluency in interviews, ethnography, diary studies, usability testing, concept testing, and other methods, with sound judgment about which approach best fits the question, timeline, and decision at hand.
 Experience in mixed-methods research. Demonstrated success partnering with Data Science and quantitative UX Research to combine qualitative depth with quantitative scale, and to triangulate findings across data sources.

 Strong executive communication skills and comfort presenting insights, written POVs, and recommendations to senior leaders (Sr. Directors +) and cross-functional partners, and tailoring the message to the audience.

 Pinterest is looking for a thoughtful, highly skilled Staff Motion Designer to join the Design Innovation team. You will define and evolve the motion design language that brings clarity, coherence, and delight to Pinterest across surfaces and flagship features. This is a hands-on, horizontal role for a rare blend of motion craft leader, systems thinker, and design technologist. You will establish reusable motion principles, patterns, tokens, and implementation guidance within the design system; partner directly with product and engineering teams to solve challenging interaction problems; and build tools and prototypes that make it easier to explore and ship exceptional motion at scale. Your impact will extend from the details of a single interaction to the cohesive experience of Pinterest as a whole.
 What you’ll do 
 Define and evolve Pinterest’s motion design language – principles, interaction and transition patterns, timing and tokens, specifications, and guidance – so motion is intentional, coherent, accessible, and reusable across the product ecosystem.
 Lead motion direction for flagship and AI-forward experiences, using motion to clarify state, cause and effect, hierarchy, feedback, progress, and system responsiveness.
 Partner horizontally with product designers, engineers, product managers, researchers, and content designers to connect individual feature work to a shared motion strategy and raise the quality of shipped experiences.
 Turn high-craft explorations into scalable design system contributions that reduce ad hoc implementation, improve consistency, and enable teams to move faster with confidence.
 Rapidly prototype and validate motion ideas using the right medium – motion studies, design tools, code, AI-enabled tools, or custom prototypes – to create shared understanding and accelerate decisions.
 Work closely with engineering throughout implementation to solve technically ambitious animation challenges while balancing performance, platform conventions, accessibility, and maintainability.
 Develop or enable lightweight tools, templates, and workflows that help designers explore visual and motion ideas quickly and help engineering teams build sophisticated animations reliably.
 Stay at the leading edge of AI-enabled motion and visual-creation tools, applying them strategically to improve ideation, prototyping, and production while maintaining critical thinking, quality validation, and ownership of final outcomes.
 Conduct motion quality reviews, give actionable feedback on designs and implementations, and mentor designers in motion principles, systems thinking, prototype craft, and productive engineering partnership.
 Clearly articulate the rationale, tradeoffs, and user impact behind motion decisions to teams, leaders, and executives; build alignment around a high bar for motion craft and system quality.
 What we’re looking for 
 Minimum 8 years of experience in motion design, product design, interaction design, or a closely related discipline, with a portfolio demonstrating exceptional motion craft in shipped digital products or platforms.
 A staff/principal-level track record of influencing horizontally across teams, shaping a product or design-system direction, and raising quality without relying on formal authority.
 Deep command of motion and interaction design principles, including timing, choreography, easing, spring behavior, feedback, and transitions – and strong judgment about when motion improves usability, comprehension, emotion, and trust.
 Experience creating or materially evolving scalable motion systems, such as principles, token sets, pattern libraries, documentation, tooling, and governance that teams can adopt across products and platforms.
 Demonstrated experience partnering closely with engineers to implement complex motion; practical fluency in performance, technical constraints, platform conventions, handoff, and quality assurance.
 A design technologist mindset: comfortable using prototyping tools, AI, and code or technical workflows where useful to explore ideas, communicate intent, and improve how teams design and build.
 Strong product and systems thinking: able to connect craft decisions to user needs, product strategy, accessibility, implementation efficiency, and measurable impact.
 Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to synthesize ambiguity, create clear documentation, facilitate constructive critique, and align diverse cross-functional partners.
 A collaborative, low-ego working style with a passion for learning, experimentation, mentoring, and inclusive design. You consider reduced-motion preferences, cognitive load, and diverse user needs from the beginning of the design process.
 Bachelor’s degree in design, animation, human-computer interaction, a related field, or equivalent experience.
 Bonus Points For 
 Experience defining motion for AI, conversational, multimodal, or other emerging product experiences.
 Experience contributing to platform-wide design systems, public motion systems, or open-source animation libraries.
 Experience building designer-facing or engineer-facing tools that improve motion prototyping, handoff, or implementation quality.
 Experience in large-scale consumer products, personalization, or rapid experimentation environments.

jobs.description:

 Airbnb's Public Policy team works closely with federal, state and municipal governments, legislators, regulators, public entities, industry associations, academia, our host community and the broader public.  As part of a wider regional policy team, we take part in many local, state and national conversations at once. We engage governments directly and involve our community and partners in making the case for fair, progressive home sharing rules. Our work is organized in local campaign pods that draw on a wide range of tools: detailed policy analysis, strategic partnerships, policy media, community organizing, digital tactics, polling, data science and research, and persuasive policy narratives.

 The Public Policy Campaign Manager leads the design and execution of successful policy campaigns in Mexico, working with the Public Policy Lead on both daily operations and overall strategy. You will draft and run integrated engagement plans, using in-person and digital tools to move key stakeholders toward specific policy goals in response to active or developing legislation and regulation.
 A central part of the role is building trust with local authorities. You will help them understand the contribution our community makes, and engage them in creating fair legal and regulatory frameworks that embrace the potential of the sharing economy.
 You are meticulously organized, detail-oriented and focused on solutions. You see the big picture, prioritize strategically, and know which information and data to escalate to leadership.  At least 10 years of experience in public policy, direct lobbying or government relations in a business, political, governmental, legislative or regulatory context, such as tourism and accommodation, e-commerce and platform regulation, housing and landlord/tenant law, or tax.
 Proven experience managing complex regulatory and political issues, whether in-house, as a consultant, or in politics, campaigns or advocacy groups.

La personne responsable de la qualité doit faire fonctionner le programme de qualité sur terrain : s’assurer que les équipes d’assurance qualité (AQ) des partenaires sont calibrées et responsables, traduire les normes de qualité en comportements chez les partenaires, déceler tôt les tendances de rendement et mener les actions qui comblent les écarts. Elle agira aussi comme mentor auprès d’un groupe de responsables de la qualité des partenaires, qui travaillent directement avec les partenaires pour gérer et améliorer le rendement. Elle travaillera également en collaboration directe avec les dirigeants de la qualité de nos différents partenaires qui soutiennent l’anglais mondial. Elle orientera l’attention et l’énergie de ces équipes vers ce qui compte, éliminera les obstacles, aidera à cerner les occasions d’amélioration et maintiendra l’ensemble du programme de qualité GE selon une norme uniforme.
 Une journée type : 
 Exécution du programme de qualité GE 
 Assurer l’exécution quotidienne du programme de qualité GE pour toutes les gammes de services du palier de volume (R1, R2, R3, DSS, S&E, DMHS, RIT) et pour tous les sites partenaires GE.
 Veiller à ce que les cibles hebdomadaires d’évaluation AQ soient atteintes dans tous les sites et toutes les gammes de services; surveiller l’exhaustivité des évaluations, la précision de la calibration et les activités d’accompagnement (coaching) au sein du portefeuille GE.
 Maintenir la cadence hebdomadaire des rapports sur le rendement AQ, afin que les équipes AQ des partenaires et les gestionnaires des opérations des partenaires reçoivent chaque semaine des données de qualité à jour, exactes et exploitables.
 Gouvernance du réseau de partenaires et responsabilisation 
 Responsabiliser les équipes AQ des partenaires GE à l’égard des résultats de la fiche de rendement : cibles de saturation des agents, exhaustivité des évaluations, précision de la calibration, efficacité de l’accompagnement et perspectives exploitables.
 Maintenir un engagement régulier avec les équipes de qualité des partenaires : rencontres hebdomadaires d’harmonisation et harmonisation sur les résultats et les actions issus des revues d’affaires mensuelles.
 Faire remonter les écarts de rendement des partenaires et établir des plans d’action documentés lorsque la situation le justifie; saisir la haute direction des situations qui l’exigent.
 Gérer le processus d’intégration de tout nouveau site partenaire GE qui entre en service, en veillant à ce qu’il soit calibré selon les normes de qualité GE avant son expansion.
 Calibration et harmonisation 
 Mener des séances de calibration auprès des sites partenaires GE; assurer la rigueur de la calibration afin que la qualité GE soit mesurée de façon uniforme, peu importe le partenaire ou la région géographique.
 Favoriser l’harmonisation de l’AQ entre les équipes de la qualité et celles de la prestation de services.
 Perspectives, corrélation avec le NPS et indicateur phare AQS 
 Superviser l’analyse des détracteurs du NPS afin de cerner les causes d’insatisfaction; collaborer avec la prestation de services, la formation et les autres parties prenantes pour tirer parti des occasions d’amélioration.
 Établir la corrélation entre les résultats de qualité, les résultats opérationnels et les indicateurs clés de rendement (ICR); orienter l’attention et les efforts de qualité en conséquence, selon les mesures opérationnelles qui exigent une attention particulière.
 Veiller à ce que les perspectives de qualité GE soient intégrées au récit hebdomadaire du rendement des partenaires : lorsque les scores baissent d’une semaine à l’autre, comprendre les facteurs et la cause fondamentale, et être en mesure de les expliquer lors des revues hebdomadaires.
 Initiatives interfonctionnelles 
 Collaborer avec l’équipe de formation GE sur des initiatives clés, comme le Training Flight Simulator et AirReady; le rôle de la qualité est de s’assurer que les documents de formation liés à la qualité sont alignés sur notre cadre Lead With Hospitality.
 Agir à titre de porte-parole de la qualité GE au sein des groupes de travail interfonctionnels, lorsque les constats de qualité ont des répercussions directes sur des changements de processus ou de contenu.
 Dégager des évaluations GE les tendances qui signalent des lacunes de politique, des défaillances de flux de travail ou des problèmes de produit, et pas seulement des occasions d’accompagnement individuel. Lorsque la même erreur d’enquête apparaît dans trois sites partenaires différents au cours de la même semaine, il s’agit d’un problème systémique qui doit être consigné dans OneTrack, et non d’une simple note d’accompagnement.
 Rapports et cadences opérationnelles 
 Être responsable de la contribution de GE au cadre mondial de production de rapports sur la qualité : données hebdomadaires sur les ICR par site et par langue (NPS, taux de réouverture, AQS, 0-60, débit de traitement), soumises de façon exacte et dans les délais dans le cadre du déploiement des rapports automatisés, qui remplace le processus actuel de validation manuelle des diapositives.
 S’assurer que les sites partenaires GE soumettent leurs propres récits sur les ICR, et que ceux-ci sont substantiels, et non de simples résumés généraux ou des chiffres inexacts. Le rôle du ou de la responsable QI est de vérifier la qualité du récit, et pas seulement les chiffres; ce poste doit veiller à ce que cette norme soit respectée dans les cinq réseaux de partenaires.
 Maintenir le calendrier GE des points de contact de qualité : revues hebdomadaires du rendement des partenaires, séances mensuelles de calibration, revues d’affaires mensuelles des partenaires et évaluations trimestrielles des capacités des partenaires de type COPC; veiller à ce que l’équipe des responsables QI soit préparée et présente à chacune d’elles.
 Votre expertise : 
 8 ans ou plus d’expérience en qualité, en exploitation ou dans un domaine connexe du soutien à la communauté ou à la clientèle, dont une expérience directe de la gestion de programmes d’AQ au sein de réseaux d'impartition de processus d'affaires ( BPO) ou de partenaires.
 Baccalauréat exigé, de préférence dans un domaine connexe.
 Expérience démontrée de la responsabilisation des partenaires d’impartition de processus d’affaires (BPO) : animation de séances de calibration, gestion des fiches de rendement AQ des partenaires, rédaction et exécution de plans d’amélioration, et responsabilisation des gestionnaires AQ des d'impartition de processus d'affaires ( BPO) à l’égard des normes de rendement dans un contexte de gouvernance.
 Connaissance pratique de la méthodologie COPC; capacité d’appliquer les normes d’évaluation, les exigences d’échantillonnage et la gouvernance de la calibration de COPC dans un environnement opérationnel réel regroupant plusieurs partenaires.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant, Consolidations
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 
 The Community You Will Join:  
 We are the Consolidations & Intercompany team within Accounting & Reporting. We consolidate Airbnb's financial results across its global legal entities and manage the intercompany activity that connects them, so the books stay accurate, compliant with US GAAP, and closed on time. You will work across Finance, partnering with Treasury, Tax, and Finance Systems on funding, transfer pricing, and process optimization. 
 The Difference You Will Make: 
 As Senior Accountant, Consolidations, you will support the day-to-day and key intercompany and consolidations accounting activities, particularly during month-end close, where success means hitting each business day milestone. You will serve as a resource on intercompany topics across the wider Finance organization, including support for internal and external audit requests. You will challenge how things are done today and carry better ways of working through to implementation, in our processes and in the ones we share with cross-functional partners. 
 A Typical Day:  
 Own your assigned close areas from start to finish, preparing and posting monthly intercompany and consolidation journal entries and reconciliations by the close milestone dates, including global funding and settlements, ad hoc cash transfers, recharges, and eliminations like intercompany profit.
 Prepare and post journal entries for foreign currency transactions, redenominations, and translation adjustments.
 Work with Treasury on cash pool and intercompany funding accounting, including settlements with FX, accrued and capitalized interest, and reconciliations.
 Work with Treasury, Tax, and other Controlling teams to clear intercompany imbalances and close blockers, raising risks early with a proposed fix, and serve as a resource on intercompany topics such as consolidation and eliminations (ASC 810), foreign currency, and capital transactions.
 Keep documentation, workpapers, and SOPs current so the work is repeatable and audit-ready, and respond to internal, external, and statutory audit requests.
 Cut manual work out of the close. Start with the entries and reconciliations within our team, then take on the processes we share with Tax, Treasury, and other partners, to shorten the close and reduce control risk.
 Core working hours: 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM Pacific Time (11:30 AM to 8:30 PM Eastern Time)
 Additional flexibility required during month-end close
 Your Expertise: 
 BS/BA in Accounting and a CPA or Chartered Accountant.
 4+ years of accounting experience, with at least 1 year in month-end close.
 Experience automating accounting or close work, including using AI tools to drive efficiency gains, and advanced Excel for analyzing large data sets.
 Experience improving controls and reconciliation processes that keep working as volume and complexity increase.
 Experience owning an assigned close area or workstream end to end with minimal oversight, and a record of spotting problems early and proposing fixes that go beyond the minimum.
 Experience learning a new accounting area or system quickly and applying it in a live close, working with partners across Finance to resolve issues, and communicating clearly in English, in writing and verbally.
 Preferred: public accounting experience; direct intercompany accounting experience, especially capital transactions and FX accounting under US GAAP (ASC 830); SQL or another database query language; experience with a large-scale ERP.
