jobs.title: Senior Lead Quality, Global English
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 
 The Community You Will Join:  
 The Quality Lead for Global English supports the largest segment of Airbnb's Community Support partner network, the Global English Volume Tier. This lead oversees the day-to-day quality operation across multiple BPO partners, spanning Resolutions 1, 2, and 3, Dedicated Service Support, Services & Experiences, Dedicated Managed Host Support, and Review Integrity, across roughly 5,000+ GE-language agents globally.
 The Difference You Will Make: 
 This is an execution and leadership role. The Quality Lead is responsible for making the quality program work on the ground: ensuring partner QA teams are calibrated and accountable, translating quality standards into partner behavior, surfacing performance trends early, and driving the actions that close gaps. This Lead will also mentor a group of Partner Quality Leads, who work directly with partners to manage and drive performance; this individual will also work directly with Quality Leaders across our different partners supporting Global English. This Lead will direct the focus and energy of these teams toward what matters, remove blockers, help address areas of opportunity, and hold the overall GE quality program to a consistent standard.
 A Typical Day:  
 GE Quality Program Execution 
 Own the day-to-day execution of the GE quality program across all Volume Tier service lines (R1, R2, R3, DSS, S&E, DMHS, RIT) and all GE partner sites.
 Ensure weekly QA evaluation targets are met across all sites and service lines; monitor evaluation completeness, calibration accuracy, and coaching activity within the GE portfolio.
 Maintain the weekly QA performance reporting cadence, ensuring partner QA teams and Partner Operations Managers receive timely, accurate, and actionable quality data each week.
 Partner Network Governance & Accountability 
 Hold GE partner QA teams accountable to the Performance Scorecard results: Agent Saturation Targets, Evaluation Completeness, Calibration Accuracy, Coaching Effectiveness, Actionable Insights.
 Maintain regular engagement with Partner Quality teams: weekly alignment cadences and alignment on monthly business reviews results and actions.
 Escalate partner performance gaps and establish documented action plans where warranted; escalation to the Sr. Leadership for situations that require escalation.
 Manage the New Site Onboarding process for any new GE partner sites that come online, ensuring they are calibrated to GE quality standards before they scale.
 Calibration & Alignment 
 Conduct calibration sessions across GE partner sites; ensure calibration rigor, so that GE quality is being measured consistently regardless of partner or geography.
 Drive QA alignment across Quality and Delivery teams. 
 Insights, NPS Correlation & the AQS North Star 
 Oversee NPS Detractor Analysis Insights, to identify drivers of dissatisfaction; work with Delivery, Training, and other stakeholders to address areas of opportunity. 
 Correlate quality results to operational outcomes and KPIs; place quality focus and emphasis accordingly, based on operational measures that require attention. 
 Ensure GE quality insights are integrated into the weekly partner performance narrative: when scores drop week-over-week, understand drivers and root cause; be able to explain in weekly reviews. 
 Cross-Functional Initiatives 
 Partner with the GE Training team on critical initiatives, such as Training Flight Simulator and AirReady; Quality's role is to ensure training artifacts related to Quality are aligned to to our Lead With Hospitality framework.
 Participate as the GE quality voice in cross-functional working groups, where quality findings have direct implications for process or content change. 
 Surface patterns from GE evaluations that signal policy gaps, workflow failures, or product issues — not just agent-level coaching opportunities. When the same investigation error appears across three different partner sites in the same week, that is a systemic issue that belongs in OneTrack, not a coaching note.
 Reporting & Operational Cadences 
 Own the GE contribution to the global Quality reporting framework: weekly KPI data by site and language (NPS, Reopen Rate, AQS, 0–60, Throughput) submitted accurately and on time as part of the automated reporting rollout, replacing the current manual slide validation process.
 Ensure GE partner sites are submitting their own KPI narratives with substance — not high-level summaries or incorrect figures. The QI Lead's job is to verify narrative quality, not just numbers; this role's job is to ensure that standard is held across all five partner networks.
 Maintain the GE calendar of quality touchpoints: weekly partner performance reviews, monthly calibration sessions, monthly partner business reviews, and quarterly COPC-style partner capability assessments — and ensure the QI Lead team is prepared and present for each.
 Your Expertise: 
 8+ years of experience in Community/Customer Support Quality, Operations, or a related field, with direct experience managing QA programs across BPO or partner networks.
 Bachelor's Degree, preferably in related field required.
 Demonstrated experience driving partner BPO accountability: running calibration sessions, managing partner QA scorecards, writing and executing improvement plans, and holding BPO QA managers to performance standards in a governance context.
 Working knowledge of COPC methodology; able to apply COPC evaluation standards, sampling requirements, and calibration governance in a live multi-partner operational environment.
 Strong analytical skills: able to read weekly QA performance data, diagnose root causes behind score movements (tenure mix, calibration drift, form changes, workflow updates), and translate that diagnosis into a clear narrative for Delivery and partner leadership.
 Experience with QA tooling platforms — Observe.AI, NICE QC, or equivalent — including form design, calibration management, and partner site onboarding.
 Excellent written and verbal communication; able to write a sharp partner performance email, run a productive calibration session across time zones, and present quality findings to senior Delivery stakeholders with confidence.
 Preferred 
 Experience in a BPO or multi-site QA role, either in-house at a BPO or as a client-side quality manager managing multiple BPO partners simultaneously.
 Six Sigma Green Belt or equivalent structured problem-solving background.
 Background working with analytics teams on QA-to-NPS or QA-to-CSAT correlation analysis; experience using AQS (Ambassador Quality Score) or equivalent composite agent performance metrics.
 Familiarity with cross-functional quality improvement programs — investigation skills initiatives, coaching ambassador programs, agent messaging tone efforts — and experience coordinating quality's role in multi-team rollouts.
 Your Location: 
 This position is Canada - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.
 The Weather and Degraded Roads Perception team builds features that enable the Waymo driver to behave safely and comfortably in the presence of rain, fog, snow, ice, potholes, unpaved roads, trenches, and construction sites. In collaboration with the planner and control teams, we think broadly about how we want the vehicle to behave in these conditions and make every effort to accomplish our goals. Most of the team's work consists of designing new perception features, developing and retraining ML models, and building hybrid onboard/offboard systems to coordinate fleetwide behaviors. We also work with Vision Language Models (VLMs) to enable appropriate driving behavior in long-tail situations.

 MS or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics or equivalent

 Familiarity with Tensorflow or Pytorch or JAX

jobs.title: Directeur(trice), Appels d'offres, Stratégie et tarification
jobs.description:
Chez Lyft, notre mission est de servir et de connecter. Nous y parvenons en favorisant un environnement de travail où chacun trouve sa place et a la possibilité de s'épanouir.
 Le directeur ou la directrice, Stratégie des appels d’offres et tarification, dirige la façon dont Lyft Urban Solutions repère, élabore et remporte de nouvelles affaires. Ce poste réunit au sein d’une même fonction la stratégie commerciale, l’intelligence d’affaires, la planification de la demande et la gestion des appels d’offres. À titre de partenaire stratégique et de bras droit du chef de la stratégie commerciale et de la livraison, la personne titulaire pilote l'entièreté du cycle de poursuite des occasions d’affaires soit de la stratégie de marché et du positionnement avant les appels d’offres jusqu’au dépôt des soumissions et au transfert aux équipes de réalisation. Nous recherchons un ou une stratège aussi solide sur les plans commercial, technique et financier, qui dirige avec assurance ses équipes et des équipes multifonctionnelles.
 Lyft Solutions Urbaines (souvent appelé LUS) crée des programmes de vélos et de trottinettes en libre-service que les usagers adorent, dont les villes ont besoin et que les exploitants apprécient. Nous concevons, fabriquons et soutenons les vélos et la technologie des stations qui font fonctionner des programmes de vélopartage dans des villes du monde entier, dont BIXI. Notre équipe de Montréal est au cœur de ce travail : elle réunit sous un même toit les équipes d'ingénierie, de fabrication, de chaîne d'approvisionnement, d'opérations, de marketing et commerciales.
 Responsabilités: 
 Stratégie commerciale, intelligence d’affaires et planification de la demande 
 Définir la stratégie commerciale avec le chef de la stratégie commerciale et de la livraison, notamment les marchés cibles, les régions prioritaires et les priorités de croissance.
 Diriger le ou la gestionnaire, Stratégie commerciale et planification de la demande, en matière de planification, de politique de tarification, d’intelligence d’affaires et de planification de la demande.
 Développer une intelligence d’affaires et une veille sur les appels d’offres (marchés, clients, concurrents et approvisionnement) qui orientent la stratégie, le carnet d’occasions et les décisions de poursuite.
 Assumer la planification de la demande et les prévisions du carnet d’occasions, en arrimant la capacité et les ressources de l’équipe des appels d’offres aux occasions anticipées et aux cibles de revenus.
 Avant l’appel d’offres, capture et décision de soumissionner 
 Responsable du processus à jalons décisionnels que suivent toutes les occasions en avant des appels d’offres, en cohérence avec la stratégie commerciale et les régions cibles.
 Réaliser des plans de capture pour les occasions stratégiques et ciblées, afin de façonner les occasions bien avant la publication des appels d’offres.
 Formuler les recommandations de soumissionner ou non, en présentant à la haute direction une vision claire de l’adéquation stratégique, du chemin vers le succès, des risques et du rendement financier.
 Stratégie et exécution des soumissions 
 Positionner chaque soumission pour gagner : définir dès le lancement les thèmes gagnants, la proposition de valeur, les éléments de différenciation concurrentielle et le positionnement tarifaire.
 Façonner les solutions et les offres commerciales avec les équipes d’exploitation, techniques, des finances et des affaires juridiques, afin qu’elles soient concurrentielles, réalisables et rentables.
 Élaborer et remettre en question les modèles financiers, la tarification et les analyses de rentabilisation des soumissions, en veillant à ce que chaque soumission respecte les seuils de marge convenus.
 Instaurer une planification rigoureuse des soumissions, avec des jalons, des étapes de revue, des responsables et des échéances claires.
 Leadership et partenariats 
 Diriger et faire grandir une équipe composée de gestionnaires d’appels d’offres, de spécialistes, de coordonnateurs et coordonnatrices ainsi que du ou de la gestionnaire, Stratégie commerciale et planification de la demande, comme une seule fonction très performante.
 Diriger avec autorité les équipes multifonctionnelles de soumission et tenir les contributeurs responsables du respect des échéances.
 Prendre des décisions opportunes et assurées en contexte d’ambiguïté, en équilibrant les risques et le potentiel de gain.
 Faire le lien entre les ventes, les appels d’offres, les contrats et la réalisation, afin que ce que nous vendons puisse être livré de façon rentable.
 Expérience: 
 Plus de 12 ans d’expérience dans des rôles liés aux appels d’offres, à la capture d’affaires, au développement commercial ou au développement des affaires, dont plus de 5 ans à diriger des équipes à titre de gestionnaire principal, de directeur ou l’équivalent.
 Sens commercial et des ventes : un historique de succès dans des appels d’offres d’envergure et complexes, et une solide compréhension des cycles de vente, des relations clients et du positionnement de marché.
 Esprit stratégique : capacité à saisir les occasions, à définir la stratégie de soumission et à formuler des recommandations claires à la haute direction.
 Compétences techniques : capacité à comprendre et à façonner des solutions techniques et opérationnelles, à échanger de façon crédible avec les experts et à transformer les exigences en offres convaincantes et réalisables. À l’aise avec les données, l’intelligence d’affaires et les outils de planification.
 Solides compétences financières : maîtrise de la modélisation financière, de la tarification, des états des résultats, des flux de trésorerie et de la gestion des marges, et capacité à défendre les données financières des soumissions auprès des finances et de la haute direction.
 Leadership assuré : capacité à bâtir des équipes très performantes et à influencer les parties prenantes de haut niveau de différentes fonctions.
 Maîtrise professionnelle du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral et à l’écrit (la connaissance d’une troisième langue est un atout). La maîtrise de l’anglais est requise pour collaborer avec les équipes de Lyft, ainsi qu’avec des clients et des partenaires en Amérique du Nord et à l’international.
 Atouts : expérience avec les méthodologies APMP ou Shipley, expérience des appels d’offres dans plusieurs régions et parcours combinant appels d’offres et réalisation.
 À quoi ressemble la réussite (12 premiers mois) 
 Un processus à jalons décisionnels en amont des appels d’offres et des plans de capture en place pour toutes les occasions stratégiques et ciblées.
 Une capacité fonctionnelle d’intelligence d’affaires et de planification de la demande qui oriente les décisions liées au carnet d’occasions et aux ressources.
 Un taux de succès amélioré, chaque soumission reposant sur une stratégie claire et un modèle financier ambitieux mais crédible.
 Une équipe solide et unie, reconnue comme un partenaire de confiance dans l’ensemble de l’organisation.
 Avantages: 
 Excellente couverture d’assurance santé, dentaire, vision, ainsi que l’assurance vie et prestation d’invalidité
 Programme de soutien en santé mentale
 Soutien à la fertilité et à la planification familiale
 Avantage pour les soins d'animaux de compagnie
 Compte de dépenses de santé (HSA)
 Options de cotisation pour le REER
 En plus des jours fériés observés dans la province, les membres salariés de l’équipe sont couverts par la politique flexible de congés payés de Lyft. La politique permet aux membres de l’équipe de prendre autant de temps qu’ils en ont besoin (avec l’approbation du gestionnaire).  The Director, Bid Strategy & Pricing (“Bid Director”) leads how Lyft Urban Solutions identifies, shapes, and wins new business. This role brings together commercial strategy, business intelligence, demand planning, and bid management in one function. Working as a strategic partner and deputy to the Head of Commercial Strategy & Delivery, the Bid Director owns the full pursuit lifecycle, from market strategy and pre-tender capture through bid submission and handover to delivery. We're looking for a strategist who is equally strong commercially, technically, and financially, and who leads people and cross-functional teams with confidence.
 Lyft Urban Solutions (LUS) creates bikeshare programs that riders love, cities need, and operators value. We design, build and support the bikes and stations technology behind bikeshare programs in cities around the world, including Bixi. Our Montreal team sits at the heart of that work, bringing together engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, operations, marketing and commercial teams under one roof.
 Responsibilities: 
 Commercial Strategy, Business Intelligence, and Demand Planning 
 Shape the commercial strategy with the Head of Commercial Strategy & Delivery, including target markets, regions of focus, and growth priorities.
 Lead the Commercial Strategy & Demand Planning Manager across planning, pricing policy, business intelligence, and demand planning.
 Build business and bid intelligence (market, customer, competitor, and procurement insight) that drives strategy, pipeline, and pursuit decisions.
 Own demand planning and pipeline forecasting, aligning bid capacity and resources with expected opportunities and revenue targets.
 Pre-Tender, Capture, and Bid/No-Bid 
 Own a gated process that all pre-tender pursuits follow, aligned with commercial strategy and target regions.

jobs.title: Fleet Operations Associate
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.
 Flexdrive is a subsidiary of Lyft that works together with Lyft teams to realize our shared mission. 
 At Flexdrive, we're at the forefront of revolutionizing transportation by building the operational backbone for autonomous vehicle (AV) fleets. As a leader in fleet management, we're leveraging our expertise to enter the AV space, forming strategic partnerships with cutting-edge technology providers. We're looking for dedicated team members to help us pioneer this new chapter, starting with our first AV depot in Nashville, Tennessee.
 Reporting to the Depot Operations Lead , Flexdrive is seeking detail-oriented and technically capable Depot Operations Associates to ensure our autonomous vehicle fleet maintains optimal readiness for 24/7 operations. This hands-on role combines critical vehicle preparation, maintenance support, and calibration responsibilities that directly impact fleet availability and safety. You will be responsible for the complete vehicle lifecycle from pre-deployment checks through end-of-day diagnostics, including specialized calibration procedures that enable autonomous operation.
 This position offers a unique opportunity to work with cutting-edge autonomous vehicle technology while developing expertise in AV operations, safety protocols, and technical procedures. If you're passionate about being part of the future of transportation and thrive in a fast-paced, detail-oriented environment, we encourage you to apply.
 Work Schedule & Shift Availability 
 This role supports 24/7 AV depot operations and requires availability to work either a day, afternoon, or overnight shift with hours scheduled between 6:00 AM- 3:30 PM, 12:00 PM - 11:00 PM, or 9:30 PM- 7:30 AM. Specific shift times and schedules will be determined based on operational needs and business requirements. 
 Schedules may include weekends and holidays based on depot operational requirements.
 Responsibilities: 
 Vehicle Readiness & Preparation: 
 Daily Fleet Management: Review and assess available AVs each shift, executing pre-deployment safety checks and end-of-day diagnostics to ensure all vehicles meet operational readiness standards per partner requirements.
 Vehicle State Transitions: Progress vehicles through operational states by completing all required checklists, sensor inspections, and verification processes in the fleet management system.
 Quality Assurance: Perform comprehensive vehicle inspections following partner knowledge base standards, annotating issues and ensuring adherence to Critical to Quality processes.
 Task Execution: Manage daily tasks via digital task management system, ensuring efficient workflow and timely completion of all vehicle preparation activities.
 Charging, Cleaning & Fleet Servicing: 
 Vehicle Cleanliness Standards: Maintain interior and exterior cleanliness meeting partner brand standards, ensuring all components (body panels, glass, sensors) are free of dirt, debris, dust, and odors following established cleaning procedures.
 Charging Operations: Execute strategic charging activities at optimal times, including mid-day charging sessions, while completing concurrent tasks to maximize efficiency and maintain fleet availability.
 Preventative Maintenance: Perform basic preventative maintenance tasks that don't require dealership intervention, including fluid checks/refills, tire pressure adjustments, and minor component replacements per approved SOPs.
 Cleaning Chemical Compliance: Use only approved cleaning chemicals and follow hazardous materials handling protocols per EHS requirements.
 Data Management & Security: 
 Data Operations: Execute secure data handling activities including data transfers, offload procedures, and device tracking while maintaining chain of custody per security standards.
 Data Compliance: Ensure all data offload procedures meet established SLAs, maintaining proper documentation and verification of successful data transfers.
 Device Security: Use only employer-supplied, corporate-enrolled devices for photos and data transfer, ensuring no personal devices store proprietary information per security requirements.
 Secure Handling: Maintain strict security protocols for all sensitive hardware, following chain of custody standards for critical components.
 Calibration & Technical Operations: 
 Sensor Calibration: Conduct calibration activities to reintroduce repaired vehicles into autonomous operation, following precise procedures outlined in training materials and SOPs.
 Manual Driving Operations: Drive autonomous vehicles within depot and on public roads for calibration procedures, ensuring sensors are properly calibrated for autonomous operations.
 Technical Verification: Validate calibration success through system checks and diagnostic procedures, ensuring vehicles meet all technical requirements for autonomous deployment.
 Documentation: Maintain accurate records of all calibration activities, including completion times, issues encountered, and verification results.
 Lot Management & Logistics: 
 Vehicle Movement: Efficiently manage lot operations including parking, staging, and moving AVs to appropriate areas (deployment zones, charging stations, service bays) while optimizing depot flow.
 Status Management: Update vehicle status in real-time tracking systems, monitoring cycle times and ensuring accurate visibility of fleet readiness.
 Service Coordination: Confirm completion of all service and repairs, transitioning vehicles to appropriate next status while tracking SLA compliance.
 Issue Escalation: Flag maintenance needs and repair requirements to Fleet Supervisor or Depot Operations Lead, providing detailed documentation of observed issues.
 Safety & Compliance: 
 Safety Protocol Adherence: Follow all OSHA, EHS, and partner safety guidelines including proper PPE usage, hazardous material handling, and emergency response procedures.
 Training Compliance: Maintain all required qualifications and certifications, completing ongoing training through the partner's learning management system.
 Incident Reporting: Immediately report safety concerns, vehicle damage, or operational issues through appropriate channels, supporting incident investigation as needed.
 Quality Standards: Ensure all work meets or exceeds partner operations system standards and quality requirements.
 Experience: 
 High school diploma or equivalent required; technical certification or associate degree in automotive technology, logistics, or related field preferred.
 1-2 years of experience in automotive, fleet operations, logistics, or similar hands-on operational environment.
 Valid U.S. driver's license with clean driving record (no major violations in past 3 years) - required for calibration driving duties.
 Mechanical aptitude with ability to perform basic vehicle maintenance and understand technical procedures.
 Strong attention to detail with ability to follow complex SOPs and maintain consistent quality standards.
 Physical capabilities to perform depot operations including ability to stand/walk for extended periods, lift up to 50 lbs, and work in various weather conditions.
 Technical proficiency with mobile devices, tablets, and basic computer systems for data entry and status tracking.
 Excellent communication skills for coordinating with team members and escalating issues effectively.
 Flexibility to work various shifts including nights, weekends, and holidays as part of 24/7 operations.
 Ability to obtain required certifications including Defensive Driving certification and role-specific qualifications.
 Benefits: 
 Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
 Mental health benefits
 Family building benefits
 Child care and pet benefits
 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future

jobs.description:

 Lyft is looking for a creator- and culture-obsessed Influencer Manager to build and own our influencer practice from the ground up. This role is for you if you can spot a viral creator on Monday, close the deal on Tuesday, then launch on Wednesday—and turn the relationship into something we can ignite again in a month. 
 You’ll work in close partnership with our Global Growth, Brand, Product Marketing, Legal, and Business Affairs teams, as well as our creator agency partners and production teams. You’ll also be Lyft’s go-to expert on creator work, building the playbook, setting the benchmarks, and helping teams across the company understand what great influencer marketing looks like and what it’s worth.

 Own influencer process end-to-end (develop strategy, write briefs, own talent relationships, manage deliverables, oversee production, drive approvals, and manage deadlines for all influencer work)

 Make the build-versus-agency call by campaign type, and keep in-house what needs Lyft judgment
 Build the repeatable process: intake, talent vetting, rate benchmarking, brief templates, and measurement standards for both organic and paid work
 Partner with Business Affairs and Legal on contracts, usage rights, exclusivity, and disclosure compliance
 Partner closely with the rest of the Social team on quick-turn projects that support evergreen content and business priorities, especially collab posts and anything landing on Lyft's owned channels
 Build talent relationships that carry across campaigns rather than restarting each time
 Level up marketers across the org — coach DRIs on what good influencer work looks like so quality doesn't vary by team
 Experience: 
 5+ years in influencer marketing, creator strategy, or paid social, with real depth on both organic creator partnerships and paid influencer activations
 Has personally negotiated influencer deals and understands how rates move with usage, exclusivity, and whether content runs organic, boosted, or as an ad
 Has managed an agency and scaled its support across multiple internal teams — not just run one account

 役割 
 セールスと市場開拓（Go-to-Market）部門の一員としてご活躍いただける、アカウント エグゼクティブを募集しています。この職務は日本を拠点とし、リージョナルディレクター直属となります。
 世界中のプロフェッショナルと連携しながら、お客様の期待を超える価値提供を実現し、安全でクラウドを前提としたデジタルの未来を推進していくポジションです。
また、Customer Success／Enablement／Architecture各チームと密に協働し、Zscalerが実現するクラウド・トランスフォーメーションの力を提案・体現することで、クラウドセキュリティ分野のグローバルリーダーとしての当社のポジションをさらに強固なものにしていただきます。
 業務内容 (役割と期待されること) 
 ・顧客の経営幹部を含む主要な関係者との信頼関係を構築すること。
 ・顧客の目標に基づく長期的なアカウント戦略を設計すること。
 ・社内関係者との連携による顧客ニーズを反映したアカウント計画を策定すること。
 ・ 顧客のビジネスを理解し、具体的な目標を掲げ、Zscalerソリューションを提案し、信頼できるパートナーとしての役割を発揮すること。
 求める人物像 (成功のための資質) 
 不確実さを力に変えられる人 ：正解が見えない状況でも前に進むことが出来る方。歩きながら道をつくることに前向きで、曖昧さを「障害」ではなく、価値あるものを生み出すための素材として捉えられる方。
 オーナーシップを持って動ける人 ：ミッションへの熱意が行動力につながり、自ら意思決定し、最後までやり切ることが出来る方。成果に本気で向き合うからこそ誠実にふるまい、戦略の議論から現場の実行まで、必要に応じて自在に行き来できる方。
 課題解決を楽しめる人 ：難しい課題ほど熱意をもって取り組める方。課題に集中し、解決までやり抜くことで最大のインパクトを生み出せると知っている方。
 信頼をつくるコラボレーター ：自分の成功だけでなく、チームの成功にコミットできる方。明確さと敬意のある率直さを大切にし、フィードバックを「与える・受け取る」を継続できる方。これこそが最高のチームワークであり、信頼を最速で築く方法だと理解している方。
 学び続ける人 ：学び続ける姿勢を持っている方。真の成長志向を持ち、自己啓発に情熱を注ぎ、より良いパートナー、より強力なチームメイトになるために積極的にフィードバックを求める方。仕事を心から楽しみ、目的意識を持って取り組める方。
 応募資格(必須条件) 
 ・ソフトウェアまたはセキュリティ業界における10年以上のフルサイクルセールス経験
 ・学士号またはそれに相当する実務経験
 ・法人顧客との関与および経営幹部への販売を含む戦略的営業の経験
 ・ビジネスレベルの日本語力(読み書き、会話)
 ・AI/ML技術に関する基礎知識、および担当する業務領域において成果を最適化するために、AI主導型ソリューションを活用・保護・展開した経験
 他の候補者との差別化要素(歓迎条件) 
 ・既存顧客や見込み客との確立されたネットワークを活かし、持続的な成果を生み出すスキル
 ・顧客の目的や課題を深く理解し、テクノロジーによるデジタルトランスフォーメーションの促進についての深い理解
 ・戦略的な営業計画に関する知識と新規顧客を獲得した実績
 ・ 具体的なAI関連スキルの保有、または実務での活用経験 
 ・AIを活用したセールスインテリジェンス、予測予測、あるいは会話型AIプラットフォームを活用した経験があり、エンタープライズ領域のテリトリープランニングやパイプラインの加速化を最適化できること

 This role is based in Tokyo, Japan.
 What you will be doing
 Develop and execute a territory strategy focused on new enterprise customer acquisition and sustainable revenue growth
 Strategically prospect into CTOs, engineering and IT leaders, and technical end users; proactively identify, qualify, and develop pipeline by uncovering customer priorities and business initiatives
 Lead complex enterprise sales cycles from discovery and qualification through negotiation and close, aligning stakeholders around a clear path forward
 Build trusted relationships and business champions across customer organizations, creating opportunities to open new accounts and grow MongoDB’s footprint across business units
 Articulate the business value of MongoDB’s platform and connect enterprise technology needs to customer outcomes
 Partner with Solutions Consulting, Professional Services, Customer Success, and cloud and channel partners to progress opportunities, maximize deal outcomes, and support customer success
 Meet and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual bookings objectives, while participating in MongoDB’s sales enablement and development programs
 What you bring to the table
 7+ years of quota-carrying field sales experience in a fast-paced, competitive market, with a focus on new business acquisition
 Professional business fluency in Japanese
 A track record of consistently meeting and exceeding sales targets
 The ability to explain the business value of complex enterprise technology to a range of stakeholders
 Experience building business champions and leading complex enterprise sales processes
 Strong opportunity qualification, time management, and resource management skills, along with the ability to learn quickly and establish credibility
 A driven, resilient, and competitive approach, with strong self-awareness and emotional intelligence

 Sales methodology training, such as MEDDIC, SPIN, or Challenger Sales
 Familiarity with databases, developer ecosystems, or open-source technology
 A strong interest in building expertise in MongoDB’s products and growing a career in the data platform market
 About MongoDB
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI.
 Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment , guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about life at MongoDB , and help us make an impact on the world.
 MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
 MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.
 エンタープライズ・アカウント・エグゼクティブ（新規開拓）
 日本のエンタープライズ企業に新規開拓でアプローチし、MongoDBの日本市場でのプレゼンスを広げていただく営業職です。意欲と主体性があり、お客様の課題に向き合える方を求めています。新たなエンタープライズのお客様との関係を築き、データを活用したモダナイゼーションやプロダクト・システム構築を支援していただきます。担当テリトリーの戦略を自ら描いて実行し、ビジネス部門・テクノロジー部門のリーダーと信頼関係を築きながら、複雑な商談をリードします。お客様とMongoDBの双方にとって意義ある成果を生み出すことがミッションです。
 勤務地は東京です。
 業務内容
 新規エンタープライズ顧客の獲得と持続的な売上成長を軸に、担当テリトリーの戦略を立案・実行する
 CTO、エンジニアリング・IT部門のリーダー、現場の技術担当者に戦略的にアプローチする。お客様の優先課題や事業施策を掘り下げ、案件の発掘・見極め・パイプラインの構築を主体的に進める
 ディスカバリーや案件の見極めから、交渉、クロージングまで、複雑なエンタープライズ商談をリードする。関係者の認識をそろえ、次のステップを明確にする
 顧客組織内に信頼関係とビジネスチャンピオン（社内推進役）を構築し、新規アカウントの開拓と、事業部門をまたいだMongoDB活用の拡大につなげる
 MongoDBのプラットフォームがもたらすビジネス価値を伝え、お客様のエンタープライズ技術のニーズを成果に結びつける
 ソリューションコンサルティング、プロフェッショナルサービス、カスタマーサクセス、クラウド/チャネルパートナーと連携し、案件を前に進めて成約につなげ、お客様の成功を支援する
 月次・四半期・年間の受注目標を達成・超過する。あわせて、MongoDBのセールスイネーブルメントや人材育成プログラムにも参加する
 応募資格
 競争が激しくスピード感のある市場で、新規開拓に重点を置いたクォータ（売上目標）を持つフィールドセールスの経験が7年以上ある
 売上目標を継続的に達成・超過してきた実績がある
 複雑なエンタープライズ向けテクノロジーのビジネス価値を、さまざまな立場の関係者にわかりやすく説明できる
 ビジネスチャンピオンを育てながら、複雑なエンタープライズ営業プロセスをリードした経験がある
 案件の見極め、時間管理、リソース管理に長けており、素早くキャッチアップして信頼を得られる
 向上心とレジリエンス、競争心があり、自己理解が深く、相手の立場や感情を汲み取って信頼関係を築ける
 歓迎する経験・スキル
 MEDDIC、SPIN、チャレンジャー・セールスなどの営業メソドロジーのトレーニング受講経験
 データベース、開発者エコシステム、オープンソース技術に関する知見
 MongoDB製品の専門性を高め、データプラットフォーム市場でキャリアを築いていくことへの強い関心
 MongoDBについて
 MongoDBは「変化」を前提に作られた会社です。お客様と社員が、市場のスピードに合わせてイノベーションを起こせるよう支援しています。私たちはAI時代に向けてデータプラットフォームを再定義し、ソフトウェアで産業を創造・変革し、既存の枠組みを覆そうとする開発者を後押ししています。MongoDBの統合データプラットフォームは、市場で最も広く利用でき、グローバルに分散されたデータプラットフォームです。レガシーなワークロードのモダナイズ、イノベーションの推進、AIの活用を支援します。
 クラウドネイティブなプラットフォームであるMongoDB Atlasは、グローバルに分散したマルチクラウド対応のデータプラットフォームとして唯一の存在で、AWS、Google Cloud、Microsoft Azureで利用できます。世界各地に拠点を構え、AIネイティブのスタートアップからFortune 100企業の約75%まで、67,000社を超えるお客様が、最も重要なアプリケーションでMongoDBを活用しています。私たちは、次世代のソフトウェアを支えています。

 社員一人ひとりの成長とビジネスへの貢献を後押しするため、誰もが支え合い、成長できる企業文化づくりに力を入れています。社員のアフィニティグループから、不妊治療支援、充実した育児休業制度まで、社員の心身の健康を大切にし、仕事とプライベートの両面でキャリアを支えます。 MongoDBでの働き方について詳しくはこちら 。ぜひ私たちと一緒に、世界にインパクトを与えましょう。

jobs.title: In-House Creator
jobs.description:
ABOUT GENESIS

We are a full-stack general-purpose robot company, born across San Francisco and Paris and bound by a single mission: to make general-purpose robots a reality, unlocking infinite physical labor for the world and freeing people for creativity, exploration, and the pursuits they love for their own sake.



We are French and American by birth and global by nature. We are backed by partners who share our vision, including Eclipse, Khosla Ventures, Bpifrance, and HSG, alongside Eric Schmidt, Xavier Niel, Daniela Rus, and Vladlen Koltun. Our people work across the Bay Area and Europe, building the engine that will teach robots to do real work in the real world. We recently unveiled Eno, our wheeled, dexterous robot powered by our GENE foundation model, and we are starting to put it to work with real customers.




THE ROLE

There's more real work happening at Genesis each week than anyone outside the building gets to see. With a launch ahead and researchers and engineers watching closely, we want a steady, credible record of it: the lab, the robots, the people, and the days between demos. The In-House Creator is our production engine, spotting the story, shooting it, and finishing it. You'll work with the Social Media Manager, who owns strategy and the calendar, and with founders and engineers, to publish often without giving up the premium feel.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Capture everyday life at Genesis, from late test runs to whiteboard sessions to lunch, and turn it into a steady pipeline of material for the brand accounts.

 - Film robots and lab work safely and closely enough that the footage shows real capability, favoring unbroken takes on real tasks over staged moments.

 - Shoot, produce, and edit video end to end, handling camera, lighting, audio, pacing, music, and the final cut, with each version built natively for its platform and X first.

 - Develop recurring formats, such as lab updates, engineer explainers, and first-attempt robot reels, that the team can count on and the audience comes back for.

 - Put founders, researchers, and engineers on camera, helping people who'd rather be debugging come across clearly and like themselves.

 - Cover launches, events, and lab visits, and turn customer deployments into video stories as robots go into production.

 - Build a searchable footage library and a capture system with shot lists and filming guides so engineers and field teams bring back usable footage when you're not there.

 - Work with the Social Media Manager on what ships, when, and in what form, supplying both the raw and finished material behind the calendar.

 - Review every robot clip for accuracy by labeling autonomy level and playback speed, flagging any edit that changes how a result reads, and holding customer and unreleased work until it's cleared.

 - Keep the bar high while publishing often, deciding what stays inside, what gets cut, and what earns a place on the brand accounts.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Professional experience (5+ years) shooting, producing, and editing video, with a portfolio that shows both what you captured and how you cut it.

 - Hands-on craft with camera, lighting, and audio, including fast setups in tight lab spaces and upkeep of the kit you shoot with.

 - Fluency in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, CapCut, or similar, plus a working sense of hooks in the first seconds, pacing, and sound for short-form video.

 - Speed paired with taste, meaning the ability to turn a moment around the same day without it looking rushed.

 - Comfort on camera and a presence that fits Genesis: curious, credible, and understated.

 - Genuine curiosity about robotics and the patience to work around engineers, test schedules, and hardware that doesn't always cooperate.

 - Safety awareness around moving robots and active test areas, and the habit of asking before stepping into a work cell.

 - Sound judgment about what's ready to publish, including when a clip overstates what a robot can do or reveals something that should stay inside.

 - Bonus: An existing following whose tone and audience align with Genesis.

 - Bonus: Motion graphics, 3D, or AI-assisted creative tools that help you move faster without lowering the bar.

 - Bonus: Prior work in robotics, hardware, or another field where a lab demo and a field deployment are very different things to film.

jobs.title: Channel Sales Manager, Los Angeles
jobs.description:
Who We Are 
 Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 
 We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.
 You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 
 About the Role 
 As a Channel Sales Manager , you'll be pivotal in scaling Verkada's reach and impact by developing and managing a network of high-performing reseller partners. You'll be responsible for driving net new business through the channel—building pipeline and executing strategic plans that result in measurable growth.
 This individual contributor role requires strategic thinking and hands-on execution as you collaborate across sales, marketing, and partner teams to grow Verkada’s presence in Southern California.
 What You’ll Do
 You’ll be at the heart of Verkada’s mission, working hand-in-hand with our sales teams to drive growth and success with channel partners. You’ll be responsible for building pipeline and generating net new business through reseller partners while executing a best-in-class channel strategy. Here’s what you’ll own:
 Drive Net New Pipeline: Proactively identify and generate pipeline with net new end-user customers through strategic reseller partners. Collaborate closely with field sales teams to co-sell and close high-value opportunities.
 Execute Regional Channel Strategy: Develop and manage a focused partner business plan for your territory that aligns with Verkada’s overall GTM objectives and quarterly sales targets.
 Empower Our Partners: Train and enable partner executives, sales teams, and technical stakeholders on Verkada’s full product portfolio, programs, and campaigns to ensure deep engagement and capability across all levels.
 Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with Verkada’s internal sales, marketing, and pre-sales teams to drive joint activities, including partner events, demand generation campaigns, and customer-facing initiatives.
 Lead with Insight: Conduct regular QBRs and ad-hoc business reviews with partners to align on priorities, track performance, celebrate wins, and identify opportunities for improvement.
 Strengthen the Channel Ecosystem: Influence partner sales teams to prioritize Verkada in key deals and business planning efforts. Leverage insights from the field to recommend improvements to Verkada’s channel tools, incentives, and partner program offerings.
 Drive Awareness and Demand: Lead and participate in regional in-person and virtual events to grow Verkada’s brand awareness, build community, and strengthen relationships with key partner contacts and stakeholders.
 Operate Strategically and Tactically: Own the full lifecycle of partner engagement in your region—from onboarding and enablement to pipeline development and revenue realization.
 This role requires regular travel, estimated to be at least 50% of the time, including both domestic and international destinations as needed. The successful candidate must be comfortable with frequent travel to support business operations, customer and partner engagements and team collaboration. 
 What You Bring
 Experience & Success : 4+ years of channel sales or partner management experience with a strong track record of building new business via Security Integrators or IT VAR partners. Recognition, such as President’s Club, is a plus.
 Strategic & Creative Thinking: A process-driven approach, complemented by innovative thinking to create scalable, partner-focused initiatives.
 Relationship-Builder : Ability to influence and engage across all levels—from partner sales reps to executive leadership.
 Technical Fluency: Comfortable navigating product discussions and sales operations. Proficiency in Salesforce, Excel, and business intelligence tools.
 Clear Communicator: Strong verbal and written communication skills with sharp attention to detail and a professional presence.
 Local to Greater Los Angeles Area: Open to 50% travel and willingness to be in our HQ in San Mateo on admin days.  
 US Employee Benefits 
 Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:
 Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans
 Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage
 Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options
 Expanded mental health support
 Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits
 Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time
 Professional development stipend
 Wellness/fitness benefits
 Healthy lunches provided daily
 Commuter benefits
 Additional Information 
 You must be independently authorized to work in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role, at this time.
 Annual Pay Range 
 At Verkada, we want to attract and retain the best employees, and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contribution to the company. With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate's skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity. A Verkada employee may be eligible for additional forms of compensation, depending on their role, including sales incentives, discretionary bonuses, and/or equity in the company in the form of restricted stock units (RSUs)

jobs.title: Engineering Manager – Camera Firmware Platform
jobs.description:
Who We Are 
 Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 
 We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.
 You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 
 About the Team 
 The Camera Firmware Platform team owns the foundation that every Verkada camera runs on. While our product firmware teams bring new camera categories to market, this team makes every camera in the fleet, both existing and future models, more reliable, faster, leaner, and more power-efficient.
 Edge Storage: We own the on-camera storage stack that turns every Verkada camera into a self-contained recording device. Our mandate is reliable, accessible, secure, and observable storage of customer video. Footage is preserved instantly across SD cards and raw NAND, even during network outages or sudden power loss, for millions of cameras and petabytes of video. This extends to the backend services that manage retention, cloud backup, and storage health across the fleet.
 Firmware Platform: Building on that foundation, we own the cross-cutting firmware systems underneath every camera feature: boot and shutdown, memory and power management, system state orchestration, IPC, observability, and firmware update. We build these once, for every camera model and SoC, so product teams can move fast without rebuilding the same infrastructure.
 About the Role 
 As the Engineering Manager for Camera Firmware Platform, you will lead a highly technical team of storage and embedded systems engineers responsible for the reliability, performance, power, and stability of firmware running on a fleet of more than 1.8 million perpetually online devices. You will set the storage and platform roadmap, decide which fleet-wide investments matter most, and turn them into measurable improvements in footage retention, storage endurance, boot time, memory headroom, power draw, and crash rates.
 You will partner closely with the Camera Firmware product team, Hardware, Streaming, Computer Vision, Cloud Infrastructure, Security, Manufacturing, and Product. You will also work with Verkada Linux, the shared OS layer across all Verkada product lines, to incubate platform capabilities on cameras and contribute them back for use across the company product lines.
 This role combines deep technical leadership with people management. We are committed to a thriving in-office culture, and this role requires onsite presence at our HQ in San Mateo, CA.
 What You'll Do 
 Lead the team 
 Lead and grow a team of storage, firmware, and systems engineers, and recruit and retain top-tier embedded talent as the team expands its charter.
 Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, career development, and execution management.
 Define the technical vision and multi-quarter roadmap for camera storage and firmware platform, balancing fleet-wide investments against support for new camera launches.
 Establish engineering best practices around testing, observability, incident response, root-cause analysis, and long-term maintainability.
 Drive storage optimizations 
 Storage stack and architecture: Own the on-camera storage stack end to end, including filesystems (ext4, UBIFS), video layout and indexing, SD/eMMC drivers, and raw NAND. Lead next-generation storage architecture such as new SD card modes, partition-level encryption, and secure deletion of expired footage.
 Reliability, endurance, and retention: Guarantee footage integrity through power loss, filesystem corruption, and failing media. Minimize write amplification with aligned, batched writes, and extend retention through index compression, smarter SD card capacity allocation, and better high versus low-quality stream storage.
 Storage observability: Build deep storage observability of SD and NAND health, erase counts, bad blocks, UBI counters, writes per hour, and retention metrics that feed release go/no-go decisions.
 Testing: Build hardware-in-the-loop testing for storage disaster cases such as full-period retention, OTA transitions across storage layout changes, partition reformats, EEPROM recovery, and SD controller firmware updates.
 Media qualification: Partner with Hardware teams and external flash vendors to evaluate, qualify, and validate next-generation storage media.
 Backend and network storage: Guide the evolution of storage-adjacent backend systems for retention, cloud backup, archives, and storage health notifications. Build on-premises storage appliances where cameras back up footage to RAID-backed hard drives over the LAN, with SMART-based drive health monitoring.
 Drive firmware platform improvements 
 Boot and shutdown: Optimize boot and shutdown paths across the boot stack, kernel, userspace services, and backend connection. This is critical for reducing downtime and maximizing video footage retention.
 System resources: Optimize memory, power, and network on resource-constrained embedded devices. Reduce DRAM and flash footprint of firmware services. Prevent brownouts at peak load with power management schemes such as Dynamic Frequency Scaling (DFS). Make network traffic between device and backend more efficient and resilient with techniques such as retry backoff with jitter and connection consolidation.
 Device State Management: Orchestrate device-level state transitions such as system and service restarts, OTA, DSP pipeline restart, commissioning and decommissioning. Sequencing these operations in the correct order is critical for correct device function.
 Observability and debuggability: Add core dumps and stack traces for crashes, reliable IPC message delivery, power-on self tests, standardized per-service and fleet-wide metrics, and system-wide log levels.
 Developer and release velocity: Improve build and kernel tooling, remote serial and flashing access, AI-assisted code review and workflows, and standardized manufacturing release and flashing automation across camera models.
 Operate at fleet scale 
 Own fleet-wide reliability metrics for retention, storage health, crash rates, memory pressure, boot time, and power, and make them visible in release go/no-go decisions.
 Find and fix issues before customers notice them, using diagnostic data from across the fleet.
 What You Bring 
 BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
 8+ years of software engineering experience in embedded or systems software, including 2+ years leading or managing high-performing systems, storage, platform, or infrastructure teams.
 Experience designing storage systems for continuous, high-throughput write workloads, such as video recording.
 Strong expertise in systems programming in C/C++; experience with Go or other higher-level languages preferred.
 Hands-on experience profiling and optimizing system-level performance, memory, and power on resource-constrained devices.
 Experience designing concurrent userspace services and IPC mechanisms (shared memory, sockets, message queues) and reasoning about their trade-offs.
 Experience debugging complex
